verses.en: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.
verses.fr: Moab se révolta contre Israël, après la mort d''Achab.
verses.am: አክዓብም ከሞተ በኋላ ሞዓብ በእስራኤል ላይ ዐመፀ።

verses.en: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.
verses.fr: Or Achazia tomba par le treillis de sa chambre haute à Samarie, et il en fut malade. Il fit partir des messagers, et leur dit: Allez, consultez Baal-Zebub, dieu d''Ekron, pour savoir si je guérirai de cette maladie.
verses.am: አካዝያስም በሰማርያ በሰገነቱ ላይ ሳለ ከዓይነ ርግቡ ወድቆ ታመመ፤ እርሱም። ሂዱ ከዚህም ደዌ እድን እንደ ሆነ የአቃሮንን አምላክ ብዔልዜቡልን ጠይቁ ብሎ መልእክተኞችን ላከ።

verses.en: But the angel of the Lord said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say unto them, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that ye go to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron?
verses.fr: Mais l''ange de l''Eternel dit à Elie, le Thischbite: Lève-toi, monte à la rencontre des messagers du roi de Samarie, et dis-leur: Est-ce parce qu''il n''y a point de Dieu en Israël que vous allez consulter Baal-Zebub, dieu d''Ekron?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ቴስብያዊውን ኤልያስን። ተነሣ፥ የሰማርያን ንጉሥ መልእክተኞች ለመገናኘት ውጣና። የአቃሮንን አምላክ ብዔልዜቡልን ትጠይቁ ዘንድ የምትሄዱት በእስራኤል ዘንድ አምላክ ስለሌለ ነውን?

verses.en: Now therefore thus saith the Lord, Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die. And Elijah departed.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel: Tu ne descendras pas du lit sur lequel tu es monté, car tu mourras. Et Elie s''en alla.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ትሞታለህ እንጂ ከወጣህበት አልጋ አትወርድም በላቸው አለው። ኤልያስም ሄደ።

verses.en: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?
verses.fr: Les messagers retournèrent auprès d''Achazia. Et il leur dit: Pourquoi revenez-vous?
verses.am: መልእክተኞችም ወደ አካዝያስ ተመለሱ፥ እርሱም። ለምን ተመለሳችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that thou sendest to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: Un homme est monté à notre rencontre, et nous a dit: Allez, retournez vers le roi qui vous a envoyés, et dites-lui: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Est-ce parce qu''il n''y a point de Dieu en Israël que tu envoies consulter Baal-Zebub, dieu d''Ekron? C''est pourquoi tu ne descendras pas du lit sur lequel tu es monté, car tu mourras.
verses.am: እነርሱም። አንድ ሰው ሊገናኘን መጣና። ሂዱ፥ ወደ ላካችሁም ንጉሥ ተመልሳችሁ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአቃሮንን አምላክ ብዔልዜቡልን ትጠይቅ ዘንድ የላከህ በእስራኤል ዘንድ አምላክ ስለሌለ ነውን? ስለዚህ ትሞታለህ እንጂ ከወጣህበት አልጋ አትወርድም በሉት አለን አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, What manner of man was he which came up to meet you, and told you these words?
verses.fr: Achazia leur dit: Quel air avait l''homme qui est monté à votre rencontre et qui vous a dit ces paroles?
verses.am: እርሱም። ሊገናኛችሁ የወጣው፥ ይህንስ ቃል የነገራችሁ ሰው መልኩ ምን ይመስላል? አላቸው።

verses.en: And they answered him, He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: C''était un homme vêtu de poil et ayant une ceinture de cuir autour des reins. Et Achazia dit: C''est Elie, le Thischbite.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ሰውዮው ጠጕራም ነው፥ በወገቡም ጠፍር ታጥቆ ነበር አሉት። እርሱም። ቴስብያዊው ኤልያስ ነው አለ።

verses.en: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spake unto him, Thou man of God, the king hath said, Come down.
verses.fr: Il envoya vers lui un chef de cinquante avec ses cinquante hommes. Ce chef monta auprès d''Elie, qui était assis sur le sommet de la montagne, et il lui dit: Homme de Dieu, le roi a dit: Descends!
verses.am: ንጉሡም የአምሳ አለቃውን ከአምሳ ሰዎች ጋር ሰደደ፥ ወደ እርሱም ወጣ፤ እነሆም፥ በተራራ ራስ ላይ ተቀምጦ ነበር። እርሱም። የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ ንጉሡ። ውረድ ይልሃል አለው።

verses.en: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I be a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
verses.fr: Elie répondit au chef de cinquante: Si je suis un homme de Dieu, que le feu descende du ciel et te consume, toi et tes cinquante hommes! Et le feu descendit du ciel et le consuma, lui et ses cinquante hommes.
verses.am: ኤልያስም መልሶ የአምሳ አለቃውን። እኔስ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው እንደ ሆንሁ እሳት ከሰማይ ትውረድ፥ አንተንም፥ አምሳውንም ሰዎችህን ትብላ አለው። እሳትም ከሰማይ ወርዳ እርሱንና አምሳውን ሰዎቹን በላች።

verses.en: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.
verses.fr: Achazia envoya de nouveau vers lui un autre chef de cinquante avec ses cinquante hommes. Ce chef prit la parole et dit à Elie: Homme de Dieu, ainsi a dit le roi: Hâte-toi de descendre!
verses.am: ደግሞም ሌላ የአምሳ አለቃ ከአምሳ ሰዎች ጋር ላከበት፤ እርሱም። የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ ንጉሡ። ፈጥነህ ውረድ ይላል ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
verses.fr: Elie leur répondit: Si je suis un homme de Dieu, que le feu descende du ciel et te consume, toi et tes cinquante hommes! Et le feu de Dieu descendit du ciel et le consuma, lui et ses cinquante hommes.
verses.am: ኤልያስም። እኔስ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው እንደ ሆንሁ እሳት ከሰማይ ትውረድ፥ አንተንም አምሳውንም ሰዎችህን ትብላ አለው። የእግዚአብሔርም እሳት ከሰማይ ወርዳ እርሱንና አምሳውን ሰዎቹን በላች።

verses.en: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him, O man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.
verses.fr: Achazia envoya de nouveau un troisième chef de cinquante avec ses cinquante hommes. Ce troisième chef de cinquante monta; et à son arrivée, il fléchit les genoux devant Elie, et lui dit en suppliant: Homme de Dieu, que ma vie, je te prie, et que la vie de ces cinquante hommes tes serviteurs soit précieuse à tes yeux!
verses.am: ደግሞም ሦስተኛ የአምሳ አለቃ ከአምሳ ሰዎች ጋር ሰደደ፤ ሦስተኛውም የአምሳ አለቃ ወጥቶ በኤልያስ ፊት በጕልበቱ ተንበረከከና። የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ ነፍሴና የእነዚህ የአምሳው ባሪያዎችህ ነፍስ በፊትህ የከበረች ትሁን።

verses.en: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.
verses.fr: Voici, le feu est descendu du ciel et a consumé les deux premiers chefs de cinquante et leurs cinquante hommes: mais maintenant, que ma vie soit précieuse à tes yeux!
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እሳት ከሰማይ ወርዳ የፊተኞቹን ሁለቱን የአምሳ አለቆችና አምሳ አምሳውን ሰዎቻቸውን በላች፤ አሁን ግን ነፍሴ በፊትህ የከበረች ትሁን ብሎ ለመነው።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel dit à Elie: Descends avec lui, n''aie aucune crainte de lui. Elie se leva et descendit avec lui vers le roi.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ኤልያስን። ከእርሱ ጋር ውረድ፥ አትፍራውም አለው። ተነሥቶም ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ንጉሡ ወረደ።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron, is it not because there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.
verses.fr: Il lui dit: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Parce que tu as envoyé des messagers pour consulter Baal-Zebub, dieu d''Ekron, comme s''il n''y avait en Israël point de Dieu dont on puisse consulter la parole, tu ne descendras pas du lit sur lequel tu es monté, car tu mourras.
verses.am: ኤልያስም። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአቃሮንን አምላክ ብዔልዜቡልን ትጠይቅ ዘንድ መልእክተኞችን ልከሃልና ትሞታለህ እንጂ ከወጣህበት አልጋ አትወርድም አለው።

verses.en: So he died according to the word of the Lord which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.
verses.fr: Achazia mourut, selon la parole de l''Eternel prononcée par Elie. Et Joram régna à sa place, la seconde année de Joram, fils de Josaphat, roi de Juda; car il n''avait point de fils.
verses.am: ኤልያስም እንደ ተናገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል ሞተ። ልጅም አልነበረውምና በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮሣፍጥ ልጅ በኢዮራም በሁለተኛው ዓመት ወንድሙ ኢዮራም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions d''Achazia, et ce qu''il a fait, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël?
verses.am: አካዝያስ ያደረገው የቀረው ነገር በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the Lord would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
verses.fr: Lorsque l''Eternel fit monter Elie au ciel dans un tourbillon, Elie partait de Guilgal avec Elisée.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ እግዚአብሔር ኤልያስን በዐውሎ ነፋስ ወደ ሰማይ ሊያወጣው በወደደ ጊዜ ኤልያስ ከኤልሳዕ ጋር ከጌልገላ ተነሣ።

verses.en: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the Lord hath sent me to Bethel. And Elisha said unto him, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Bethel.
verses.fr: Elie dit à Elisée: Reste ici, je te prie, car l''Eternel m''envoie jusqu''à Béthel. Elisée répondit: L''Eternel est vivant et ton âme est vivante! je ne te quitterai point. Et ils descendirent à Béthel.
verses.am: ኤልያስም ኤልሳዕን። እግዚአብሔር ወደ ቤቴል ልኮኛልና በዚህ ቆይ አለው። ኤልሳዕም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በሕያው ነፍስህም እምላለሁ፥ አልለይህም አለ። ወደ ቤቴልም ወረዱ።

verses.en: And the sons of the prophets that were at Bethel came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Lord will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he said, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.
verses.fr: Les fils des prophètes qui étaient à Béthel sortirent vers Elisée, et lui dirent: Sais-tu que l''Eternel enlève aujourd''hui ton maître au-dessus de ta tête? Et il répondit: Je le sais aussi; taisez-vous.
verses.am: በቤቴልም የነበሩ የነቢያት ልጆች ወደ ኤልሳዕ ወጥተው። እግዚአብሔር ጌታህን ከራስህ ላይ ዛሬ እንዲወስደው አውቀሃልን? አሉት። እርሱም። አዎን፥ አውቄአለሁ፤ ዝም በሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the Lord hath sent me to Jericho. And he said, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.
verses.fr: Elie lui dit: Elisée, reste ici, je te prie, car l''Eternel m''envoie à Jéricho. Il répondit: L''Eternel est vivant et ton âme est vivante! je ne te quitterai point. Et ils arrivèrent à Jéricho.
verses.am: ኤልያስም። ኤልሳዕ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ኢያሪኮ ልኮኛልና እባክህ፥ በዚህ ቆይ አለው። እርሱም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በሕያው ነፍስህም እምላለሁ፥ አልለይህም አለ።

verses.en: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Lord will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.
verses.fr: Les fils des prophètes qui étaient à Jéricho s''approchèrent d''Elisée, et lui dirent: Sais-tu que l''Eternel enlève aujourd''hui ton maître au-dessus de ta tête? Et il répondit: Je le sais aussi; taisez-vous.
verses.am: ወደ ኢያሪኮም መጡ። በኢያሪኮም የነበሩ የነቢያት ልጆች ወደ ኤልሳዕ ቀርበው። እግዚአብሔር ጌታህን ከራስህ ላይ ዛሬ እንዲወስደው አውቀሃልን? አሉት። እርሱም። አዎን አውቄአለሁ፤ ዝም በሉ ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.en: And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for the Lord hath sent me to Jordan. And he said, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.
verses.fr: Elie lui dit: Reste ici, je te prie, car l''Eternel m''envoie au Jourdain. Il répondit: L''Eternel est vivant et ton âme est vivante! je ne te quitterai point. Et ils poursuivirent tous deux leur chemin.
verses.am: ኤልያስም። እግዚአብሔር ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ልኮኛልና እባክህ፥ በዚህ ቆይ አለው። እርሱም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በሕያው ነፍስህም እምላለሁ፥ አልለይህም አለ። ሁለቱም ሄዱ።

verses.en: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.
verses.fr: Cinquante hommes d''entre les fils des prophètes arrivèrent et s''arrêtèrent à distance vis-à-vis, et eux deux s''arrêtèrent au bord du Jourdain.
verses.am: ከነቢያትም ልጆች አምሳ ሰዎች ሄዱ፥ በፊታቸውም ርቀው ቆሙ፤ እነዚህም ሁለቱ በዮርዳኖስ ዳር ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.
verses.fr: Alors Elie prit son manteau, le roula, et en frappa les eaux, qui se partagèrent çà et là, et ils passèrent tous deux à sec.
verses.am: ኤልያስም መጐናጸፊያውን ወስዶ ጠቀለለው፥ ውኃውንም መታ፥ ወዲህና ወዲያም ተከፈለ፤ ሁለቱም በደረቅ ተሻገሩ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils eurent passé, Elie dit à Elisée: Demande ce que tu veux que je fasse pour toi, avant que je sois enlevé d''avec toi. Elisée répondit: Qu''il y ait sur moi, je te prie, une double portion de ton esprit!
verses.am: ከተሻገሩም በኋላ ኤልያስ ኤልሳዕን። ከአንተ ሳልወሰድ አደርግልህ ዘንድ የምትሻውን ለምን አለው፤ ኤልሳዕም። መንፈስህ በእኔ ላይ ሁለት እጥፍ ይሆን ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing: nevertheless, if thou see me when I am taken from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be so.
verses.fr: Elie dit: Tu demandes une chose difficile. Mais si tu me vois pendant que je serai enlevé d''avec toi, cela t''arrivera ainsi; sinon, cela n''arrivera pas.
verses.am: እርሱም። አስቸጋሪ ነገር ለምነሃል፤ ነገር ግን ከአንተ ዘንድ በተወሰድሁ ጊዜ ብታየኝ ይሆንልሃል፤ አለዚያ ግን አይሆንልህም አለ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
verses.fr: Comme ils continuaient à marcher en parlant, voici, un char de feu et des chevaux de feu les séparèrent l''un de l''autre, et Elie monta au ciel dans un tourbillon.
verses.am: ሲሄዱም። እያዘገሙም ሲጫወቱ፥ እነሆ፥ የእሳት ሰረገላና የእሳት ፈረሶች በመካከላቸው ገብተው ከፈሉአቸው፤ ኤልያስም በዐውሎ ነፋስ ወደ ሰማይ ወጣ።

verses.en: And Elisha saw it, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.
verses.fr: Elisée regardait et criait: Mon père! mon père! Char d''Israël et sa cavalerie! Et il ne le vit plus. Saisissant alors ses vêtements, il les déchira en deux morceaux,
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም አይቶ። አባቴ አባቴ ሆይ፥ የእስራኤል ሰረገላና ፈረሰኞች፥ ብሎ ጮኸ። ከዚያም ወዲያ አላየውም፤ ልብሱንም ይዞ ከሁለት ተረተረው።

verses.en: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;
verses.fr: et il releva le manteau qu''Elie avait laissé tomber. Puis il retourna, et s''arrêta au bord du Jourdain;
verses.am: ከኤልያስም የወደቀውን መጐናጸፊያ አነሣ፥ ተመልሶም በዮርዳኖስ ዳር ቆመ።

verses.en: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the Lord God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.
verses.fr: il prit le manteau qu''Elie avait laissé tomber, et il en frappa les eaux, et dit: Où est l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Elie? Lui aussi, il frappa les eaux, qui se partagèrent çà et là, et Elisée passa.
verses.am: ከኤልያስም የወደቀውን መጎናጸፊያ ወስዶ ውኃውን መታና። የኤልያስ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ወዴት ነው? አለ፤ ውኃውንም በመታ ጊዜ ወዲህና ወዲያ ተከፈለ፤ ኤልሳዕም ተሻገረ።

verses.en: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.
verses.fr: Les fils des prophètes qui étaient à Jéricho, vis-à-vis, l''ayant vu, dirent: L''esprit d''Elie repose sur Elisée! Et ils allèrent à sa rencontre, et se prosternèrent contre terre devant lui.
verses.am: ከኢያሪኮም መጥተው በአንጻሩ የነበሩት የነቢያት ልጆች ባዩት ጊዜ። የኤልያስ መንፈስ በኤልሳዕ ላይ ዐርፎአል አሉ። ሊገናኙትም መጥተው በፊቱ ወደ ምድር ተደፉ።

verses.en: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest peradventure the Spirit of the Lord hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Voici, il y a parmi tes serviteurs cinquante hommes vaillants; veux-tu qu''ils aillent chercher ton maître? Peut-être que l''esprit de l''Eternel l''a emporté et l''a jeté sur quelque montagne ou dans quelque vallée. Il répondit: Ne les envoyez pas.
verses.am: እነርሱም። እነሆ፥ ከባሪያዎችህ ጋር አምሳ ኃያላን ሰዎች አሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ አንሥቶ ወደ አንድ ተራራ ወይም ወደ አንድ ሸለቆ ጥሎት እንደ ሆነ፥ ሄደው ጌታህን ይፈልጉት ዘንድ እንለምንሃለን አሉት። እርሱም። አትስደዱ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.
verses.fr: Mais ils le pressèrent longtemps; et il dit: Envoyez-les. Ils envoyèrent les cinquante hommes, qui cherchèrent Elie pendant trois jours et ne le trouvèrent point.
verses.am: እስኪያፍርም ድረስ ግድ ባሉት ጊዜ። ስደዱ አለ፤ አምሳም ሰዎች ሰደዱ፤ ሦስት ቀንም ፈልገው አላገኙትም።

verses.en: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils furent de retour auprès d''Elisée, qui était à Jéricho, il leur dit: Ne vous avais-je pas dit: N''allez pas?
verses.am: እርሱም። አዲስ ማሰሮ አምጡልኝ፥ ጨውም ጨምሩበት አለ፤ ያንንም አመጡለት።

verses.en: And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.
verses.fr: Les gens de la ville dirent à Elisée: Voici, le séjour de la ville est bon, comme le voit mon seigneur; mais les eaux sont mauvaises, et le pays est stérile.
verses.am: እርሱም። አዲስ ማሰሮ አምጡልኝ፥ ጨውም ጨምሩበት አለ፤ ያንንም አመጡለት።

verses.en: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they brought it to him.
verses.fr: Il dit: Apportez-moi un plat neuf, et mettez-y du sel. Et ils le lui apportèrent.
verses.am: ውኃው ወዳለበቱም ምንጭ ወጥቶ ጨው ጣለበትና። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ይህን ውኃ ፈውሼዋለሁ፤ ከዚህም በኋላ ሞትና ጭንገፋ አይሆንበትም አለ።

verses.en: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the Lord, I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land.
verses.fr: Il alla vers la source des eaux, et il y jeta du sel, et dit: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: J''assainis ces eaux; il n''en proviendra plus ni mort, ni stérilité.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም እንደ ተናገረው ነገር ውኃው እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ተፈውሶአል።

verses.en: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.
verses.fr: Et les eaux furent assainies, jusqu''à ce jour, selon la parole qu''Elisée avait prononcée.
verses.am: ከዚያም ወደ ቤቴል ወጣ፤ በመንገድም ሲወጣ ብላቴኖች ከከተማይቱ ወጥተው። አንተ መላጣ፥ ውጣ፤ አንተ መላጣ፥ ውጣ ብለው አፌዙበት።

verses.en: And he went up from thence unto Bethel: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.
verses.fr: Il monta de là à Béthel; et comme il cheminait à la montée, des petits garçons sortirent de la ville, et se moquèrent de lui. Ils lui disaient: Monte, chauve! monte, chauve!
verses.am: ዘወርም ብሎ አያቸው፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ስም ረገማቸው፤ ከዱርም ሁለት ድቦች ወጥተው ከብላቴኖች አርባ ሁለቱን ሰባበሩአቸው።

verses.en: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the Lord. And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.
verses.fr: Il se retourna pour les regarder, et il les maudit au nom de l''Eternel. Alors deux ours sortirent de la forêt, et déchirèrent quarante-deux de ces enfants.
verses.am: ከዚያም ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ተራራ ሄደ፥ ከዚያም ወደ ሰማርያ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.
verses.fr: De là il alla sur la montagne du Carmel, d''où il retourna à Samarie.
verses.am: ፤ ከዚያም ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ተራራ ሄደ፥ ከዚያም ወደ ሰማርያ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
verses.fr: Joram, fils d''Achab, régna sur Israël à Samarie, la dix-huitième année de Josaphat, roi de Juda. Il régna douze ans.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በኢዮሣፍጥ በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት የአክዓብ ልጅ ኢዮራም በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ መንገሥ ጀመረ፥ አሥራ ሁለትም ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he wrought evil in the sight of the Lord; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, non pas toutefois comme son père et sa mère. Il renversa les statues de Baal que son père avait faites;
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን አባቱ ያሠራውን የበኣልን ሐውልት አርቆአልና እንደ አባቱና እንደ እናቱ አልነበረም።

verses.en: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
verses.fr: mais il se livra aux péchés de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, qui avait fait pécher Israël, et il ne s''en détourna point.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እስራኤልን ባሳታቸው በናባጥ ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት ተያዘ፤ ከእርሱም አልራቀም።

verses.en: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.
verses.fr: Méscha, roi de Moab, possédait des troupeaux, et il payait au roi d''Israël un tribut de cent mille agneaux et de cent mille béliers avec leur laine.
verses.am: የሞዓብም ንጉሥ ሞሳ ባለ በጎች ነበረ፤ ለእስራኤልም ንጉሥ የመቶ ሺህ ጠቦትና የመቶ ሺህ አውራ በጎች ጠጕር ይገብርለት ነበር።

verses.en: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
verses.fr: A la mort d''Achab, le roi de Moab se révolta contre le roi d''Israël.
verses.am: አክዓብም ከሞተ በኋላ የሞዓብ ንጉሥ በእስራኤል ንጉሥ ላይ ዐመፀ።

verses.en: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.
verses.fr: Le roi Joram sortit alors de Samarie, et passa en revue tout Israël.
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ ንጉሡ ኢዮራም ከሰማርያ ወጥቶ እስራኤልን ሁሉ አሰለፈ።

verses.en: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as thou art, my people as thy people, and my horses as thy horses.
verses.fr: Il se mit en marche, et il fit dire à Josaphat, roi de Juda: Le roi de Moab s''est révolté contre moi; veux-tu venir avec moi attaquer Moab? Josaphat répondit: J''irai, moi comme toi, mon peuple comme ton peuple, mes chevaux comme tes chevaux.
verses.am: ወደ ይሁዳም ንጉሥ ወደ ኢዮሣፍጥ። የሞዓብ ንጉሥ ዐምፆብኛልና ከእኔ ጋር በሞዓብ ላይ ለሰልፍ ትሄዳለህን? ብሎ ላከ። እርሱም። እወጣለሁ፤ እኔ እንደ አንተ፥ ሕዝቤም እንደ ሕዝብህ፥ ፈረሶቼም እንደ ፈረሶችህ ናቸው አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Par quel chemin monterons-nous? Joram dit: Par le chemin du désert d''Edom.
verses.am: ደግሞም። በምን መንገድ እንሄዳለን? አለ፤ እርሱም። በኤዶምያስ ምድረ በዳ መንገድ ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.en: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days' journey: and there was no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël, le roi de Juda et le roi d''Edom, partirent; et après une marche de sept jours, ils manquèrent d''eau pour l''armée et pour les bêtes qui la suivaient.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ንጉሥና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኤዶምያስም ንጉሥ ሄዱ፤ የሰባትም ቀን መንገድ ዞሩ፤ ለሠራዊቱና ለተከተሉአቸውም እንስሶች ውኃ አልተገኘም።

verses.en: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the Lord hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!
verses.fr: Alors le roi d''Israël dit: Hélas! l''Eternel a appelé ces trois rois pour les livrer entre les mains de Moab.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ። ወዮ! እግዚአብሔር በሞዓብ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ እነዚህን ሦስቱን ነገሥታት ጠርቶአልና ወዮ አለ።

verses.en: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the Lord, that we may enquire of the Lord by him? And one of the king of Israel's servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.
verses.fr: Mais Josaphat dit: N''y a-t-il ici aucun prophète de l''Eternel, par qui nous puissions consulter l''Eternel? L''un des serviteurs du roi d''Israël répondit: Il y a ici Elisée, fils de Schaphath, qui versait l''eau sur les mains d''Elie.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም። በእርሱ እግዚአብሔርን የምንጠይቅበት የእግዚአብሔር ነቢይ በዚህ አይገኝምን? አለ። ከእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ባሪያዎች አንዱ። በኤልያስ እጅ ላይ ውኃ ያፈስስ የነበረው የሣፋጥ ልጅ ኤልሳዕ እዚህ አለ ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the Lord is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
verses.fr: Et Josaphat dit: La parole de l''Eternel est avec lui. Le roi d''Israël, Josaphat et le roi d''Edom, descendirent auprès de lui.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም። የእግዚአብሔር ቃል በእርሱ ዘንድ ይገኛል አለ። የእስራኤል ንጉሥና ኢዮሣፍጥ የኤዶምያስም ንጉሥ ወደ እርሱ ወረዱ።

verses.en: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said unto him, Nay: for the Lord hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab.
verses.fr: Elisée dit au roi d''Israël: Qu''y a-t-il entre moi et toi? Va vers les prophètes de ton père et vers les prophètes de ta mère. Et le roi d''Israël lui dit: Non! car l''Eternel a appelé ces trois rois pour les livrer entre les mains de Moab.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ። እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለኝ? ወደ አባትህና ወደ እናትህ ነቢያት ሂድ አለው። የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ። አይደለም፥ በሞዓብ እጅ ይጥላቸው ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እነዚህን ሦስት ነገሥታት ጠርቶአል አለው።

verses.en: And Elisha said, As the Lord of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.
verses.fr: Elisée dit: L''Eternel des armées, dont je suis le serviteur, est vivant! si je n''avais égard à Josaphat, roi de Juda, je ne ferais aucune attention à toi et je ne te regarderais pas.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም። በፊቱ የቆምሁት የሠራዊት ጌታ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! የይሁዳን ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን ያላፈርሁ ብሆን ኖሮ አንተን ባልተመለከትሁና ባላየሁ ነበር።

verses.en: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the Lord came upon him.
verses.fr: Maintenant, amenez-moi un joueur de harpe. Et comme le joueur de harpe jouait, la main de l''Eternel fut sur Elisée.
verses.am: አሁንም ባለ በገና አምጡልኝ አለ። ባለ በገናውም በደረደረ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ መጣችበት፤

verses.en: And he said, Thus saith the Lord, Make this valley full of ditches.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Faites dans cette vallée des fosses, des fosses!
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዚህ ሸለቆ ሁሉ ጕድጓድ ቆፈሩ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel: Vous n''apercevrez point de vent et vous ne verrez point de pluie, et cette vallée se remplira d''eau, et vous boirez, vous, vos troupeaux et votre bétail.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላል። ነፋስ አታዩም፥ ዝናብም አታዩም፥ ይህ ሸለቆ ግን ውኃ ይሞላል፤ እናንተም ከብቶቻችሁም እንስሶቻችሁም ትጠጣላችሁ።

verses.en: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the Lord: he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.
verses.fr: Mais cela est peu de chose aux yeux de l''Eternel. Il livrera Moab entre vos mains;
verses.am: ይህም በእግዚአብሔር ዓይን ቀላል ነገር ነው፤ ደግሞም ሞዓባውያንን በእጃችሁ አሳልፎ ይሰጣል።

verses.en: And ye shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.
verses.fr: vous frapperez toutes les villes fortes et toutes les villes d''élite, vous abattrez tous les bons arbres, vous boucherez toutes les sources d''eau, et vous ruinerez avec des pierres tous les meilleurs champs.
verses.am: የተመሸጉትንና ያማሩትን ከተሞች ሁሉ ትመታላችሁ፥ የሚያፈሩትንም ዛፎች ሁሉ ትቈርጣላችሁ፥ የውኃውንም ምንጮች ሁሉ ትደፍናላችሁ፥ መልካሞችንም እርሻዎች ሁሉ በድንጋይ ታበላሻላችሁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
verses.fr: Or le matin, au moment de la présentation de l''offrande, voici, l''eau arriva du chemin d''Edom, et le pays fut rempli d''eau.
verses.am: በነጋውም የቍርባን ጊዜ ሲደርስ፥ እነሆ፥ ውኃ በኤዶምያስ መንገድ መጣ፥ ምድሪቱም ውኃ ሞላች።

verses.en: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.
verses.fr: Cependant, tous les Moabites ayant appris que les rois montaient pour les attaquer, on convoqua tous ceux en âge de porter les armes et même au-dessus, et ils se tinrent sur la frontière.
verses.am: ሞዓባውያንም ሁሉ ነገሥታት ሊወጉአቸው እንደ መጡ በሰሙ ጊዜ በወገባቸው ሰይፍ የሚታጠቁ ሁሉ ተሰበሰቡ፤ ወጥተውም በአገሩ ድንበር ላይ ቆሙ።

verses.en: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:
verses.fr: Ils se levèrent de bon matin, et quand le soleil brilla sur les eaux, les Moabites virent en face d''eux les eaux rouges comme du sang.
verses.am: ማልደውም ተነሡ፤ ፀሐይም በውኃው ላይ አንጸባረቀ፥ ሞዓባውያንም በፊታቸው ውኃው እንደ ደም ቀልቶ አዩና። ይህ ደም ነው፤

verses.en: And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.
verses.fr: Ils dirent: C''est du sang! les rois ont tiré l''épée entre eux, ils se sont frappés les uns les autres; maintenant, Moabites, au pillage!
verses.am: በእርግጥ ነገሥታት እርስ በርሳቸው ተዋጉ፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም ተጋደሉ፤ ሞዓብ ሆይ፥ እንግዲህ ወደ ምርኮህ ሂድ አሉ።

verses.en: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.
verses.fr: Et ils marchèrent contre le camp d''Israël. Mais Israël se leva, et frappa Moab, qui prit la fuite devant eux. Ils pénétrèrent dans le pays, et frappèrent Moab.
verses.am: ወደ እስራኤል ሰፈር በመጡ ጊዜ እስራኤላውያን ተነሥተው ሞዓባውያንን መቱ፥ እነርሱም ከፊታቸው ሸሹ፤ ሞዓባውያንንም እየመቱ ወደ አገሩ ውስጥ ገቡ።

verses.en: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kirharaseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it, and smote it.
verses.fr: Ils renversèrent les villes, ils jetèrent chacun des pierres dans tous les meilleurs champs et les en remplirent, ils bouchèrent toutes les sources d''eau, et ils abattirent tous les bons arbres; et les frondeurs enveloppèrent et battirent Kir-Haréseth, dont on ne laissa que les pierres.
verses.am: ከተሞችንም አፈረሱ፤ በመልካሞቹም እርሻዎች ሁሉ ላይ እስኪሞሉ ድረስ እያንዳንዱ ሰው አንድ አንድ ድንጋይ ይጥል ነበር፤ የውኃውንም ምንጮች ሁሉ ደፈኑ፥ የሚያፈሩትንም ዛፎች ሁሉ ቈረጡ፤ የቂርሐራሴትን ድንጋዮች ብቻ አስቀሩ፤ ባለ ወንጭፎች ግን ከብበው መቱአት።

verses.en: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through even unto the king of Edom: but they could not.
verses.fr: Le roi de Moab, voyant qu''il avait le dessous dans le combat, prit avec lui sept cents hommes tirant l''épée pour se frayer un passage jusqu''au roi d''Edom; mais ils ne purent pas.
verses.am: የሞዓብም ንጉሥ ሰልፍ እንደ በረታበት ባየ ጊዜ ሰይፍ የሚመዝዙ ሰባት መቶ ሰዎች ከእርሱ ጋር ወሰደ፥ ወደ ኤዶምያስም ንጉሥ ያልፉ ዘንድ ሞከሩ፤ አልቻሉምም።

verses.en: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great indignation against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.
verses.fr: Il prit alors son fils premier-né, qui devait régner à sa place, et il l''offrit en holocauste sur la muraille. Et une grande indignation s''empara d''Israël, qui s''éloigna du roi de Moab et retourna dans son pays.
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ በእርሱ ፋንታ ንጉሥ የሚሆነውን የበኵር ልጁን ወስዶ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በቅጥሩ ላይ አቀረበው። በእስራኤልም ዘንድ ታላቅ ቍጣ ሆነ፤ ከዚያም ርቀው ወደ ምድራቸው ተመለሱ።

verses.en: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the Lord: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.
verses.fr: Une femme d''entre les femmes des fils des prophètes cria à Elisée, en disant: Ton serviteur mon mari est mort, et tu sais que ton serviteur craignait l''Eternel; or le créancier est venu pour prendre mes deux enfants et en faire ses esclaves.
verses.am: ከነቢያትም ወገን ሚስቶች አንዲት ሴት። ባሌ ባሪያህ ሞቶአል፤ ባሪያህም እግዚአብሔርን ይፈራ እንደ ነበረ አንተ ታውቃለህ፤ ባለ ዕዳ ልጆቼን ባሪያዎች አድርጎ ሊወስዳቸው መጥቶአል ብላ ወደ ኤልሳዕ ጮኸች።

verses.en: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.
verses.fr: Elisée lui dit: Que puis-je faire pour toi? Dis-moi, qu''as-tu à la maison? Elle répondit: Ta servante n''a rien du tout à la maison qu''un vase d''huile.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም። አደርግልሽ ዘንድ ምን ትሻለሽ? በቤትሽ ያለውን ንገሪኝ አላት። እርስዋም። ለእኔ ለባሪያህ ከዘይት ማሰሮ በቀር በቤቴ አንዳች የለኝም አለች።

verses.en: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Va demander au dehors des vases chez tous tes voisins, des vases vides, et n''en demande pas un petit nombre.
verses.am: እርሱም። ሄደሽ ከጐረቤቶችሽ ሁሉ ከሜዳ ባዶ ማድጋዎችን ተዋሺ፤ አታሳንሻቸውም አላት።

verses.en: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.
verses.fr: Quand tu seras rentrée, tu fermeras la porte sur toi et sur tes enfants; tu verseras dans tous ces vases, et tu mettras de côté ceux qui seront pleins.
verses.am: ገብተሽም ከአንቺና ከልጆችሽ በኋላ በሩን ዝጊ፥ ወደ እነዚህም ማድጋዎች ሁሉ ዘይቱን ገልብጪ፤ የሞላውንም ፈቀቅ አድርጊ አለ።

verses.en: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.
verses.fr: Alors elle le quitta. Elle ferma la porte sur elle et sur ses enfants; ils lui présentaient les vases, et elle versait.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ከእርሱ ሄዳ በሩን ከእርስዋና ከልጆችዋ በኋላ ዘጋች፤ እነርሱም ማድጋዎቹን ወደ እርስዋ ያመጡ ነበር፥ እርስዋም ትገለብጥ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.
verses.fr: Lorsque les vases furent pleins, elle dit à son fils: Présente-moi encore un vase. Mais il lui répondit: Il n''y a plus de vase. Et l''huile s''arrêta.
verses.am: ማድጋዎቹም በሞሉ ጊዜ ልጅዋን። ደግሞም ማድጋ አምጣልኝ አለችው፤ እርሱም። ሌላ ማድጋ የለም አላት፤ ዘይቱም ቆመ።

verses.en: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.
verses.fr: Elle alla le rapporter à l''homme de Dieu, et il dit: Va vendre l''huile, et paie ta dette; et tu vivras, toi et tes fils, de ce qui restera.
verses.am: መጥታም ለእግዚአብሔር ሰው ነገረችው፤ እርሱም። ሄደሽ ዘይቱን ሽጪ ለባለ ዕዳውም ክፈዪ፤ አንቺና ልጆችሽም ከተረፈው ተመገቡ አለ።

verses.en: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.
verses.fr: Un jour Elisée passait par Sunem. Il y avait là une femme de distinction, qui le pressa d''accepter à manger. Et toutes les fois qu''il passait, il se rendait chez elle pour manger.
verses.am: አንድ ቀንም እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ኤልሳዕ ወደ ሱነም አለፈ፥ በዚያም ታላቅ ሴት ነበረች፤ እንጀራ ይበላ ዘንድ የግድ አለችው፤ በዚያም ባለፈ ቍጥር እንጀራ ሊበላ ወደዚያ ይገባ ነበር።

verses.en: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.
verses.fr: Elle dit à son mari: Voici, je sais que cet homme qui passe toujours chez nous est un saint homme de Dieu.
verses.am: ለባልዋም። ይህ በእኛ ዘንድ ሁልጊዜ የሚያልፈው ቅዱስ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው እንደ ሆነ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
verses.fr: Faisons une petite chambre haute avec des murs, et mettons-y pour lui un lit, une table, un siège et un chandelier, afin qu''il s''y retire quand il viendra chez nous.
verses.am: ትንሽ ቤት በሰገነቱ ላይ እንሥራ፤ በዚያም አልጋ ጠረጴዛ ወንበርና መቅረዝ እናኑርለት፤ ወደ እኛም ሲመጣ ወደዚያ ይገባል አለችው።

verses.en: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.
verses.fr: Elisée, étant revenu à Sunem, se retira dans la chambre haute et y coucha.
verses.am: አንድ ቀንም ወደዚያ በመጣ ጊዜ ወደ ቤቱ ገብቶ በዚያ ዐረፈ።

verses.en: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.
verses.fr: Il dit à Guéhazi, son serviteur: Appelle cette Sunamite. Guéhazi l''appela, et elle se présenta devant lui.
verses.am: ሎሌውንም ግያዝን። ይህችን ሱነማዊት ጥራ አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.
verses.fr: Et Elisée dit à Guéhazi: Dis-lui: Voici, tu nous as montré tout cet empressement; que peut-on faire pour toi? Faut-il parler pour toi au roi ou au chef de l''armée? Elle répondit: J''habite au milieu de mon peuple.
verses.am: በጠራትም ጊዜ በፊቱ ቆመች። እርሱም። እነሆ፥ ይህን ሁሉ አሳብ አሰብሽልኝ፤ አሁንስ ምን ላድርግልሽ? ለንጉሥ ወይስ ለሠራዊት አለቃ ልንገርልሽን? በላት አለው፤ እርስዋም። እኔ በወገኔ መካከል ተቀምጫለሁ ብላ መለሰች።

verses.en: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Que faire pour elle? Guéhazi répondit: Mais, elle n''a point de fils, et son mari est vieux.
verses.am: እርሱም። እንግዲህ ምን እናድርግላት? አለ። ግያዝም። ልጅ የላትም፤ ባልዋም ሸምግሎአል ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.en: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Appelle-la. Guéhazi l''appela, et elle se présenta à la porte.
verses.am: እርሱም። ጥራት አለ። በጠራትም ጊዜ በደጃፉ ቆመች።

verses.en: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.
verses.fr: Elisée lui dit: A cette même époque, l''année prochaine, tu embrasseras un fils. Et elle dit: Non! mon seigneur, homme de Dieu, ne trompe pas ta servante!
verses.am: እርሱም። በሚመጣው ዓመት በዚህ ወራት ወንድ ልጅ ትታቀፊአለሽ አለ፤ እርስዋም። አይደለም ጌታዬ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ ባሪያህን እንዳትዋሻት እለምንሃለሁ አለች።

verses.en: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.
verses.fr: Cette femme devint enceinte, et elle enfanta un fils à la même époque, l''année suivante, comme Elisée lui avait dit.
verses.am: ሴቲቱም ፀነሰች፥ በዚያም ወራት በአዲሱ ዓመት ኤልሳዕ እንዳላት ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች።

verses.en: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
verses.fr: L''enfant grandit. Et un jour qu''il était allé trouver son père vers les moissonneurs,
verses.am: ሕፃኑም አደገ፥ አንድ ቀንም እህል አጫጆች ወዳሉበት ወደ አባቱ ወጣ።

verses.en: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.
verses.fr: il dit à son père: Ma tête! ma tête! Le père dit à son serviteur: Porte-le à sa mère.
verses.am: አባቱንም። ራሴን ራሴን አለው፤ እርሱም ሎሌውን። ተሸክመህ ወደ እናቱ ውሰደው አለው።

verses.en: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.
verses.fr: Le serviteur l''emporta et l''amena à sa mère. Et l''enfant resta sur les genoux de sa mère jusqu''à midi, puis il mourut.
verses.am: አንሥቶም ወደ እናቱ ወሰደው፤ በጕልበትዋም ላይ እስከ ቀትር ድረስ ተቀመጠ፥ ሞተም።

verses.en: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.
verses.fr: Elle monta, le coucha sur le lit de l''homme de Dieu, ferma la porte sur lui, et sortit.
verses.am: ወጥታም በእግዚአብሔር ሰው አልጋ ላይ አጋደመችው፥ በሩንም ዘግታበት ወጣች።

verses.en: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.
verses.fr: Elle appela son mari, et dit: Envoie-moi, je te prie, un des serviteurs et une des ânesses; je veux aller en hâte vers l''homme de Dieu, et je reviendrai.
verses.am: ባልዋንም ጠርታ። ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው በፍጥነት ደርሼ እመለስ ዘንድ አንድ ሎሌና አንድ አህያ ላክልኝ አለችው።

verses.en: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Pourquoi veux-tu aller aujourd''hui vers lui? Ce n''est ni nouvelle lune ni sabbat. Elle répondit: Tout va bien.
verses.am: እርሱም። መባቻ ወይም ሰንበት ያይደለ ዛሬ ለምን ትሄጂበታለሽ? አለ። እርስዋም። ደኅና ነው አለች።

verses.en: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.
verses.fr: Puis elle fit seller l''ânesse, et dit à son serviteur: Mène et pars; ne m''arrête pas en route sans que je te le dise.
verses.am: አህያውንም አስጭና ሎሌዋን። ንዳ፥ ሂድ፤ እኔ ሳላዝዝህ አታዘግየኝ አለችው።

verses.en: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:
verses.fr: Elle partit donc et se rendit vers l''homme de Dieu sur la montagne du Carmel. L''homme de Dieu, l''ayant aperçue de loin, dit à Guéhazi, son serviteur: Voici cette Sunamite!
verses.am: እንዲሁም ሄደች፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ሰው ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ተራራ መጣች። የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ከሩቅ ባያት ጊዜ ሎሌውን ግያዝን፥ እነኋት ሱነማዊቲቱ መጣች፤

verses.en: Run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well:
verses.fr: Maintenant, cours donc à sa rencontre, et dis-lui: Te portes-tu bien? Ton mari et ton enfant se portent-ils bien? Elle répondit: Bien.
verses.am: ትቀበላትም ዘንድ ሩጥና። በደኅናሽ ነውን? ባልሽ ደኅና ነውን? ልጅሽስ ደኅና ነውን? በላት አለው። እርስዋም። ደኅና ነው አለች።

verses.en: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the Lord hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.
verses.fr: Et dès qu''elle fut arrivée auprès de l''homme de Dieu sur la montagne, elle embrassa ses pieds. Guéhazi s''approcha pour la repousser. Mais l''homme de Dieu dit: Laisse-la, car son âme est dans l''amertume, et l''Eternel me l''a caché et ne me l''a point fait connaître.
verses.am: ወደ ተራራው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው በመጣች ጊዜ እግሮቹን ጨበጠች፤ ግያዝም ሊያርቃት ቀረበ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው። ነፍስዋ አዝናለችና ተዋት፤ እግዚአብሔርም ያንን ከእኔ ሰውሮታል አልነገረኝምም አለ።

verses.en: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?
verses.fr: Alors elle dit: Ai-je demandé un fils à mon seigneur? N''ai-je pas dit: Ne me trompe pas?
verses.am: እርስዋም። በውኑ ከጌታዬ ልጅን ለመንሁን? እኔም አታታልለኝ አላልሁህምን? አለች።

verses.en: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.
verses.fr: Et Elisée dit à Guéhazi: Ceins tes reins, prends mon bâton dans ta main, et pars. Si tu rencontres quelqu''un, ne le salue pas; et si quelqu''un te salue, ne lui réponds pas. Tu mettras mon bâton sur le visage de l''enfant.
verses.am: ግያዝንም። ወገብህን ታጠቅ፥ በትሬንም በእጅህ ይዘህ ሂድ፤ ሰውም ብታገኝ ሰላም አትበል፥ እርሱም ሰላም ቢልህ አትመልስለት፤ በትሬንም በሕፃኑ ፊት ላይ አኑር አለው።

verses.en: And the mother of the child said, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.
verses.fr: La mère de l''enfant dit: L''Eternel est vivant et ton âme est vivante! je ne te quitterai point. Et il se leva et la suivit.
verses.am: የሕፃኑም እናት። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በሕያው ነፍስህም እምላለሁ! አልተውህም አለች፤ ተነሥቶም ተከተላት።

verses.en: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.
verses.fr: Guéhazi les avait devancés, et il avait mis le bâton sur le visage de l''enfant; mais il n''y eut ni voix ni signe d''attention. Il s''en retourna à la rencontre d''Elisée, et lui rapporta la chose, en disant: L''enfant ne s''est pas réveillé.
verses.am: ግያዝም ቀደማቸው፥ በትሩንም በሕፃኑ ፊት ላይ አኖረው፤ ነገር ግን ድምፅ ወይም መስማት አልነበረም፤ እርሱንም ሊገናኘው ተመልሶ። ሕፃኑ አልነቃም ብሎ ነገረው።

verses.en: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.
verses.fr: Lorsque Elisée arriva dans la maison, voici, l''enfant était mort, couché sur son lit.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም ወደ ቤት በገባ ጊዜ እነሆ፥ ሕፃኑ ሞቶ በአልጋው ላይ ተጋድሞ ነበር።

verses.en: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Elisée entra et ferma la porte sur eux deux, et il pria l''Eternel.
verses.am: ገብቶም በሩን ከሁለቱ በኋላ ዘጋ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጸለየ።

verses.en: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.
verses.fr: Il monta, et se coucha sur l''enfant; il mit sa bouche sur sa bouche, ses yeux sur ses yeux, ses mains sur ses mains, et il s''étendit sur lui. Et la chair de l''enfant se réchauffa.
verses.am: መጥቶም በሕፃኑ ላይ ተኛ፤ አፉንም በአፉ፥ ዓይኑንም በዓይኑ፥ እጁንም በእጁ ላይ አድርጎ ተጋደመበት፤ የሕፃኑም ገላ ሞቀ።

verses.en: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
verses.fr: Elisée s''éloigna, alla çà et là par la maison, puis remonta et s''étendit sur l''enfant. Et l''enfant éternua sept fois, et il ouvrit les yeux.
verses.am: ተመልሶም በቤቱ ውስጥ አንድ ጊዜ ወዲህና ወዲያ ተመላለሰ፤ ደግሞም ወጥቶ ሰባት ጊዜ በሕፃኑ ላይ ተጋደመ፤ ሕፃኑም ዓይኖቹን ከፈተ።

verses.en: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
verses.fr: Elisée appela Guéhazi, et dit: Appelle cette Sunamite. Guéhazi l''appela, et elle vint vers Elisée, qui dit: Prends ton fils!
verses.am: ግያዝንም ጠርቶ። ይህችን ሱነማዊት ጥራ አለው። ጠራትም፥ ወደ እርሱም በገባች ጊዜ። ልጅሽን አንሥተሽ ውሰጂ አላት።

verses.en: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.
verses.fr: Elle alla se jeter à ses pieds, et se prosterna contre terre. Et elle prit son fils, et sortit.
verses.am: ገብታም በእግሩ አጠገብ ወደቀች በምድርም ላይ ተደፋች፤ ልጅዋንም አንሥታ ወጣች።

verses.en: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.
verses.fr: Elisée revint à Guilgal, et il y avait une famine dans le pays. Comme les fils des prophètes étaient assis devant lui, il dit à son serviteur: Mets le grand pot, et fais cuire un potage pour les fils des prophètes.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም ዳግመኛ ወደ ጌልገላ መጣ፥ በምድርም ላይ ራብ ነበረ፤ የነቢያትም ልጆች በፊቱ ተቀምጠው ነበር፥ ሎሌውንም። ታላቁን ምንቸት ጣድ፥ ለነቢያት ልጆችም ወጥ ሥራ አለው።

verses.en: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.
verses.fr: L''un d''eux sortit dans les champs pour cueillir des herbes; il trouva de la vigne sauvage et il y cueillit des coloquintes sauvages, plein son vêtement. Quand il rentra, il les coupa en morceaux dans le pot où était le potage, car on ne les connaissait pas.
verses.am: አንዱም ቅጠላቅጠል ያመጣ ዘንድ ወደ ሜዳ ወጣ፥ የምድረበዳውንም ሐረግ አገኘ ከዚያም የበረሀ ቅል ሰበሰበ፥ ልብሱንም ሞልቶ ተመለሰ፥ መትሮም በወጡ ምንቸት ውስጥ ጨመረው፤ ምን እንደ ሆነ ግን አላወቁም።

verses.en: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.
verses.fr: On servit à manger à ces hommes; mais dès qu''ils eurent mangé du potage, ils s''écrièrent: La mort est dans le pot, homme de Dieu! Et ils ne purent manger.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም ይበሉ ዘንድ ቀዱ፤ ወጡንም በቀመሱ ጊዜ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ በምንቸቱ ውስጥ ሞት አለ ብለው ጮኹ፤ ይበሉም ዘንድ አልቻሉም።

verses.en: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.
verses.fr: Elisée dit: Prenez de la farine. Il en jeta dans le pot, et dit: Sers à ces gens, et qu''ils mangent. Et il n''y avait plus rien de mauvais dans le pot.
verses.am: እርሱም። ዱቄት አምጡልኝ አለ፤ በምንቸቱም ውስጥ ጥሎ። ይበሉ ዘንድ ለሕዝቡ ቅዱ አለ። በምንቸቱም ውስጥ ክፉ ነገር አልተገኘም።

verses.en: And there came a man from Baalshalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.
verses.fr: Un homme arriva de Baal-Schalischa. Il apporta du pain des prémices à l''homme de Dieu, vingt pains d''orge, et des épis nouveaux dans son sac. Elisée dit: Donne à ces gens, et qu''ils mangent.
verses.am: አንድ ሰውም ከበኣልሻሊሻ የበኵራቱን እንጀራ፥ ሀያ የገብስ እንጀራ፥ የእህልም እሸት በአቁማዳ ይዞ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው መጣ፤ እርሱም። ይበሉ ዘንድ ለሕዝቡ ስጣቸው አለ።

verses.en: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the Lord, They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.
verses.fr: Son serviteur répondit: Comment pourrais-je en donner à cent personnes? Mais Elisée dit: Donne à ces gens, et qu''ils mangent; car ainsi parle l''Eternel: On mangera, et on en aura de reste.
verses.am: ሎሌውም። ይህን እንዴት አድርጌ ለመቶ ሰው እሰጣለሁ? አለ። እርሱም። ይበላሉ ያተርፋሉም ብሎ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና ይበሉ ዘንድ ለሕዝቡ ስጣቸው አለ።

verses.en: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.fr: Il mit alors les pains devant eux; et ils mangèrent et en eurent de reste, selon la parole de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንዲሁም በፊታቸው አኖረው፥ እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል በሉ፥ አተረፉም።

verses.en: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the Lord had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.
verses.fr: Naaman, chef de l''armée du roi de Syrie, jouissait de la faveur de son maître et d''une grande considération; car c''était par lui que l''Eternel avait délivré les Syriens. Mais cet homme fort et vaillant était lépreux.
verses.am: የሶርያ ንጉሥ ሠራዊት አለቃ ንዕማንም እግዚአብሔር በእርሱ እጅ ለሶርያ ደኅንነትን ስለ ሰጠ በጌታው ዘንድ ታላቅ ክቡር ሰው ነበረ፤ ደግሞም ጽኑዕ ኃያል ነበረ፥ ነገር ግን ለምጻም ነበረ።

verses.en: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman's wife.
verses.fr: Or les Syriens étaient sortis par troupes, et ils avaient emmené captive une petite fille du pays d''Israël, qui était au service de la femme de Naaman.
verses.am: ከሶርያውያንም አገር አደጋ ጣዮች ወጥተው ነበር፥ ከእስራኤልም ምድር ታናሽ ብላቴና ሴት ማርከው ነበር፤ የንዕማንንም ሚስት ታገለግል ነበር።

verses.en: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.
verses.fr: Et elle dit à sa maîtresse: Oh! si mon seigneur était auprès du prophète qui est à Samarie, le prophète le guérirait de sa lèpre!
verses.am: እመቤትዋንም። ጌታዬ በሰማርያ ካለው ከነቢዩ ፊት ቢደርስ ኖሮ ከለምጹ በፈወሰው ነበር አለቻት።

verses.en: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel.
verses.fr: Naaman alla dire à son maître: La jeune fille du pays d''Israël a parlé de telle et telle manière.
verses.am: ንዕማንም ገብቶ ለጌታው። ከእስራኤል አገር የሆነች አንዲት ብላቴና እንዲህና እንዲህ ብላለች ብሎ ነገረው።

verses.en: And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.
verses.fr: Et le roi de Syrie dit: Va, rends-toi à Samarie, et j''enverrai une lettre au roi d''Israël. Il partit, prenant avec lui dix talents d''argent, six mille sicles d''or, et dix vêtements de rechange.
verses.am: የሶርያም ንጉሥ ንዕማንን። ሂድ፥ ለእስራኤል ንጉሥ ደብዳቤ እልካለሁ አለው። እርሱም ሄደ፥ አሥርም መክሊት ብር፥ ስድስት ሺህም ወርቅ፥ አሥርም መለውጫ ልብስ በእጁ ወሰደ።

verses.en: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.
verses.fr: Il porta au roi d''Israël la lettre, où il était dit: Maintenant, quand cette lettre te sera parvenue, tu sauras que je t''envoie Naaman, mon serviteur, afin que tu le guérisses de sa lèpre.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ንጉሥ። ይህች ደብዳቤ ወደ አንተ ስትደርስ ባሪያዬን ንዕማንን ከለምጹ ትፈውሰው ዘንድ እንደ ሰደድሁልህ እወቅ የሚል ደብዳቤ ወሰደ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.
verses.fr: Après avoir lu la lettre, le roi d''Israël déchira ses vêtements, et dit: Suis-je un dieu, pour faire mourir et pour faire vivre, qu''il s''adresse à moi afin que je guérisse un homme de sa lèpre? Sachez donc et comprenez qu''il cherche une occasion de dispute avec moi.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ደብዳቤውን ባነበበ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀድዶ። ሰውን ከለምጹ እፈውስ ዘንድ ይህ ሰው ወደ እኔ መስደዱ እኔ በውኑ ለመግደልና ለማዳን የምችል አምላክ ሆኜ ነውን? ተመልከቱ፥ የጠብ ምክንያትም እንደሚፈልግብኝ እዩ አለ።

verses.en: And it was so, when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''Elisée, homme de Dieu, apprit que le roi d''Israël avait déchiré ses vêtements, il envoya dire au roi: Pourquoi as-tu déchiré tes vêtements? Laisse-le venir à moi, et il saura qu''il y a un prophète en Israël.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ኤልሳዕ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ልብሱን እንደ ቀደደ በሰማ ጊዜ። ልብስህን ለምን ቀደድህ? ወደ እኔ ይምጣ፥ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ ነቢይ እንዳለ ያውቃል ብሎ ወደ ንጉሡ ላከ።

verses.en: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
verses.fr: Naaman vint avec ses chevaux et son char, et il s''arrêta à la porte de la maison d''Elisée.
verses.am: ንዕማንም በፈረሱና በሰረገላው መጣ፥ በኤልሳዕም ቤት ደጃፍ ውጭ ቆመ።

verses.en: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.
verses.fr: Elisée lui fit dire par un messager: Va, et lave-toi sept fois dans le Jourdain; ta chair redeviendra saine, et tu seras pur.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም። ሂድ፥ በዮርዳኖስም ሰባት ጊዜ ታጠብ፤ ሥጋህም ይፈወሳል፥ አንተም ንጹሕ ትሆናለህ ብሎ ወደ እርሱ መልእክተኛ ላከ።

verses.en: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the Lord his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.
verses.fr: Naaman fut irrité, et il s''en alla, en disant: Voici, je me disais: Il sortira vers moi, il se présentera lui-même, il invoquera le nom de l''Eternel, son Dieu, il agitera sa main sur la place et guérira le lépreux.
verses.am: ንዕማን ግን ተቈጥቶ ሄደ፥ እንዲህም አለ። እነሆ፥ ወደ እኔ የሚመጣ፥ ቆሞም የአምላኩን የእግዚአብሔርን ስም የሚጠራ፥ የለምጹንም ስፍራ በእጁ ዳስሶ የሚፈውሰኝ መስሎኝ ነበር።

verses.en: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
verses.fr: Les fleuves de Damas, l''Abana et le Parpar, ne valent-ils pas mieux que toutes les eaux d''Israël? Ne pourrais-je pas m''y laver et devenir pur? Et il s''en retournait et partait avec fureur.
verses.am: የደማስቆ ወንዞች አባናና ፋርፋ ከእስራኤል ውኆች ሁሉ አይሻሉምን? በእነርሱስ ውስጥ መታጠብና መንጻት አይቻለኝም ኖሮአልን? ዘወርም ብሎ ተቈጥቶ ሄደ።

verses.en: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done it? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?
verses.fr: Mais ses serviteurs s''approchèrent pour lui parler, et ils dirent: Mon père, si le prophète t''eût demandé quelque chose de difficile, ne l''aurais-tu pas fait? Combien plus dois-tu faire ce qu''il t''a dit: Lave-toi, et tu seras pur!
verses.am: ባሪያዎቹም ቀርበው። አባት ሆይ፥ ነቢዩ ታላቅ ነገርስ እንኳ ቢነግርህ ኖሮ ባደረግኸው ነበር፤ ይልቁንስ። ታጠብና ንጹሕ ሁን ቢልህ እንዴት ነዋ! ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.en: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
verses.fr: Il descendit alors et se plongea sept fois dans le Jourdain, selon la parole de l''homme de Dieu; et sa chair redevint comme la chair d''un jeune enfant, et il fut pur.
verses.am: ወረደም፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው እንደ ተናገረው በዮርዳኖስ ሰባት ጊዜ ብቅ ጥልቅ አለ፤ ሥጋውም እንደ ገና እንደ ትንሽ ብላቴና ሥጋ ሆኖ ተመለሰ፥ ንጹሕም ሆነ።

verses.en: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing of thy servant.
verses.fr: Naaman retourna vers l''homme de Dieu, avec toute sa suite. Lorsqu''il fut arrivé, il se présenta devant lui, et dit: Voici, je reconnais qu''il n''y a point de Dieu sur toute la terre, si ce n''est en Israël. Et maintenant, accepte, je te prie, un présent de la part de ton serviteur.
verses.am: እርሱም ከጭፍራው ሁሉ ጋር ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው ተመለሰ፥ ወጥቶም በፊቱ ቆመና። እነሆ፥ ከእስራኤል ዘንድ በቀር በምድር ሁሉ አምላክ እንደሌለ አወቅሁ፤ አሁንም ከባሪያህ በረከት ትቀበል ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ አለ።

verses.en: But he said, As the Lord liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it; but he refused.
verses.fr: Elisée répondit: L''Eternel, dont je suis le serviteur, est vivant! je n''accepterai pas. Naaman le pressa d''accepter, mais il refusa.
verses.am: እርሱም። በፊቱ የቆምሁት ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! አልቀበልም አለ። ይቀበለውም ዘንድ ግድ አለው፤ እርሱ ግን እንቢ አለ።

verses.en: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules' burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Alors Naaman dit: Puisque tu refuses, permets que l''on donne de la terre à ton serviteur, une charge de deux mulets; car ton serviteur ne veut plus offrir à d''autres dieux ni holocauste ni sacrifice, il n''en offrira qu''à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ንዕማንም። እኔ ባሪያህ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ለሌሎች አማልክት የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ሌላ መሥዋዕት አላቀርብምና ሁለት የበቅሎ ጭነት አፈር እንድወስድ እሺ ትለኝ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ።

verses.en: In this thing the Lord pardon thy servant, that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, the Lord pardon thy servant in this thing.
verses.fr: Voici toutefois ce que je prie l''Eternel de pardonner à ton serviteur. Quand mon maître entre dans la maison de Rimmon pour s''y prosterner et qu''il s''appuie sur ma main, je me prosterne aussi dans la maison de Rimmon: veuille l''Eternel pardonner à ton serviteur, lorsque je me prosternerai dans la maison de Rimmon!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለእኔ ለባሪያህ በዚህ ነገር ብቻ ይቅር ይበለኝ፤ ጌታዬ በዚያ ይሰግድ ዘንድ እጄን ተደግፎ ወደ ሬሞን ቤት በገባ ጊዜ፥ እኔም በሬሞን ቤት በሰገድሁ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ነገር ለእኔ ለባሪያህ ይቅር ይበለኝ አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.
verses.fr: Elisée lui dit: Va en paix. Lorsque Naaman eut quitté Elisée et qu''il fut à une certaine distance,
verses.am: እርሱም። በደኅና ሂድ አለው። አንድ አግድመትም ያህል ከእርሱ ራቀ።

verses.en: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, as the Lord liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.
verses.fr: Guéhazi, serviteur d''Elisée, homme de Dieu, se dit en lui-même: Voici, mon maître a ménagé Naaman, ce Syrien, en n''acceptant pas de sa main ce qu''il avait apporté; l''Eternel est vivant! je vais courir après lui, et j''en obtiendrai quelque chose.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ሎሌ ግያዝ። ጌታዬ ሶርያዊውን ይህን ንዕማንን ማረው፥ ካመጣለትም ነገር ምንም አልተቀበለም፤ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በስተ ኋለው እሮጣለሁ፥ ከእርሱም አንዳች እወስዳለሁ አለ።

verses.en: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?
verses.fr: Et Guéhazi courut après Naaman. Naaman, le voyant courir après lui, descendit de son char pour aller à sa rencontre, et dit: Tout va-t-il bien?
verses.am: ግያዝም ንዕማንን ተከተለው፤ ንዕማንም ወደ እርሱ ሲሮጥ ባየው ጊዜ ሊገናኘው ከሰረገላው ወርዶ። ሁሉ ደኅና ነውን? አለው።

verses.en: And he said, All is well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Tout va bien. Mon maître m''envoie te dire: Voici, il vient d''arriver chez moi deux jeunes gens de la montagne d''Ephraïm, d''entre les fils des prophètes; donne pour eux, je te prie, un talent d''argent et deux vêtements de rechange.
verses.am: እርሱም። ደኅና ነው። አሁን ከነቢያት ወገን የሆኑት ሁለት ጕልማሶች ከተራራማው ከኤፍሬም አገር ወደ እኔ መጥተዋል፤ አንድ መክሊት ብርና ሁለት መለወጫ ልብስ ትሰጣቸው ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ ብሎ ጌታዬ ላከኝ አለ።

verses.en: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.
verses.fr: Naaman dit: Consens à prendre deux talents. Il le pressa, et il serra deux talents d''argent dans deux sacs, donna deux habits de rechange, et les fit porter devant Guéhazi par deux de ses serviteurs.
verses.am: ንዕማንም። ሁለት መክሊት ትወስድ ዘንድ ይፈቀድልህ አለ፤ ግድ አለውም፤ ሁለቱንም መክሊት ብር በሁለት ከረጢት ውስጥ አሰረና ከሁለት መለወጫ ልብስ ጋር ለሁለት ሎሌዎቹ አስያዘ፤ እነርሱም ተሸክመው በፊቱ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And when he came to the tower, he took them from their hand, and bestowed them in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.
verses.fr: Arrivé à la colline, Guéhazi les prit de leurs mains et les déposa dans la maison, et il renvoya ces gens qui partirent.
verses.am: ወደ ኮረብታውም በመጣ ጊዜ ከእጃቸው ወስዶ በቤቱ ውስጥ አኖራቸው፤ ሰዎቹንም አሰናበተ፥ እነርሱም ሄዱ።

verses.en: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence comest thou, Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.
verses.fr: Puis il alla se présenter à son maître. Elisée lui dit: D''où viens-tu, Guéhazi? Il répondit: Ton serviteur n''est allé ni d''un côté ni d''un autre.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ገብቶ በጌታው ፊት ቆመ፤ ኤልሳዕም። ግያዝ ሆይ፥ ከወዴት መጣህ? አለው። እርሱም። እኔ ባሪያህ ወዴትም አልሄድሁም አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Went not mine heart with thee, when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?
verses.fr: Mais Elisée lui dit: Mon esprit n''était pas absent, lorsque cet homme a quitté son char pour venir à ta rencontre. Est-ce le temps de prendre de l''argent et de prendre des vêtements, puis des oliviers, des vignes, des brebis, des boeufs, des serviteurs et des servantes?
verses.am: እርሱም። ያ ሰው ከሰረገላው ወርዶ ሊቀበልህ በተመለሰ ጊዜ ልቤ ከአንተ ጋር አልሄደምን? ብሩንና ልብሱን፥ የወይራውንና የወይኑን ቦታ፥ በጎችንና በሬዎችን፥ ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን ባሪያዎች ትቀበል ዘንድ ይህ ጊዜው ነውን?

verses.en: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee, and unto thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow.
verses.fr: La lèpre de Naaman s''attachera à toi et à ta postérité pour toujours. Et Guéhazi sortit de la présence d''Elisée avec une lèpre comme la neige.
verses.am: እንግዲህስ የንዕማን ለምጽ በአንተ ላይ፥ ለዘላለምም በዘርህ ላይ ይጣበቃል አለው። እንደ በረዶም ለምጻም ሆኖ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ወጣ።

verses.en: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell with thee is too strait for us.
verses.fr: Les fils des prophètes dirent à Elisée: Voici, le lieu où nous sommes assis devant toi est trop étroit pour nous.
verses.am: የነቢያትም ልጆች ኤልሳዕን። እነሆ፥ በፊትህ የምንቀመጥበት ስፍራ ጠብቦናል።

verses.en: Let us go, we pray thee, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go ye.
verses.fr: Allons jusqu''au Jourdain; nous prendrons là chacun une poutre, et nous nous y ferons un lieu d''habitation. Elisée répondit: Allez.
verses.am: ወደ ዮርዳኖስም እንሂድ፥ ከእኛም እያንዳንዱ ከዚያ ምሰሶ ያምጣ፥ የምንቀመጥበትንም ስፍራ በዚያ እንሥራ አሉት፤ እርሱም። ሂዱ አለ።

verses.en: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.
verses.fr: Et l''un d''eux dit: Consens à venir avec tes serviteurs. Il répondit: J''irai.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አንዱ። አንተ ደግሞ ከእኛ ከባሪያዎችህ ጋር ለመሄድ ፍቀድ አለ። እርሱም። እሄዳለሁ አለ።

verses.en: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down wood.
verses.fr: Il partit donc avec eux. Arrivés au Jourdain, ils coupèrent du bois.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር ሄደ፤ ወደ ዮርዳኖስም በደረሱ ጊዜ እንጨት ቆረጡ።

verses.en: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.
verses.fr: Et comme l''un d''eux abattait une poutre, le fer tomba dans l''eau. Il s''écria: Ah! mon seigneur, il était emprunté!
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አንዱ ምሰሶውን ሲቆርጥ የምሳሩ ብረት ወደ ውኃው ውስጥ ወደቀ፤ እርሱም። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ወየው! ወየው! የተዋስሁት ነበረ ብሎ ጮኽ።

verses.en: And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast it in thither; and the iron did swim.
verses.fr: L''homme de Dieu dit: Où est-il tombé? Et il lui montra la place. Alors Elisée coupa un morceau de bois, le jeta à la même place, et fit surnager le fer.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው። የወደቀው ወዴት ነው? አለ ስፍራውንም አሳየው፤ እንጨትም ቆርጦ በዚያ ጣለው፥ ብረቱም ተንሳፈፈ።

verses.en: Therefore said he, Take it up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it.
verses.fr: Puis il dit: Enlève-le! Et il avança la main, et le prit.
verses.am: እርሱም። ውሰደው አለ፤ እጁንም ዘርግቶ ወሰደው።

verses.en: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place shall be my camp.
verses.fr: Le roi de Syrie était en guerre avec Israël, et, dans un conseil qu''il tint avec ses serviteurs, il dit: Mon camp sera dans un tel lieu.
verses.am: የሶርያም ንጉሥ ከእስራኤል ጋር ይዋጋ ነበር፤ ከባሪያዎቹም ጋር ተማክሮ። በዚህ ተደብቀን እንሰፍራለን አለ።

verses.en: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.
verses.fr: Mais l''homme de Dieu fit dire au roi d''Israël: Garde-toi de passer dans ce lieu, car les Syriens y descendent.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው። ሶርያውያን በዚያ ተደብቀዋልና በዚያ ስፍራ እንዳታልፍ ተጠንቀቅ ብሎ ወደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ ላከ።

verses.en: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.
verses.fr: Et le roi d''Israël envoya des gens, pour s''y tenir en observation, vers le lieu que lui avait mentionné et signalé l''homme de Dieu. Cela arriva non pas une fois ni deux fois.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ ነገረው ስፍራ ሰደደ፤ አንድ ጊዜም ሳይሆን፥ ሁለት ጊዜም ሳይሆን በዚያ ራሱን አዳነ።

verses.en: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel?
verses.fr: Le roi de Syrie en eut le coeur agité; il appela ses serviteurs, et leur dit: Ne voulez-vous pas me déclarer lequel de nous est pour le roi d''Israël?
verses.am: የሶርያም ንጉሥ ልብ ስለዚህ እጅግ ታወከ፤ ባሪያዎቹንም ጠርቶ። ከእኛ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ጋር የተወዳጀ እንዳለ አትነግሩኝምን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.
verses.fr: L''un de ses serviteurs répondit: Personne! ô roi mon seigneur; mais Elisée, le prophète, qui est en Israël, rapporte au roi d''Israël les paroles que tu prononces dans ta chambre à coucher.
verses.am: ከባሪያዎቹም አንዱ። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እንዲህ እኮ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን በእልፍኝህ ውስጥ ሆነህ የምትናገረውን በእስራኤል ዘንድ ያለ ነቢይ ኤልሳዕ ለእስራኤል ንጉሥ ይነግረዋል አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Go and spy where he is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.
verses.fr: Et le roi dit: Allez et voyez où il est, et je le ferai prendre. On vint lui dire: Voici, il est à Dothan.
verses.am: እርሱም። ልኬ አስይዘው ዘንድ ሄዳችሁ ወዴት እንደ ሆነ እዩ አለ። እነርሱም። እነሆ፥ በዶታይን አለ ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.en: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.
verses.fr: Il y envoya des chevaux, des chars et une forte troupe, qui arrivèrent de nuit et qui enveloppèrent la ville.
verses.am: ወደዚያም ፈረሶችንና ሰረገሎችን እጅግም ጭፍራ ሰደደ፤ በሌሊትም መጥተው ከተማይቱን ከበቡ።

verses.en: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?
verses.fr: Le serviteur de l''homme de Dieu se leva de bon matin et sortit; et voici, une troupe entourait la ville, avec des chevaux et des chars. Et le serviteur dit à l''homme de Dieu: Ah! mon seigneur, comment ferons-nous?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሎሌ ማለዳ ተነሥቶ በወጣ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ በከተማይቱ ዙሪያ ጭፍራና ፈረሶች ሰረገሎችም ነበሩ። ሎሌውም። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ወዮ! ምን እናደርጋለን? አለው።

verses.en: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Ne crains point, car ceux qui sont avec nous sont en plus grand nombre que ceux qui sont avec eux.
verses.am: እርሱም። ከእኛ ጋር ያሉት ከእነርሱ ጋር ካሉት ይበልጣሉና አትፍራ አለው።

verses.en: And Elisha prayed, and said, Lord, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the Lord opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.
verses.fr: Elisée pria, et dit: Eternel, ouvre ses yeux, pour qu''il voie. Et l''Eternel ouvrit les yeux du serviteur, qui vit la montagne pleine de chevaux et de chars de feu autour d''Elisée.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም። አቤቱ፥ ያይ ዘንድ ዓይኖቹን፥ እባክህ፥ ግለጥ ብሎ ጸለየ። እግዚአብሔርም የብላቴናውን ዓይኖች ገለጠ፥ አየም፤ እነሆም፥ በኤልሳዕ ዙሪያ ያሉት የእሳት ፈረሶችና ሰረገሎች ተራራውን ሞልተውት ነበር።

verses.en: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto the Lord, and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.
verses.fr: Les Syriens descendirent vers Elisée. Il adressa alors cette prière à l''Eternel: Daigne frapper d''aveuglement cette nation! Et l''Eternel les frappa d''aveuglement, selon la parole d''Elisée.
verses.am: ወደ እርሱም በወረዱ ጊዜ ኤልሳዕ። ይህን ሕዝብ ዕውር ታደርገው ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ ብሎ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ። ኤልሳዕም እንደ ተናገረው ቃል ዕውር አደረጋቸው።

verses.en: And Elisha said unto them, This is not the way, neither is this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek. But he led them to Samaria.
verses.fr: Elisée leur dit: Ce n''est pas ici le chemin, et ce n''est pas ici la ville; suivez-moi, et je vous conduirai vers l''homme que vous cherchez. Et il les conduisit à Samarie.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም። መንገዱ በዚህ አይደለም፥ ከተማይቱም ይህች አይደለችም፤ የምትሹትን ሰው አሳያችሁ ዘንድ ተከተሉኝ አላቸው፤ ወደ ሰማርያም መራቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when they were come into Samaria, that Elisha said, Lord, open the eyes of these men, that they may see. And the Lord opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils furent entrés dans Samarie, Elisée dit: Eternel, ouvre les yeux de ces gens, pour qu''ils voient! Et l''Eternel ouvrit leurs yeux, et ils virent qu''ils étaient au milieu de Samarie.
verses.am: ወደ ሰማርያም በገቡ ጊዜ ኤልሳዕ። አቤቱ፥ ያዩ ዘንድ የእነዚህን ሰዎች ዓይኖች ግለጥ አለ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ዓይኖቻቸውን ገለጠ፥ እነርሱም አዩ። እነሆም፥ በሰማርያ መካከል ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite them? shall I smite them?
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël, en les voyant, dit à Elisée: Frapperai-je, frapperai-je, mon père?
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ባያቸው ጊዜ አልሳዕን። አባቴ ሆይ፥ ልግደላቸውን? ልግደላቸውን? አለው።

verses.en: And he answered, Thou shalt not smite them: wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.
verses.fr: Tu ne frapperas point, répondit Elisée; est-ce que tu frappes ceux que tu fais prisonniers avec ton épée et avec ton arc? Donne-leur du pain et de l''eau, afin qu''ils mangent et boivent; et qu''ils s''en aillent ensuite vers leur maître.
verses.am: እርሱም። አትግደላቸው፤ በሰይፍህና በቀስትህ የማረክኸውን ትገድል ዘንድ ይገባሃልን? እንጀራና ውኃ በፊታቸው አኑርላቸው፥ በልተውና ጠጥተውም ወደ ጌታቸው ይሂዱ አለው።

verses.en: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël leur fit servir un grand repas, et ils mangèrent et burent; puis il les renvoya, et ils s''en allèrent vers leur maître. Et les troupes des Syriens ne revinrent plus sur le territoire d''Israël.
verses.am: ብዙም መብል አዘጋጀላቸው፤ በበሉና በጠጡ ጊዜም አሰናበታቸው፥ እነርሱም ወደ ጌታቸው ሄዱ። ከዚያም በኋላ የሶርያ አደጋ ጣዮች ወደ እስራኤል አገር አልመጡም።

verses.en: And it came to pass after this, that Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.
verses.fr: Après cela, Ben-Hadad, roi de Syrie, ayant rassemblé toute son armée, monta et assiégea Samarie.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ የሶርያ ንጉሥ ወልደ አዴር ሠራዊቱን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ ወጥቶም ሰማርያን ከበባት።

verses.en: And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until an ass's head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove's dung for five pieces of silver.
verses.fr: Il y eut une grande famine dans Samarie; et ils la serrèrent tellement qu''une tête d''âne valait quatre-vingts sicles d''argent, et le quart d''un kab de fiente de pigeon cinq sicles d''argent.
verses.am: በሰማርያም ታላቅ ራብ ሆኖ ነበር፤ እነሆም፥ የአህያ ራስ በአምሳ ብር፥ የርግብም ኩስ የጎሞር ስምንተኛ የሚሆን በአምስት ብር እስኪሸጥ ድረስ ከበቡአት።

verses.en: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.
verses.fr: Et comme le roi passait sur la muraille, une femme lui cria: Sauve-moi, ô roi, mon seigneur!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በቅጥር ላይ በተመላለሰ ጊዜ አንዲት ሴት ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ እርዳኝ ብላ ወደ እርሱ ጮኸች።

verses.en: And he said, If the Lord do not help thee, whence shall I help thee? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress?
verses.fr: Il répondit: Si l''Eternel ne te sauve pas, avec quoi te sauverais-je? avec le produit de l''aire ou du pressoir?
verses.am: እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር ያልረዳሽን እኔ እንዴት እረዳሻለሁ? ከአውድማው ወይስ ከመጥመቂያው ነውን? አለ።

verses.en: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, This woman said unto me, Give thy son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.
verses.fr: Et le roi lui dit: Qu''as-tu? Elle répondit: Cette femme-là m''a dit: Donne ton fils! nous le mangerons aujourd''hui, et demain nous mangerons mon fils.
verses.am: ንጉሡም። ምን ሆነሻል? አላት፤ እርስዋም። ይህች ሴት። ዛሬ እንድንበላው ልጅሽን አምጪ፤ ነገም ልጄን እንበላለን አለችኝ።

verses.en: So we boiled my son, and did eat him: and I said unto her on the next day, Give thy son, that we may eat him: and she hath hid her son.
verses.fr: Nous avons fait cuire mon fils, et nous l''avons mangé. Et le jour suivant, je lui ai dit: Donne ton fils, et nous le mangerons. Mais elle a caché son fils.
verses.am: ልጄንም ቀቅለን በላነው፤ በማግሥቱም። እንድንበላው ልጅሽን አምጪ አልኋት፤ ልጅዋንም ሸሸገችው ብላ መለሰችለት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold, he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.
verses.fr: Lorsque le roi entendit les paroles de cette femme, il déchira ses vêtements, en passant sur la muraille; et le peuple vit qu''il avait en dedans un sac sur son corps.
verses.am: ንጉሡም የሴቲቱን ቃል ሰምቶ ልብሱን ቀደደ፤ በቅጥርም ይመላለስ ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም በስተ ውስጥ በሥጋው ላይ ለብሶት የነበረውን ማቅ አዩ።

verses.en: Then he said, God do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.
verses.fr: Le roi dit: Que Dieu me punisse dans toute sa rigueur, si la tête d''Elisée, fils de Schaphath, reste aujourd''hui sur lui!
verses.am: ንጉሡም። የሣፋጥ ልጅ የኤልሳዕ ራስ ዛሬ በላዩ ያደረ እንደ ሆነ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ያድርግብኝ፥ ይህንም ይጨምርብኝ አለ።

verses.en: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and the king sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head? look, when the messenger cometh, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door: is not the sound of his master's feet behind him?
verses.fr: Or Elisée était assis dans sa maison, et les anciens étaient assis auprès de lui. Le roi envoya quelqu''un devant lui. Mais avant que le messager soit arrivé, Elisée dit aux anciens: Voyez-vous que ce fils d''assassin envoie quelqu''un pour m''ôter la tête? Ecoutez! quand le messager viendra, fermez la porte, et repoussez-le avec la porte: le bruit des pas de son maître ne se fait-il pas entendre derrière lui?
verses.am: ኤልሳዕ ግን በቤቱ ተቀምጦ ነበር፥ ሽማግሌዎችም ከእርሱ ጋር ተቀምጠው ነበር፤ ንጉሡ ሰው ላካ፤ መልእክተኛውም ገና ሳይደርስ ለሽማግሌዎች። ይህ የነፍሰ ገዳይ ልጅ ራሴን ይቈርጥ ዘንድ እንደ ላከ እዩ፤ መልእከተኛውም በመጣ ጊዜ ደጁን ዘግታችሁ ከልክሉት፤ የጌታው የእግሩ ኮቴ በኋላው ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down unto him: and he said, Behold, this evil is of the Lord; what should I wait for the Lord any longer?
verses.fr: Il leur parlait encore, et déjà le messager était descendu vers lui, et disait: Voici, ce mal vient de l''Eternel; qu''ai-je à espérer encore de l''Eternel?
verses.am: ሲናገራቸውም መልእክተኛው ወደ እርሱ ደረሰ፤ እርሱም። እነሆ፥ ይህ ክፉ ነገር ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው፥ እግዚአብሔርን ገና እጠብቅ ዘንድ ምንድር ነኝ? አለ።

verses.en: Then Elisha said, Hear ye the word of the Lord; Thus saith the Lord, To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.
verses.fr: Elisée dit: Ecoutez la parole de l''Eternel! Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Demain, à cette heure, on aura une mesure de fleur de farine pour un sicle et deux mesures d''orge pour un sicle, à la porte de Samarie.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም። የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ነገ በዚህ ጊዜ በሰማርያ በር አንድ መስፈሪያ መልካም ዱቄት በአንድ ሰቅል፥ ሁለትም መስፈሪያ ገብስ በአንድ ሰቅል ይሸመታል አለ።

verses.en: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, Behold, if the Lord would make windows in heaven, might this thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.
verses.fr: L''officier sur la main duquel s''appuyait le roi répondit à l''homme de Dieu: Quand l''Eternel ferait des fenêtres au ciel, pareille chose arriverait-elle? Et Elisée dit: Tu le verras de tes yeux; mais tu n''en mangeras point.
verses.am: ንጉሡም በእጁ ተደግፎ የነበረ አለቃ ለእግዚአብሔር ሰው መልሶ። እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በሰማይ መስኮቶች ቢያደርግ ይህ ነገር ይሆናልን? አለው። እርሱም። እነሆ፥ በዓይኖችህ ታየዋለህ፥ ከዚያም አትቀምስም አለ። ፕ

verses.en: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?
verses.fr: Il y avait à l''entrée de la porte quatre lépreux, qui se dirent l''un à l''autre: Quoi! resterons-nous ici jusqu''à ce que nous mourions?
verses.am: በበሩም መግቢያ አራት ለምጻም ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ እርስ በርሳቸውም። እስክንሞት ድረስ በዚህ ለምን እንቀመጣለን?

verses.en: If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine is in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also. Now therefore come, and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.
verses.fr: Si nous songeons à entrer dans la ville, la famine est dans la ville, et nous y mourrons; et si nous restons ici, nous mourrons également. Allons nous jeter dans le camp des Syriens; s''ils nous laissent vivre, nous vivrons et s''ils nous font mourir, nous mourrons.
verses.am: ወደ ከተማ እንገባ ዘንድ ብንወድድ ራብ በከተማ አለ፥ በዚያም እንሞታለን፤ በዚህም ብንቀመጥ እንሞታለን። እንግዲህ ኑ፥ ወደ ሶርያውያን ሰፈር እንሽሽ፤ በሕይወት ቢያኖሩን እንኖራለን፤ ቢገድሉንም እንሞታለን ተባባሉ።

verses.en: And they rose up in the twilight, to go unto the camp of the Syrians: and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria, behold, there was no man there.
