verses.fr: Ils partirent donc au crépuscule, pour se rendre au camp des Syriens; et lorsqu''ils furent arrivés à l''entrée du camp des Syriens, voici, il n''y avait personne.
verses.am: ጨለምለም ባለ ጊዜ ወደ ሶርያውያን ሰፈር ይሄዱ ዘንድ ተነሡ፤ ወደ ሶርያውያንም ሰፈር መጀመሪያ ዳርቻ በመጡ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ማንም አልነበረም።

verses.en: For the Lord had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses, even the noise of a great host: and they said one to another, Lo, the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur avait fait entendre dans le camp des Syriens un bruit de chars et un bruit de chevaux, le bruit d''une grande armée, et ils s''étaient dit l''un à l''autre: Voici, le roi d''Israël a pris à sa solde contre nous les rois des Héthiens et les rois des Egyptiens pour venir nous attaquer.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሶርያውያን የሰረገላና የፈረስ የብዙም ጭፍራ ድምፅ አሰምቶ ነበር፤ እርስ በርሳቸውም። እነሆ፥ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ የኬጢያውያንና የግብጻውያንን ነገሥት ቀጥሮ አምጥቶብናል ይባባሉ ነበር።

verses.en: Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.
verses.fr: Et ils se levèrent et prirent la fuite au crépuscule, abandonnant leurs tentes, leurs chevaux et leurs ânes, le camp tel qu''il était, et ils s''enfuirent pour sauver leur vie.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ተነሥተው በጨለማ ሸሹ፤ ድንኳኖቻቸውንና ፈረሶቻቸውን አህዮቻቸውንና ሰፈሩን እንዳለ ትተው ነፍሳቸውን ያድኑ ዘንድ ሸሹ።

verses.en: And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and did eat and drink, and carried thence silver, and gold, and raiment, and went and hid it; and came again, and entered into another tent, and carried thence also, and went and hid it.
verses.fr: Les lépreux, étant arrivés à l''entrée du camp, pénétrèrent dans une tente, mangèrent et burent, et en emportèrent de l''argent, de l''or, et des vêtements, qu''ils allèrent cacher. Ils revinrent, pénétrèrent dans une autre tente, et en emportèrent des objets qu''ils allèrent cacher.
verses.am: እነዚህም ለምጻሞች ወደ ሰፈሩ መጀመሪያ ዳርቻ በመጡ ጊዜ ወደ አንድ ድንኳን ገብተው በሉ ጠጡም፥ ከዚያም ወርቅና ብር ልብስም ወሰዱ፥ ሄደውም ሸሸጉት፤ ተመልሰውም ወደ ሌላ ድንኳን ገቡ፥ ከዚያም ደግሞ ወስደው ሸሸጉ።

verses.en: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king's household.
verses.fr: Puis ils se dirent l''un à l''autre: Nous n''agissons pas bien! Cette journée est une journée de bonne nouvelle; si nous gardons le silence et si nous attendons jusqu''à la lumière du matin, le châtiment nous atteindra. Venez maintenant, et allons informer la maison du roi.
verses.am: ከዚያም ወዲያ እርስ በርሳቸው። መልካም አላደረግንም፤ ዛሬ የመልካም ምስራች ቀን ነው፥ እኛም ዝም ብለናል፤ እስኪነጋም ድረስ ብንቆይ በደለኞች እንሆናለን፤ ኑ፥ እንሂድ፤ ለንጉሥ ቤተ ሰብ እንናገር ተባባሉ።

verses.en: So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they were.
verses.fr: Ils partirent, et ils appelèrent les gardes de la porte de la ville, auxquels ils firent ce rapport: Nous sommes entrés dans le camp des Syriens, et voici, il n''y a personne, on n''y entend aucune voix d''homme; il n''y a que des chevaux attachés et des ânes attachés, et les tentes comme elles étaient.
verses.am: መጥተውም። ወደ ሶርያውያን ሰፈር መጣን፥ እነሆም፥ ፈረሶችና አህዮች ታስረው፥ ድንኳኖችም ተተክለው ነበር እንጂ ሰው አልነበረም፥ የሰውም ድምፅ አልነበረም ብለው ወደ ከተማይቱ ደጅ ጠባቂ ጮኹ።

verses.en: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king's house within.
verses.fr: Les gardes de la porte crièrent, et ils transmirent ce rapport à l''intérieur de la maison du roi.
verses.am: የደጁም ጠባቂዎች ጠሩ፥ ለንጉሡም ቤት ውስጥ አወሩ።

verses.en: And the king arose in the night, and said unto his servants, I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we be hungry; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive, and get into the city.
verses.fr: Le roi se leva de nuit, et il dit à ses serviteurs: Je veux vous communiquer ce que nous font les Syriens. Comme ils savent que nous sommes affamés, ils ont quitté le camp pour se cacher dans les champs, et ils se sont dit: Quand ils sortiront de la ville, nous les saisirons vivants, et nous entrerons dans la ville.
verses.am: ንጉሡም በሌሊት ተነሥቶ ባሪያዎቹን። ሶርያውያን ያደረጉብንን እነግራችኋለሁ፤ እንደ ተራብን ያውቃሉ፤ ስለዚህ። ከከተማይቱ በወጡ ጊዜ በሕይወታቸው እንይዛቸዋለን፥ ወደ ከተማም እንገባለን ብለው በሜዳ ይሸሸጉ ዘንድ ከሰፈሩ ወጥተዋል አላቸው።

verses.en: And one of his servants answered and said, Let some take, I pray thee, five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city, (behold, they are as all the multitude of Israel that are left in it: behold, I say, they are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed:) and let us send and see.
verses.fr: L''un des serviteurs du roi répondit: Que l''on prenne cinq des chevaux qui restent encore dans la ville, -ils sont comme toute la multitude d''Israël qui y est restée, ils sont comme toute la multitude d''Israël qui dépérit, -et envoyons voir ce qui se passe.
verses.am: ከባሪያዎቹም አንዱ መልሶ። በከተማ ከቀሩት ፈረሶች አምስት ይውሰዱ፤ እነሆ፥ እንደ ቀሩት እንደ እስራኤል ወገን ሁሉ ናቸው፤ እነሆ፥ እንዳለቁ እንደ እስራኤል ወገን ሁሉ ናቸው፤ እንስደድም፥ እንይም አለ።

verses.en: They took therefore two chariot horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.
verses.fr: On prit deux chars avec les chevaux, et le roi envoya des messagers sur les traces de l''armée des Syriens, en disant: Allez et voyez.
verses.am: ሁለትም ሰረገሎች ከፈረሶች ጋር ወሰዱ፤ ንጉሡም። ሄዳችሁ እዩ ብሎ ከሶርያውያን ሠራዊት በኋላ ላከ።

verses.en: And they went after them unto Jordan: and, lo, all the way was full of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. And the messengers returned, and told the king.
verses.fr: Ils allèrent après eux jusqu''au Jourdain; et voici, toute la route était pleine de vêtements et d''objets que les Syriens avaient jetés dans leur précipitation. Les messagers revinrent, et le rapportèrent au roi.
verses.am: በኋላቸው እስከ ዮርዳኖስ ድረስ ሄዱ፤ እነሆም፥ ሶርያውያን ሲሸሹ የጣሉት ልብስና ዕቃ መንገዱን ሁሉ ሞልቶ ነበር። መልእክተኞችም ተመልሰው ለንጉሡ ነገሩት።

verses.en: And the people went out, and spoiled the tents of the Syrians. So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.fr: Le peuple sortit, et pilla le camp des Syriens. Et l''on eut une mesure de fleur de farine pour un sicle et deux mesures d''orge pour un sicle, selon la parole de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ወጥቶ የሶርያውያንን ሰፈር በዘበዘ፤ እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል አንድ መስፈሪያ መልካም ዱቄት በአንድ ሰቅል፥ ሁለትም መስፈሪያ ገብስ በአንድ ሰቅል ተሸመተ።

verses.en: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate: and the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died, as the man of God had said, who spake when the king came down to him.
verses.fr: Le roi avait remis la garde de la porte à l''officier sur la main duquel il s''appuyait; mais cet officier fut écrasé à la porte par le peuple et il mourut, selon la parole qu''avait prononcée l''homme de Dieu quand le roi était descendu vers lui.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ያን እጁን ይደግፈው የነበረውን አለቃ በሩን ይጠብቅ ዘንድ አቆመው። ሕዝቡም በበሩ ረገጠው፥ ንጉሡም ወደ እርሱ በወረደ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው እንደ ተናገረው ሞተ።

verses.en: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, Two measures of barley for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour for a shekel, shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria:
verses.fr: L''homme de Dieu avait dit alors au roi: On aura deux mesures d''orge pour un sicle et une mesure de fleur de farine pour un sicle, demain, à cette heure, à la porte de Samarie.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ለንጉሡ። ነገ በዚህ ጊዜ በሰማርያ በር ሁለት መስፈሪያ ገብስ በአንድ ሰቅል፥ አንድም መስፈሪያ መልካም ዱቄት በአንድ ሰቅል ይሸመታል ብሎ እንደ ተናገረው ነገር እንዲሁ ሆነ።

verses.en: And that lord answered the man of God, and said, Now, behold, if the Lord should make windows in heaven, might such a thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.
verses.fr: Et l''officier avait répondu à l''homme de Dieu: Quand l''Eternel ferait des fenêtres au ciel, pareille chose arriverait-elle? Et Elisée avait dit: Tu le verras de tes yeux; mais tu n''en mangeras point.
verses.am: ያም አለቃ ለእግዚአብሔር ሰው መልሶ። እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በሰማይ መስኮቶች ቢያደርግ ይህ ነገር ይሆናልን? ብሎ ነበር፤ እርሱም። እነሆ፥ በዓይኖችህ ታየዋለህ፥ ከዚያም አትቀምስም ብሎት ነበር።

verses.en: And so it fell out unto him: for the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died.
verses.fr: C''est en effet ce qui lui arriva: il fut écrasé à la porte par le peuple, et il mourut.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ደረሰበት፤ ሕዝቡም በበሩ ረገጠውና ሞተ።

verses.en: Then spake Elisha unto the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go thou and thine household, and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn: for the Lord hath called for a famine; and it shall also come upon the land seven years.
verses.fr: Elisée dit à la femme dont il avait fait revivre le fils: Lève-toi, va t''en, toi et ta maison, et séjourne où tu pourras; car l''Eternel appelle la famine, et même elle vient sur le pays pour sept années.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም ልጅዋን ያስነሣላትን ሴት። አንቺ ከቤተ ሰብሽ ጋር ተነሥተሽ ሂጂ፥ በምታገኚውም ስፍራ ተቀመጪ፤ እግዚአብሔር ራብ ጠርቶአል፤ ሰባት ዓመትም በምድር ላይ ይመጣል ብሎ ተናገራት።

verses.en: And the woman arose, and did after the saying of the man of God: and she went with her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.
verses.fr: La femme se leva, et elle fit selon la parole de l''homme de Dieu: elle s''en alla, elle et sa maison, et séjourna sept ans au pays des Philistins.
verses.am: ሴቲቱም ተነሥታ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው ቃል አደረገች፤ ከቤተ ሰብዋም ጋር ሄዳ በፍልስጥኤም አገር ሰባት ዓመት ተቀመጠች።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the seven years' end, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines: and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land.
verses.fr: Au bout des sept ans, la femme revint du pays des Philistins, et elle alla implorer le roi au sujet de sa maison et de son champ.
verses.am: ሰባቱም ዓመት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ ሴቲቱ ከፍልስጥኤም አገር ተመለሰች፤ ስለ ቤትዋና ስለ መሬትዋ ልትጮኽ ወደ ንጉሡ ወጣች።

verses.en: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things that Elisha hath done.
verses.fr: Le roi s''entretenait avec Guéhazi, serviteur de l''homme de Dieu, et il disait: Raconte-moi, je te prie, toutes les grandes choses qu''Elisée a faites.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ከእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሎሌ ከግያዝ ጋር። ኤልሳዕ ያደረገውን ተአምራት ሁሉ ንገረኝ እያለ ይጫወት ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, cried to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.
verses.fr: Et pendant qu''il racontait au roi comment Elisée avait rendu la vie à un mort, la femme dont Elisée avait fait revivre le fils vint implorer le roi au sujet de sa maison et de son champ. Guéhazi dit: O roi, mon seigneur, voici la femme, et voici son fils qu''Elisée a fait revivre.
verses.am: እርሱም የሞተውን እንደ አስነሣ ለንጉሡ ሲናገር፥ እነሆ፥ ልጅዋን ያስነሣላት ሴት ስለ ቤትዋና ስለ መሬትዋ ወደ ንጉሥ ጮኸች፤ ግያዝም። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ሴቲቱ ይህች ናት፥ ኤልሳዕም ያስነሣው ልጅዋ ይህ ነው አለ።

verses.en: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.
verses.fr: Le roi interrogea la femme, et elle lui fit le récit. Puis le roi lui donna un eunuque, auquel il dit: Fais restituer tout ce qui appartient à cette femme, avec tous les revenus du champ, depuis le jour où elle a quitté le pays jusqu''à maintenant.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሴቲቱን ጠየቀ፥ ነገረችውም። ንጉሡም። የነበረላትን ሁሉ፥ መሬትዋንም ከተወች ጀምራ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ያለውን የእርሻዋን ፍሬ ሁሉ መልስላት ብሎ ስለ እርስዋ ጃንደረባውን አዘዘ።

verses.en: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of God is come hither.
verses.fr: Elisée se rendit à Damas. Ben-Hadad, roi de Syrie, était malade; et on l''avertit, en disant: L''homme de Dieu est arrivé ici.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም ወደ ደማስቆ መጣ፤ የሶርያም ንጉሥ ወልደ አዴር ታምሞ ነበር፤ ወሬኞችም። የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደዚህ መጥቶአል ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.en: And the king said unto Hazael, Take a present in thine hand, and go, meet the man of God, and enquire of the Lord by him, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?
verses.fr: Le roi dit à Hazaël: Prends avec toi un présent, et va au-devant de l''homme de Dieu; consulte par lui l''Eternel, en disant: Guérirai-je de cette maladie?
verses.am: ንጉሡም አዛሄልን። ገጸ በረከት በእጅህ ወስደህ የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው ልትገናኝ ሂድ፤ በእርሱም አፍ። ከዚህ በሽታ እድናለሁን? ብለህ እግዚአብሔርን ጠይቅ አለው።

verses.en: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels' burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Thy son Benhadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?
verses.fr: Hazaël alla au-devant d''Elisée, prenant avec lui un présent, tout ce qu''il y avait de meilleur à Damas, la charge de quarante chameaux. Lorsqu''il fut arrivé, il se présenta à lui, et dit: Ton fils Ben-Hadad, roi de Syrie, m''envoie vers toi pour dire: Guérirai-je de cette maladie?
verses.am: አዛሄልም ሊገናኘው ሄደ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ከደማስቆ መልካሙን ነገር ሁሉ የአርባ ግመል ጭነት ገጸ በረከት ወሰደ፤ መጥቶም በፊቱ ቆመና። ልጅህ የሶርያ ንጉሥ ወልደ አዴር። ከዚህ በሽታ እድናለሁን? ሲል ወደ አንተ ልኮኛል አለ።

verses.en: And Elisha said unto him, Go, say unto him, Thou mayest certainly recover: howbeit the Lord hath shewed me that he shall surely die.
verses.fr: Elisée lui répondit: Va, dis-lui: Tu guériras! Mais l''Eternel m''a révélé qu''il mourra.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም። ሂድ፥ መዳንስ ትድናለህ በለው፤ ነገር ግን እንዲሞት እግዚአብሔር አሳይቶኛል አለው።

verses.en: And he settled his countenance stedfastly, until he was ashamed: and the man of God wept.
verses.fr: L''homme de Dieu arrêta son regard sur Hazaël, et le fixa longtemps, puis il pleura.
verses.am: እስኪያፍርም ድረስ ትኵር ብሎ ተመለከተው፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው አነባ።

verses.en: And Hazael said, Why weepeth my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel: their strong holds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women with child.
verses.fr: Hazaël dit: Pourquoi mon seigneur pleure-t-il? Et Elisée répondit: Parce que je sais le mal que tu feras aux enfants d''Israël; tu mettras le feu à leurs villes fortes, tu tueras avec l''épée leurs jeunes gens, tu écraseras leurs petits enfants, et tu fendras le ventre de leurs femmes enceintes.
verses.am: አዛሄልም። ጌታዬ ለምን ያነባል? አለ። እርሱም። በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ የምታደርገውን ክፋት ስለማውቅ ነው፤ ምሽጎቻቸውን በእሳት ታቃጥላለህ፥ ጕልማሶቻቸውንም በሰይፍ ትገድላለህ፥ ሕፃናቶቻቸውንም ትፈጠፍጣለህ፥ እርጉዞቻቸውንም ትቀድዳለህ አለው።

verses.en: And Hazael said, But what, is thy servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, The Lord hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria.
verses.fr: Hazaël dit: Mais qu''est-ce que ton serviteur, ce chien, pour faire de si grandes choses? Et Elisée dit: L''Eternel m''a révélé que tu seras roi de Syrie.
verses.am: አዛሄልም። ይህን ታላቅ ነገር አደርግ ዘንድ እኔ ውሻ ባሪያህ ምንድር ነኝ? አለ። ኤልሳዕም። አንተ በሶርያ ላይ ንጉሥ እንድትሆን እግዚአብሔር አሳይቶኛል አለው።

verses.en: So he departed from Elisha, and came to his master; who said to him, What said Elisha to thee? And he answered, He told me that thou shouldest surely recover.
verses.fr: Hazaël quitta Elisée, et revint auprès de son maître, qui lui dit: Que t''a dit Elisée? Et il répondit: Il m''a dit: Tu guériras!
verses.am: ከኤልሳዕም ርቆ ወደ ጌታው መጣ፤ እርሱም። ኤልሳዕ ምን አለህ? አለው።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, Hazaël prit une couverture, qu''il plongea dans l''eau, et il l''étendit sur le visage du roi, qui mourut. Et Hazaël régna à sa place.
verses.am: እርሱም። እንድትፈወስ ነገረኝ አለው። በነጋውም ለሐፍ ወስዶ በውኃ ነከረው በፊቱም ላይ ሸፈነው፥ ሞተም። አዛሄልም በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.en: And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being then king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Je hoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.
verses.fr: La cinquième année de Joram, fils d''Achab, roi d''Israël, Joram, fils de Josaphat, roi de Juda, régna.
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በአክዓብ ልጅ በኢዮራም በአምስተኛው ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮሣፍጥ ልጅ ኢዮራም ነገሠ።

verses.en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Il avait trente-deux ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna huit ans à Jérusalem.
verses.am: መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሠላሳ ሁለት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ስምንት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.fr: Il marcha dans la voie des rois d''Israël, comme avait fait la maison d''Achab, car il avait pour femme une fille d''Achab, et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የአክዓብንም ልጅ አግብቶ ነበርና የአክዓብ ቤት እንዳደረገ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ሄደ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።

verses.en: Yet the Lord would not destroy Judah for David his servant's sake, as he promised him to give him alway a light, and to his children.
verses.fr: Mais l''Eternel ne voulut point détruire Juda, à cause de David, son serviteur, selon la promesse qu''il lui avait faite de lui donner toujours une lampe parmi ses fils.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለእርሱና ለልጆቹ ለዘመኑ ሁሉ መብራት ይሰጠው ዘንድ ተስፋ እንደ ሰጠ፥ ስለ ባሪያው ስለ ዳዊት እግዚአብሔር ይሁዳን ያጠፋ ዘንድ አልወደደም።

verses.en: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
verses.fr: De son temps, Edom se révolta contre l''autorité de Juda, et se donna un roi.
verses.am: በእርሱም ዘመን ኤዶምያስ ለይሁዳ እንዳይገብር ሸፈተ፥ በላያቸውም ንጉሥ አነገሡ።

verses.en: So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.
verses.fr: Joram passa à Tsaïr, avec tous ses chars; s''étant levé de nuit, il battit les Edomites, qui l''entouraient et les chefs des chars, et le peuple s''enfuit dans ses tentes.
verses.am: ኢዮራምም ከሰረገሎቹ ሁሉ ጋር ወደ ጸዒር አለፈ፤ በሌሊትም ተነሥቶ እርሱንና የሰረገሎቹን አለቆች ከብበው የነበሩትን የኤዶምያስን ሰዎች መታ፤ ሕዝቡ ግን ወደ ድንኳኑ ሸሸ።

verses.en: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
verses.fr: La rébellion d''Edom contre l''autorité de Juda a duré jusqu''à ce jour. Libna se révolta aussi dans le même temps.
verses.am: ኤዶምያስ ግን ለይሁዳ እንዳይገብር እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ሸፈተ። በዚያም ዘመን ደግሞ ልብና ሸፈተ።

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Joram, et tout ce qu''il a fait, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois de Juda?
verses.am: የተረፈውም የኢዮራም ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Joram se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré avec ses pères dans la ville de David. Et Achazia, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ኢዮራምም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ተቀበረ፤ በፋንታውም ልጁ አካዝያስ ነገሠ።

verses.en: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign.
verses.fr: La douzième année de Joram, fils d''Achab, roi d''Israël, Achazia, fils de Joram, roi de Juda, régna.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በአክዓብ ልጅ በኢዮራም በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮራም ልጅ አካዝያስ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Two and twenty years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Israel.
verses.fr: Achazia avait vingt-deux ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna un an à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Athalie, fille d''Omri, roi d''Israël.
verses.am: መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ አካዝያስ የሀያ ሁለት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ። እናቱም ጎቶልያ የተባለች የእስራኤል ንጉሥ የዘንበሪ ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.en: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the Lord, as did the house of Ahab: for he was the son in law of the house of Ahab.
verses.fr: Il marcha dans la voie de la maison d''Achab, et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, comme la maison d''Achab, car il était allié par mariage à la maison d''Achab.
verses.am: በአክዓብም ቤት መንገድ ሄደ፥ እንደ አክዓብም ቤት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፤ ለአክዓብ ቤት አማች ነበረና።

verses.en: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramothgilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.
verses.fr: Il alla avec Joram, fils d''Achab, à la guerre contre Hazaël, roi de Syrie, à Ramoth en Galaad. Et les Syriens blessèrent Joram.
verses.am: ከአክዓብም ልጅ ከኢዮራም ጋር የሶርያን ንጉሥ አዛሄልን በሬማት ዘገለዓድ ሊጋጠም ሄደ፤ ሶርያውንም ኢዮራምን አቆሰሉት።

verses.en: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
verses.fr: Le roi Joram s''en retourna pour se faire guérir à Jizreel des blessures que les Syriens lui avaient faites à Rama, lorsqu''il se battait contre Hazaël, roi de Syrie. Achazia, fils de Joram, roi de Juda, descendit pour voir Joram, fils d''Achab, à Jizreel, parce qu''il était malade.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ኢዮራም ከሶርያ ንጉሥ ከአዛሄል ጋር በተዋጋ ጊዜ ሶርያውያን በሬማት ያቈሰሉትን ቍስል ይታከም ዘንድ ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ተመለሰ። የአክዓብም ልጅ ኢዮራም ታምሞ ነበርና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮራም ልጅ አካዝያስ ሊያየው ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ወረደ።

verses.en: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up thy loins, and take this box of oil in thine hand, and go to Ramothgilead:
verses.fr: Elisée, le prophète, appela l''un des fils des prophètes, et lui dit: Ceins tes reins, prends avec toi cette fiole d''huile, et va à Ramoth en Galaad.
verses.am: ነቢዩም ኤልሳዕ ከነቢያት ልጆች አንዱን ጠርቶ እንዲህ አለው። ወገብህን ታጥቀህ ይህን የዘይት ማሰሮ በእጅህ ያዝ፥ ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድም ሂድ።

verses.en: And when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;
verses.fr: Quand tu y seras arrivé, vois Jéhu, fils de Josaphat, fils de Nimschi. Tu iras le faire lever du milieu de ses frères, et tu le conduiras dans une chambre retirée.
verses.am: በዚያም በደረስህ ጊዜ የናሜሲን ልጅ የኢዮሣፍጥን ልጅ ኢዩን ታገኘዋለህ፤ ገብተህም ከወንድሞቹ መካከል አስነሣው፥ ወደ ጓዳም አግባው።

verses.en: Then take the box of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, Thus saith the Lord, I have anointed thee king over Israel. Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.
verses.fr: Tu prendras la fiole d''huile, que tu répandras sur sa tête, et tu diras: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Je t''oins roi d''Israël! Puis tu ouvriras la porte, et tu t''enfuiras sans t''arrêter.
verses.am: የዘይቱንም ማሰሮ ይዘህ በራሱ ላይ አፍስሰውና። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ ትሆን ዘንድ ቀባሁህ በለው፤ በሩንም ከፍተህ ሽሽ፥ አትዘግይም።

verses.en: So the young man, even the young man the prophet, went to Ramothgilead.
verses.fr: Le jeune homme, serviteur du prophète, partit pour Ramoth en Galaad.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ጕልማሳው ነቢይ ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ሄደ።

verses.en: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to thee, O captain. And Jehu said, Unto which of all us? And he said, To thee, O captain.
verses.fr: Quand il arriva, voici, les chefs de l''armée étaient assis. Il dit: Chef, j''ai un mot à te dire. Et Jéhu dit: Auquel de nous tous? Il répondit: A toi, chef.
verses.am: በገባም ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ የሠራዊት አለቆች ተቀምጠው ነበር፤ እርሱም። አለቃ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ነገር አለኝ አለ። ኢዩም። ከማንኛችን ጋር ነው? አለ። እርሱም። አለቃ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ነው አለ።

verses.en: And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, I have anointed thee king over the people of the Lord, even over Israel.
verses.fr: Jéhu se leva et entra dans la maison, et le jeune homme répandit l''huile sur sa tête, en lui disant: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: Je t''oins roi d''Israël, du peuple de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ተነሥቶም ወደ ቤቱ ገባ፤ ዘይቱንም በራሱ ላይ አፍስሶ እንዲህ አለው። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ ትሆን ዘንድ ቀባሁህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the Lord, at the hand of Jezebel.
verses.fr: Tu frapperas la maison d''Achab, ton maître, et je vengerai sur Jézabel le sang de mes serviteurs les prophètes et le sang de tous les serviteurs de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የባሪያዎቼን የነቢያትን ደም፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ባሪያዎች ሁሉ ደም ከኤልዛቤል እጅ እበቀል ዘንድ የጌታህን የአክዓብን ቤት ትመታለህ።

verses.en: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:
verses.fr: Toute la maison d''Achab périra; j''exterminerai quiconque appartient à Achab, celui qui est esclave et celui qui est libre en Israël,
verses.am: የአክዓብም ቤት ሁሉ ይጠፋል፤ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ የታሰረውንና የተለቀቀውን ወንድ ሁሉ ከአክዓብ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:
verses.fr: et je rendrai la maison d''Achab semblable à la maison de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, et à la maison de Baescha, fils d''Achija.
verses.am: የአክዓብንም ቤት እንደ ናባጥ ልጅ እንደ ኢዮርብዓም ቤት፥ እንደ አኪያም ልጅ እንደ ባኦስ ቤት አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her. And he opened the door, and fled.
verses.fr: Les chiens mangeront Jézabel dans le champ de Jizreel, et il n''y aura personne pour l''enterrer. Puis le jeune homme ouvrit la porte, et s''enfuit.
verses.am: ኤልዛቤልንም በኢይዝራኤል እርሻ ውሾች ይበሉአታል፥ የሚቀብራትም አታገኝም። በሩንም ከፍቶ ሸሸ።

verses.en: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said unto him, Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to thee? And he said unto them, Ye know the man, and his communication.
verses.fr: Lorsque Jéhu sortit pour rejoindre les serviteurs de son maître, on lui dit: Tout va-t-il bien? Pourquoi ce fou est-il venu vers toi? Jéhu leur répondit: Vous connaissez bien l''homme et ce qu''il peut dire.
verses.am: ኢዩም ወደ ጌታው ባሪያዎች ወጣ፤ እነርሱም። ደኅና ነውን? ይህ እብድ ለምን መጣብህ? አሉት። እርሱም። ሰውዮውንና ነገሩን ታውቃላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they said, It is false; tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus saith the Lord, I have anointed thee king over Israel.
verses.fr: Mais ils répliquèrent: Mensonge! Réponds-nous donc! Et il dit: Il m''a parlé de telle et telle manière, disant: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Je t''oins roi d''Israël.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ሐሰት ነው፤ ንገረን አሉት፤ እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ ትሆን ዘንድ ቀባሁህ ብሎ እንዲህ እንዲህ ነገረኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.
verses.fr: Aussitôt ils prirent chacun leurs vêtements, qu''ils mirent sous Jéhu au haut des degrés; ils sonnèrent de la trompette, et dirent: Jéhu est roi!
verses.am: ሁሉም ፈጥነው ልብሳቸውን ወሰዱ፥ በሰገነቱ መሰላል እርከን ላይ ከእግሩ በታች አነጠፉት፥ ቀንደ መለከትም እየነፉ፥ ኢዩ ነግሦአል አሉ።

verses.en: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramothgilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.
verses.fr: Ainsi Jéhu, fils de Josaphat, fils de Nimschi, forma une conspiration contre Joram. -Or Joram et tout Israël défendaient Ramoth en Galaad contre Hazaël, roi de Syrie;
verses.am: እንዲሁም የናሜሲ ልጅ የኢዮሣፍጥ ልጅ ኢዩ በኢዮራም ላይ ተማማለ። ኢዮራምና የእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ከሶርያ ንጉሥ ከአዛሄል የተነሣ ሬማት ዘገለዓድን ይጠብቁ ነበር።

verses.en: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds, then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.
verses.fr: mais le roi Joram s''en était retourné pour se faire guérir à Jizreel des blessures que les Syriens lui avaient faites, lorsqu''il se battait contre Hazaël, roi de Syrie. -Jéhu dit: Si c''est votre volonté, personne ne s''échappera de la ville pour aller porter la nouvelle à Jizreel.
verses.am: ንጉሡ ኢዮራም ግን ከሶርያ ንጉሥ ከአዛሄል ጋር በተዋጋ ጊዜ ሶርያውያን ያቈሰሉትን ቍስል ይታከም ዘንድ ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ተመልሶ ነበር። ኢዩም። ልባችሁስ ከእኔ ጋር ከሆነ በኢይዝራኤል እንዳያወራ ማንም ከከተማ ኰብልሎ አይውጣ አለ።

verses.en: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram.
verses.fr: Et Jéhu monta sur son char et partit pour Jizreel, car Joram y était alité, et Achazia, roi de Juda, était descendu pour le visiter.
verses.am: ኢዮራምም በዚያ ታምሞ ተኝቶ ነበርና ኢዩ በሰረገላው ላይ ተቀምጦ ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ሄደ። የይሁዳም ንጉሥ አካዝያስ ኢዮራምን ለማየት ወርዶ ነበር።

verses.en: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?
verses.fr: La sentinelle placée sur la tour de Jizreel vit venir la troupe de Jéhu, et dit: Je vois une troupe. Joram dit: Prends un cavalier, et envoie-le au-devant d''eux pour demander si c''est la paix.
verses.am: በኢይዝራኤልም ግንብ ላይ የቆመው ሰላይ የኢዩ ጭፍራ ሲመታ አይቶ። ጭፍራ አያለሁ አለ። ኢዮራምም። የሚገናኘው ፈረሰኛ ላክ፥ እርሱም። ሰላም ነውን? ይበለው አለ።

verses.en: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he cometh not again.
verses.fr: Le cavalier alla au-devant de Jéhu, et dit: Ainsi parle le roi: Est-ce la paix? Et Jéhu répondit: Que t''importe la paix? Passe derrière moi. La sentinelle en donna avis, et dit: Le messager est allé jusqu''à eux, et il ne revient pas.
verses.am: ፈረሰኛውም ሊገናኘው ሄዶ። ንጉሡ እንዲህ ይላል። ሰላም ነውን? አለ። ኢዩም። አንተ ከሰላም ጋር ምን አለህ? ወደ ኋላዬ አልፈህ ተከተለኝ አለ። ሰላዩም። መልእክተኛው ደረሰባቸው፥ ነገር ግን አልተመለሰም ብሎ ነገረው።

verses.en: Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.
verses.fr: Joram envoya un second cavalier, qui arriva vers eux et dit: Ainsi parle le roi: Est-ce la paix? Et Jéhu répondit: Que t''importe la paix? Passe derrière moi.
verses.am: ሁለተኛም ፈረሰኛ ሰደደ፥ ወደ እነርሱም ደርሶ። ንጉሡ እንዲህ ይላል። ሰላም ነውን?አለ። ኢዩም። አንተ ከሰላም ጋር ምን አለህ? ወደ ኋላዬ አልፈህ ተከተለኝ አለ።

verses.en: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.
verses.fr: La sentinelle en donna avis, et dit: Il est allé jusqu''à eux, et il ne revient pas. Et le train est comme celui de Jéhu, fils de Nimschi, car il conduit d''une manière insensée.
verses.am: ሰላዩም። ደረሰባቸው፥ ነገር ግን አልተመለሰም፤ በችኰላ ይሄዳልና አካሄዱ እንደ ናሜሲ ልጅ እንደ ኢዩ አካሄድ ነው ብሎ ነገረው።

verses.en: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.
verses.fr: Alors Joram dit: Attelle! Et on attela son char. Joram, roi d''Israël, et Achazia, roi de Juda, sortirent chacun dans son char pour aller au-devant de Jéhu, et ils le rencontrèrent dans le champ de Naboth de Jizreel.
verses.am: ኢዮራምም። ሰረገላ አዘጋጁ አለ፤ ሰረገላውንም አዘጋጁለት። የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮራም የይሁዳም ንጉሥ አካዝያስ በሰረገሎቻቸው ተቀምጠው ወጡ፥ ኢዩንም ሊገናኙት ሄዱ፤ በኢይዝራኤላዊው በናቡቴ እርሻ ውስጥ አገኙት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?
verses.fr: Dès que Joram vit Jéhu, il dit: Est-ce la paix, Jéhu? Jéhu répondit: Quoi, la paix! tant que durent les prostitutions de Jézabel, ta mère, et la multitude de ses sortilèges!
verses.am: ኢዮራምም ኢዩን ባየ ጊዜ። ኢዩ ሆይ፥ ሰላም ነውን? አለ። እርሱም። የእናትህ የኤልዛቤል ግልሙትናዋና መተትዋ ሲበዛ ምን ሰላም አለ? ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.en: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.
verses.fr: Joram tourna bride et s''enfuit, et il dit à Achazia: Trahison, Achazia!
verses.am: ኢዮራምም መልሶ ነዳና ሸሸ፥ አካዝያስንም። አካዝያስ ሆይ፥ ዓመፅ ነው አለው።

verses.en: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.
verses.fr: Mais Jéhu saisit son arc, et il frappa Joram entre les épaules: la flèche sortit par le coeur, et Joram s''affaissa dans son char.
verses.am: ኢዩም በእጁ ቀስቱን ለጠጠ፥ ኢዮራምንም በጫንቃው መካከል ወጋው፤ ፍላጻውም በልቡ አለፈ፥ ወደ ሰረገላውም ውስጥ ወደቀ።

verses.en: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the Lord laid this burden upon him;
verses.fr: Jéhu dit à son officier Bidkar: Prends-le, et jette-le dans le champ de Naboth de Jizreel; car souviens-t''en, lorsque moi et toi, nous étions ensemble à cheval derrière Achab, son père, l''Eternel prononça contre lui cette sentence:
verses.am: ኢዩም አለቃውን ቢድቃርን እንዲህ አለው። አንሥተህ በኢይዝራኤላዊው በናቡቴ እርሻ ጣለው፥ አንተና እኔ ጎን ለጎን በፈረስ ተቀምጠን አባቱን አክዓብን በተከተልን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ይህን መከራ እንደ ተናገረበት አስብ።

verses.en: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the Lord; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the Lord. Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.fr: J''ai vu hier le sang de Naboth et le sang de ses fils, dit l''Eternel, et je te rendrai la pareille dans ce champ même, dit l''Eternel! Prends-le donc, et jette-le dans le champ, selon la parole de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በእውነት የናቡቴንና የልጆቹን ደም ትናንትና አይቻለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ በዚህም እርሻ እመልስብሃለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር። ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረው ቃል ወስደህ በእርሻው ውስጥ ጣለው።

verses.en: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot. And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.
verses.fr: Achazia, roi de Juda, ayant vu cela, s''enfuit par le chemin de la maison du jardin. Jéhu le poursuivit, et dit: Lui aussi, frappez-le sur le char! Et on le frappa à la montée de Gur, près de Jibleam. Il se réfugia à Meguiddo, et il y mourut.
verses.am: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ አካዝያስ ያንን ባየ ጊዜ በአትክልት ቤት መንገድ ሸሸ። ኢዩም። ይህን ደግሞ በሰረገላው ላይ ውጉት እያለ ተከተለው፤ በይብለዓምም አቅራቢያ ባለችው በጉር ዐቀበት ላይ ወጉት። ወደ መጊዶም ሸሸ፥ በዚያም ሞተ።

verses.en: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.
verses.fr: Ses serviteurs le transportèrent sur un char à Jérusalem, et ils l''enterrèrent dans son sépulcre avec ses pères, dans la ville de David.
verses.am: ባሪያዎቹም በሰረገላው ጭነው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወሰዱት፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ በመቃብሩ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ቀበሩት።

verses.en: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.
verses.fr: Achazia était devenu roi de Juda la onzième année de Joram, fils d''Achab.
verses.am: በአክዓብም ልጅ በኢዮራም በአሥራ አንደኛው ዓመት አካዝያስ በይሁዳ ላይ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.
verses.fr: Jéhu entra dans Jizreel. Jézabel, l''ayant appris, mit du fard à ses yeux, se para la tête, et regarda par la fenêtre.
verses.am: ኢዩም ወደ ኢይዝራኤል መጣ፤ ኤልዛቤልም በሰማች ጊዜ ዓይንዋን ተኳለች፥ ራስዋንም አስጌጠች፥ በመስኮትም ዘልቃ ትመለከት ነበር።

verses.en: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?
verses.fr: Comme Jéhu franchissait la porte, elle dit: Est-ce la paix, nouveau Zimri, assassin de son maître?
verses.am: ኢዩም በበሩ ሲገባ። ጌታውን የገደለ ዘምሪ ሆይ፥ ሰላም ነውን? አለችው።

verses.en: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.
verses.fr: Il leva le visage vers la fenêtre, et dit: Qui est pour moi? qui? Et deux ou trois eunuques le regardèrent en s''approchant de la fenêtre.
verses.am: ፊቱንም ወደ መስኮቱ አንሥቶ። ከእኔ ጋር ማን ነው? አለ። ሁለት ሦስትም ጃንደረቦች ወደ እርሱ ተመለከቱ።

verses.en: And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.
verses.fr: Il dit: Jetez-la en bas! Ils la jetèrent, et il rejaillit de son sang sur la muraille et sur les chevaux. Jéhu la foula aux pieds;
verses.am: እርሱም። ወደ ታች ወርውሩአት አለ፤ ወረወሩአትም፥ ደምዋም በግንቡና በፈረሶቹ ላይ ተረጨ፥ ረገጡአትም።

verses.en: And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed woman, and bury her: for she is a king's daughter.
verses.fr: puis il entra, mangea et but, et il dit: Allez voir cette maudite, et enterrez-la, car elle est fille de roi.
verses.am: በገባም ጊዜ በላ ጠጣም፤ ከዚያም በኋላ። ይህችን የተረገመች እዩ፤ የንጉሥ ልጅ ናትና ቅበሩአት አለ።

verses.en: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.
verses.fr: Ils allèrent pour l''enterrer; mais ils ne trouvèrent d''elle que le crâne, les pieds et les paumes des mains.
verses.am: ሊቀብሩአትም በሄዱ ጊዜ ከአናትዋና ከእግርዋ ከመዳፍም በቀር ምንም አላገኙም።

verses.en: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of the Lord, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:
verses.fr: Ils retournèrent l''annoncer à Jéhu, qui dit: C''est ce qu''avait déclaré l''Eternel par son serviteur Elie, le Thischbite, en disant: Les chiens mangeront la chair de Jézabel dans le champ de Jizreel;
verses.am: ተመልሰውም ነገሩት፤ እርሱም። በባሪያው በቴስብያዊ ኤልያስ። በኢይዝራኤል እርሻ የኤልዛቤልን ሥጋ ውሾች ይበላሉ፤

verses.en: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.
verses.fr: et le cadavre de Jézabel sera comme du fumier sur la face des champs, dans le champ de Jizreel, de sorte qu''on ne pourra dire: C''est Jézabel.
verses.am: የኤልዛቤልም ሬሳ በኢይዝራኤል እርሻ መሬት ላይ እንደ ፍግ ይሆናልና ማንም። ይህች ኤልዛቤል ናት ይል ዘንድ አይችልም ብሎ የተናገረው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው አለ።

verses.en: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab's children, saying,
verses.fr: Il y avait dans Samarie soixante-dix fils d''Achab. Jéhu écrivit des lettres qu''il envoya à Samarie aux chefs de Jizreel, aux anciens, et aux gouverneurs des enfants d''Achab. Il y était dit:
verses.am: ለአክዓብም በሰማርያ ሰባ ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ኢዩም ደብዳቤ ጻፈ፤ የአክዓብን ልጆች ለሚያሳድጉ ለሰማርያ ታላላቆችና ሽማግሌዎች።

verses.en: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master's sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;
verses.fr: Maintenant, quand cette lettre vous sera parvenue, -puisque vous avez avec vous les fils de votre maître, avec vous les chars et les chevaux, une ville forte et les armes, -
verses.am: ይህ ደብዳቤ አሁን በደረሳችሁ ጊዜ የጌታችሁ ልጆች ሰረገሎችና ፈረሶችም የተመሸገችም ከተማ መሣሪያዎችም በእናንተ ዘንድ አሉና፥

verses.en: Look even out the best and meetest of your master's sons, and set him on his father's throne, and fight for your master's house.
verses.fr: voyez lequel des fils de votre maître est le meilleur et convient le mieux, mettez-le sur le trône de son père, et combattez pour la maison de votre maître!
verses.am: ከጌታችሁ ልጆች ደስ የሚያሰኛችሁንና የሚሻላችሁን ምረጡ፥ በአባቱም ዙፋን አስቀምጡት፥ ስለ ጌታችሁም ቤት ተዋጉ ብሎ ወደ ሰማርያ ሰደደ፤

verses.en: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?
verses.fr: Ils eurent une très grande peur, et ils dirent: Voici, deux rois n''ont pu lui résister; comment résisterions-nous?
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን እጅግ ፈርተው። እነሆ፥ ሁለቱ ነገሥታት በፊቱ ይቆሙ ዘንድ አልቻሉም፤ እኛስ እንዴት እንቆማለን? አሉ።

verses.en: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up of the children, sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou that which is good in thine eyes.
verses.fr: Et le chef de la maison, le chef de la ville, les anciens, et les gouverneurs des enfants, envoyèrent dire à Jéhu: Nous sommes tes serviteurs, et nous ferons tout ce que tu nous diras; nous n''établirons personne roi, fais ce qui te semble bon.
verses.am: የቤቱ አለቃ፥ የከተማይቱም አለቃ፥ ሽማግሌዎችና ልጆቹን የሚያሳድጉ። እኛ ባሪያዎችህ ነን፥ ያዘዝኸንም ሁሉ እናደርጋለን፤ ንጉሥም በላያችን አናነግሥም፤ የምትወድደውን አድርግ ብለው ወደ ኢዩ ላኩ።

verses.en: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye be mine, and if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master's sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king's sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.
verses.fr: Jéhu leur écrivit une seconde lettre où il était dit: Si vous êtes à moi et si vous obéissez à ma voix, prenez les têtes de ces hommes, fils de votre maître, et venez auprès de moi demain à cette heure, à Jizreel. Or les soixante-dix fils du roi étaient chez les grands de la ville, qui les élevaient.
verses.am: ሁለተኛም። ወገኖቼስ እንደ ሆናችሁ፥ ነገሬንም ከሰማችሁ፥ የጌታችሁን ልጆች ራስ ቍረጡ፥ ነገም በዚህ ሰዓት ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ወደ እኔ ይዛችሁ ኑ ብሎ ደብዳቤ ጻፈላቸው። የንጉሡም ልጆች ሰባው ሰዎች በሚያሳድጓቸው በከተማይቱ ታላላቆች ዘንድ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king's sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him them to Jezreel.
verses.fr: Quand la lettre leur fut parvenue, ils prirent les fils du roi, et ils égorgèrent ces soixante-dix hommes; puis ils mirent leurs têtes dans des corbeilles, et les envoyèrent à Jéhu, à Jizreel.
verses.am: ደብዳቤውም በደረሳቸው ጊዜ የንጉሡን ልጆች ሰባውን ሰዎች ይዘው ገደሉአቸው፤ ራሳቸውንም በቅርጫት አድርገው ወደ እርሱ ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ላኩ።

verses.en: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king's sons. And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.
verses.fr: Le messager vint l''en informer, en disant: Ils ont apporté les têtes des fils du roi. Et il dit: Mettez-les en deux tas à l''entrée de la porte, jusqu''au matin.
verses.am: መልእክተኛም መጥቶ። የንጉሡን ልጆች ራስ ይዘው መጥተዋል ብሎ ነገረው። እርሱም። እስከ ነገ ድረስ በበሩ አደባባይ ሁለት ክምር አድርጋችሁ አኑሩአቸው አለ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?
verses.fr: Le matin, il sortit; et se présentant à tout le peuple, il dit: Vous êtes justes! voici, moi, j''ai conspiré contre mon maître et je l''ai tué; mais qui a frappé tous ceux-ci?
verses.am: በነጋውም ወጥቶ ቆመ፥ ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ። እናንተ ንጹሐን ናችሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ጌታዬን የወነጀልሁ የገደልሁትም እኔ ነኝ፤ እነዚህንስ ሁሉ የገደለ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the Lord, which the Lord spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the Lord hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah.
verses.fr: Sachez donc qu''il ne tombera rien à terre de la parole de l''Eternel, de la parole que l''Eternel a prononcée contre la maison d''Achab; l''Eternel accomplit ce qu''il a déclaré par son serviteur Elie.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአክዓብ ቤት ላይ ከተናገረው ከእግዚአብሔር ቃል በምድር ላይ አንዳች እንዳይወድቅ አሁን እወቁ፤ እግዚአብሔር በባሪያው በኤልያስ የተናገረውን አድርጎአል አላቸው።

verses.en: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.
verses.fr: Et Jéhu frappa tous ceux qui restaient de la maison d''Achab à Jizreel, tous ses grands, ses familiers et ses ministres, sans en laisser échapper un seul.
verses.am: ኢዩም ከአክዓብ ቤት የቀረውን ሁሉ፥ ታላላቆቹንም ሁሉ፥ ወዳጆቹንና ካህናቱን ማንም ሳይቀር በኢይዝራኤል ገደላቸው።

verses.en: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shearing house in the way,
verses.fr: Puis il se leva, et partit pour aller à Samarie. Arrivé à une maison de réunion des bergers, sur le chemin,
verses.am: ተነሥቶም ወደ ሰማርያ ሄደ፤ በመንገድም ወዳለው ወደ በግ ጠባቂዎች ቤት በደረሰ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who are ye? And they answered, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.
verses.fr: Jéhu trouva les frères d''Achazia, roi de Juda, et il dit: Qui êtes-vous? Ils répondirent: Nous sommes les frères d''Achazia, et nous descendons pour saluer les fils du roi et les fils de la reine.
verses.am: ኢዩ ከይሁዳ ንጉሥ ከአካዝያስ ወንድሞች ጋር ተገናኝቶ። እናንተ እነማን ናችሁ? አለ። እነርሱም። እኛ የአካዝያስ ወንድሞች ነን፤ የንጉሡንና የእቴጌይቱን ልጆች ደኅንነት ለመጠየቅ እንወርዳለን አሉት።

verses.en: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.
verses.fr: Jéhu dit: Saisissez-les vivants. Et ils les saisirent vivants, et les égorgèrent au nombre de quarante-deux, à la citerne de la maison de réunion; Jéhu n''en laissa échapper aucun.
verses.am: እርሱም። በሕይወታቸው ያዙአቸው አለ። ያዙአቸውም፥ በበግ ጠባቂዎችም ቤት አጠገብ ባለው ጕድጓድ አርባ ሁለቱን ሰዎች ገደሉአቸው፤ ማንንም አላስቀረም።

verses.en: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me thine hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.
verses.fr: Etant parti de là, il rencontra Jonadab, fils de Récab, qui venait au-devant de lui. Il le salua, et lui dit: Ton coeur est-il sincère, comme mon coeur l''est envers le tien? Et Jonadab répondit: Il l''est. S''il l''est, répliqua Jéhu, donne-moi ta main. Jonadab lui donna la main. Et Jéhu le fit monter auprès de lui dans son char,
verses.am: ከዚያም በሄደ ጊዜ የሬካብን ልጅ ኢዮናዳብን ተገናኘው፤ ደኅንነቱንም ጠይቆ። ልቤ ከልብህ ጋር እንደ ሆነ ያህል ልብህ ከልቤ ጋር በቅንነት ነውን? አለው፤ ኢዮናዳብም። እንዲሁ ነው አለው። ኢዩም። እንዲሁ እንደ ሆነስ እጅህን ስጠኝ አለ። እጁንም ሰጠው፤ ወደ ሰረገላውም አውጥቶ ከእርሱ ጋር አስቀመጠውና።

verses.en: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the Lord. So they made him ride in his chariot.
verses.fr: et dit: Viens avec moi, et tu verras mon zèle pour l''Eternel. Il l''emmena ainsi dans son char.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር ና፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም መቅናቴን እይ አለው። በሰረገላውም አስቀመጠው።

verses.en: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the Lord, which he spake to Elijah.
verses.fr: Lorsque Jéhu fut arrivé à Samarie, il frappa tous ceux qui restaient d''Achab à Samarie, et il les détruisit entièrement, selon la parole que l''Eternel avait dite à Elie.
verses.am: ወደ ሰማሪያም በመጣ ጊዜ ለኤልያስ እንደ ተናገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል እስኪያጠፋው ድረስ ከአክዓብ በሰማርያ የቀረውን ሁሉ ገደለ።

verses.en: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu shall serve him much.
verses.fr: Puis il assembla tout le peuple, et leur dit: Achab a peu servi Baal, Jéhu le servira beaucoup.
verses.am: ኢዩም ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ሰብስቦ። አክዓብ በኣልን በጥቂቱ አመለከው፤ ኢዩ ግን በብዙ ያመልከዋል።

verses.en: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live. But Jehu did it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.
verses.fr: Maintenant convoquez auprès de moi tous les prophètes de Baal, tous ses serviteurs et tous ses prêtres, sans qu''il en manque un seul, car je veux offrir un grand sacrifice à Baal: quiconque manquera ne vivra pas. Jéhu agissait avec ruse, pour faire périr les serviteurs de Baal.
verses.am: አሁንም የባኣልን ነቢያት ሁሉ፥ አገልጋዮቹንም ሁሉ፥ ካህናቱንም ሁሉ ወደ እኔ ጥሩ፤ ማንም አይቅር፤ ለባኣል ታላቅ መሥዋዕት አቀርባለሁ፥ የቀረውም ሁሉ በሕይወት አይኖርም አላቸው። ኢዩም የበኣልን አገልጋዮች ያጠፋ ዘንድ በተንኰል ይህን አደረገ።

verses.en: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it.
verses.fr: Il dit: Publiez une fête en l''honneur de Baal. Et ils la publièrent.
verses.am: ኢዩም። ለበኣል ዋና ጉባኤ ቀድሱ አለ።

verses.en: And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.
verses.fr: Il envoya des messagers dans tout Israël; et tous les serviteurs de Baal arrivèrent, il n''y en eut pas un qui ne vînt; ils entrèrent dans la maison de Baal, et la maison de Baal fut remplie d''un bout à l''autre.
verses.am: እነርሱም አወጁ። ኢዩም ወደ እስራኤል ሁሉ ላከ፥ የበኣልም አገልጋዮች ሁሉ መጡ፤ ሳይመጣ የቀረ አንድ ስንኳ አልነበረም። ወደ በኣልም ቤት ገቡ፥ የበኣልም ቤት ከዳር እስከ ዳር ድረስ ሞልቶ ነበር፤

verses.en: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.
verses.fr: Jéhu dit à celui qui avait la garde du vestiaire: Sors des vêtements pour tous les serviteurs de Baal. Et cet homme sortit des vêtements pour eux.
verses.am: ዕቃ ቤቱንም። ለበኣል አገልጋዮች ሁሉ ልብስ አውጣ አለው።

verses.en: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the Lord, but the worshippers of Baal only.
verses.fr: Alors Jéhu vint à la maison de Baal avec Jonadab, fils de Récab, et il dit aux serviteurs de Baal: Cherchez et regardez, afin qu''il n''y ait pas ici des serviteurs de l''Eternel, mais qu''il y ait seulement des serviteurs de Baal.
verses.am: ልብሱንም አወጣላቸው። ኢዩም የሬካብም ልጅ ኢዮናዳብ ወደ በኣል ቤት ገቡ። የበኣልንም አገልጋዮች። መርምሩ፥ ከበኣል አገልጋዮች ብቻ በቀር እግዚአብሔርን ከሚያመልኩ ወገን በእናንተ ዘንድ አንድ እንኳ እንዳይኖር ተመልከቱ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, he that letteth him go, his life shall be for the life of him.
verses.fr: Et ils entrèrent pour offrir des sacrifices et des holocaustes. Jéhu avait placé dehors quatre-vingts hommes, en leur disant: Celui qui laissera échapper quelqu''un des hommes que je remets entre vos mains, sa vie répondra de la sienne.
verses.am: የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ሌላ መሥዋዕትም ያቀረቡ ዘንድ ገቡ፤ ኢዩም። በእጃችሁ አሳልፌ ከምሰጣችሁ ሰዎች አንድ ሰው ያመለጠ እንደ ሆነ ነፍሱ በዚያ ነፍስ ፋንታ ትሆናለች ብሎ በውጪ ሰማንያ ሰዎችን አዘጋጅቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in, and slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''on eut achevé d''offrir les holocaustes, Jéhu dit aux coureurs et aux officiers: Entrez, frappez-les, que pas un ne sorte. Et ils les frappèrent du tranchant de l''épée. Les coureurs et les officiers les jetèrent là, et ils allèrent jusqu''à la ville de la maison de Baal.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት አቅርበው በፈጸሙ ጊዜ ኢዩ ዘበኞቹንና አለቆቹን። ግቡና ግደሉአቸው፤ አንድም አይውጣ አላቸው። በሰይፍም ስለት ገደሉአቸው፤ ዘበኞችና አለቆችም ወደ ውጭ ጣሉአቸው፥ ወደ በኣልም ቤት ከተማ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.
verses.fr: Ils tirèrent dehors les statues de la maison de Baal, et les brûlèrent.
verses.am: ከበኣልም ቤት ሐውልቶቹን አወጡ አቃጠሉአቸውም።

verses.en: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.
verses.fr: Ils renversèrent la statue de Baal, ils renversèrent aussi la maison de Baal, et ils en firent un cloaque, qui a subsisté jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: የበኣልን ሐውልት ቀጠቀጡ፥ የበኣልንም ቤት አፈረሱ፥ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ የውዳቂ መጣያ አደረጉት።

verses.en: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.
verses.fr: Jéhu extermina Baal du milieu d''Israël;
verses.am: እንዲሁም ኢዩ በኣልን ከእስራኤል አጠፋ።

verses.en: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden calves that were in Bethel, and that were in Dan.
verses.fr: mais il ne se détourna point des péchés de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, qui avait fait pécher Israël, il n''abandonna point les veaux d''or qui étaient à Béthel et à Dan.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እስራኤልን ካሳተው ከናባጥ ልጅ ከኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት፥ በቤቴልና በዳን ከነበሩት ከወርቁ እምቦሶች፥ ኢዩ አልራቀም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes, and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Jéhu: Parce que tu as bien exécuté ce qui était droit à mes yeux, et que tu as fait à la maison d''Achab tout ce qui était conforme à ma volonté, tes fils jusqu''à la quatrième génération seront assis sur le trône d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ኢዩን። በፊቴ ቅን ነገር አድርገሃልና፥ በልቤም ያለውን ሁሉ በአክዓብ ቤት ላይ አድርገሃልና ልጆችህ እስከ አራት ትውልድ ድረስ በእስራኤል ዙፋን ላይ ይቀመጣሉ አለው።

verses.en: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the Lord God of Israel with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Israel to sin.
verses.fr: Toutefois Jéhu ne prit point garde à marcher de tout son coeur dans la loi de l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël; il ne se détourna point des péchés que Jéroboam avait fait commettre à Israël.
verses.am: ኢዩ ግን በእስራኤል አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር ሕግ በፍጹም ልቡ ይሄድ ዘንድ አልተጠነቀቀም፤ እስራኤልንም ካሳተው ከኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት አልራቀም።

verses.en: In those days the Lord began to cut Israel short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel;
verses.fr: Dans ce temps-là, l''Eternel commença à entamer le territoire d''Israël; et Hazaël les battit sur toute la frontière d''Israël.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት እግዚአብሔር እስራኤልን ይከፋፍላቸው ዘንድ ጀመረ፤ አዛሄልም በእስራኤል ዳርቻ ሁሉ መታቸው።

verses.en: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.
verses.fr: Depuis le Jourdain, vers le soleil levant, il battit tout le pays de Galaad, les Gadites, les Rubénites et les Manassites, depuis Aroër sur le torrent de l''Arnon jusqu''à Galaad et à Basan.
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስ ምሥራቅ ያለውን የገለዓድን አገር ሁሉ፥ በአርኖን ወንዝ አጠገብ ካለችው ከአሮዔር ጀምሮ የጋድንና የሮቤልን የምናሴንም አገር፥ ገለዓድንና ባሳንን መታ።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Jéhu, tout ce qu''il a fait, et tous ses exploits, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël?
verses.am: የቀረውም የኢዩ ነገር፥ የሠራውም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ ጭከናውም ሁሉ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Jéhu se coucha avec ses pères, et on l''enterra à Samarie. Et Joachaz, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ኢዩም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በሰማርያም ቀበሩት። በፋንታውም ልጁ ኢዮአካዝ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years.
verses.fr: Jéhu avait régné vingt-huit ans sur Israël à Samarie.
verses.am: ኢዩም በሰማርያ በእስራኤል ላይ የነገሠበት ዘመን ሀያ ስምንት ዓመት ነበረ።

verses.en: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.
verses.fr: Athalie, mère d''Achazia, voyant que son fils était mort, se leva et fit périr toute la race royale.
verses.am: የአካዝያስም እናት ጎቶልያ ልጅዋ እንደ ሞተ ባየች ጊዜ ተነሥታ የመንግሥትን ዘር ሁሉ አጠፋች።

verses.en: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons which were slain; and they hid him, even him and his nurse, in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.
verses.fr: Mais Joschéba, fille du roi Joram, soeur d''Achazia, prit Joas, fils d''Achazia, et l''enleva du milieu des fils du roi, quand on les fit mourir: elle le mit avec sa nourrice dans la chambre des lits. Il fut ainsi dérobé aux regards d''Athalie, et ne fut point mis à mort.
verses.am: የንጉሡ የኢዮራም ልጅ የአካዝያስ እኅት ዮሳቤት የአካዝያስን ልጅ ኢዮአስን ወስዳ ከተገደሉት ከንጉሥ ልጆች መካከል ሰረቀችው፤ እርሱንና ሞግዚቱንም ወደ እልፍኝ ወሰደች፥ እንዳይገደልም ከጎቶልያ ሸሸጉት።

verses.en: And he was with her hid in the house of the Lord six years. And Athaliah did reign over the land.
verses.fr: Il resta six ans caché avec Joschéba dans la maison de l''Eternel. Et c''était Athalie qui régnait dans le pays.
verses.am: በእርስዋም ዘንድ ተሸሸጎ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ስድስት ዓመት ያህል ተቀመጠ። ጎቶልያም በምድር ላይ ነገሠች።

verses.en: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of the Lord, and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of the Lord, and shewed them the king's son.
verses.fr: La septième année, Jehojada envoya chercher les chefs de centaines des Kéréthiens et des coureurs, et il les fit venir auprès de lui dans la maison de l''Eternel. Il traita alliance avec eux et les fit jurer dans la maison de l''Eternel, et il leur montra le fils du roi.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ዓመት ዮዳሄ ልኮ በካራውያንና በዘበኞች ላይ ያሉትን የመቶ አለቆች ወሰደ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት አገባቸው፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አማላቸው፥ የንጉሡንም ልጅ አሳያቸው።

verses.en: And he commanded them, saying, This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king's house;
verses.fr: Puis il leur donna ses ordres, en disant: Voici ce que vous ferez. Parmi ceux de vous qui entrent en service le jour du sabbat, un tiers doit monter la garde à la maison du roi,
verses.am: እንዲህም ብሎ አዘዛቸው። እንዲህ አድርጉ፤ በሰንበት ቀን ከምትገቡት ከእናንተ ከሦስት አንዱ እጅ የንጉሡን ቤት ዘብ ጠብቁ፤

verses.en: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.
verses.fr: un tiers à la porte de Sur, et un tiers à la porte derrière les coureurs: vous veillerez à la garde de la maison, de manière à en empêcher l''entrée.
verses.am: ከእናንተ ከሦስት አንዱ እጅ በሱር በር ሁኑ፤ አንዱም እጅ ከዘበኞች ቤት በኋላ ባለው በር ሁኑ፤ ቤቱንም ጠብቁ፥ ከልክሉም፤

verses.en: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the Lord about the king.
verses.fr: Vos deux autres divisions, tous ceux qui sortent de service le jour du sabbat feront la garde de la maison de l''Eternel auprès du roi:
verses.am: ከእናንተም በሰንበት ቀን የምትወጡት ሁለቱ እጅ በንጉሥ ዙሪያ ሆናችሁ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ጠብቁ።

verses.en: And ye shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain: and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in.
verses.fr: vous entourerez le roi de toutes parts, chacun les armes à la main, et l''on donnera la mort à quiconque s''avancera dans les rangs; vous serez près du roi quand il sortira et quand il entrera.
verses.am: ንጉሡንም በዙሪያው ክበቡት፥ የጦር ዕቃችሁም በእጃችሁ ይሁን፤ በሰልፋችሁ መካከል የሚገባ ይገደል፤ ንጉሡም በወጣና በገባ ጊዜ ከእርሱ ጋር ሁኑ።

verses.en: And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.
verses.fr: Les chefs de centaines exécutèrent tous les ordres qu''avait donnés le sacrificateur Jehojada. Ils prirent chacun leurs gens, ceux qui entraient en service et ceux qui sortaient de service le jour du sabbat, et ils se rendirent vers le sacrificateur Jehojada.
verses.am: መቶ አለቆችም ካህኑ ዮዳሄ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አደረጉ፤ ከእነርሱም እያንዳንዱ በሰንበት ይገቡ የነበሩትን፥ በሰንበቱም ይወጡ የነበሩትን ሰዎች ይዘው ወደ ካህኑ ወደ ዮዳሄ መጡ።

verses.en: And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David's spears and shields, that were in the temple of the Lord.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur remit aux chefs de centaines les lances et les boucliers qui provenaient du roi David, et qui se trouvaient dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህኑም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበረውን የንጉሡን የዳዊትን ጋሻና ጦር ሁሉ ለመቶ አለቆች ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, round about the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, along by the altar and the temple.
verses.fr: Les coureurs, chacun les armes à la main, entourèrent le roi, en se plaçant depuis le côté droit jusqu''au côté gauche de la maison, près de l''autel et près de la maison.
verses.am: ዘበኞቹም ሁሉ እያንዳንዳቸው የጦር ዕቃቸውን በእጃቸው ይዘው በንጉሡ ዙሪያ ከቤቱ ቀኝ እስከ ቤቱ ግራ ድረስ በመሠዊያውና በቤቱ አጠገብ ቆሙ።

verses.en: And he brought forth the king's son, and put the crown upon him, and gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur fit avancer le fils du roi, et il mit sur lui le diadème et le témoignage. Ils l''établirent roi et l''oignirent, et frappant des mains, ils dirent: Vive le roi!
verses.am: የንጉሡንም ልጅ አውጥቶ ዘውዱን ጫነበት፥ ምስክሩንም ሰጠው፤ ቀብተውም ንጉሥ አደረጉትና። ንጉሡ ሺህ ዓመት ይንገሥ እያሉ እጃቸውን አጨበጨቡ።

verses.en: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of the Lord.
verses.fr: Athalie entendit le bruit des coureurs et du peuple, et elle vint vers le peuple à la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ጎቶልያም የሠራዊቱንና የሕዝቡን ድምፅ በሰማች ጊዜ ወደ ሕዝቡ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት መጣች።

verses.en: And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.
verses.fr: Elle regarda. Et voici, le roi se tenait sur l''estrade, selon l''usage; les chefs et les trompettes étaient près du roi: tout le peuple du pays était dans la joie, et l''on sonnait des trompettes. Athalie déchira ses vêtements, et cria: Conspiration! conspiration!
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ንጉሡ እንደ ተለመደው በዓምዱ አጠገብ ቆሞ፥ ከንጉሡም ጋር አለቆችና መለከተኞች ቆመው አየች፤ የአገሩም ሕዝብ ሁል ደስ ብሎአቸው ቀንደ መለከት ይነፉ ነበር። ጎቶልያም ልብስዋን ቀድዳ። ዓመፅ ነው፥ ዓመፅ ነው ብላ ጮኸች።

verses.en: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Alors le sacrificateur Jehojada donna cet ordre aux chefs de centaines, qui étaient à la tête de l''armée: Faites-la sortir en dehors des rangs, et tuez par l''épée quiconque la suivra. Car le sacrificateur avait dit: Qu''elle ne soit pas mise à mort dans la maison de l''Eternel!
verses.am: ካህኑም ዮዳሄ በጭፍራው ላይ የተሾሙትን የመቶ አለቆች። ወደ ሰልፉ መካከል አውጡአት፤ የሚከተላትንም በሰይፍ ግደሉት ብሎ አዘዛቸው፤ ካህኑ። በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አትገደል ብሎአልና።

verses.en: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king's house: and there was she slain.
verses.fr: On lui fit place, et elle se rendit à la maison du roi par le chemin de l''entrée des chevaux: c''est là qu''elle fut tuée.
verses.am: እጃቸውንም በእርስዋ ላይ ጫኑ፥ በፈረሱም መግቢያ መንገድ ወደ ንጉሥ ቤት ወሰዱአት፥ በዚያም ገደሉአት።

verses.en: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the Lord and the king and the people, that they should be the Lord's people; between the king also and the people.
verses.fr: Jehojada traita entre l''Eternel, le roi et le peuple, l''alliance par laquelle ils devaient être le peuple de l''Eternel; il établit aussi l''alliance entre le roi et le peuple.
verses.am: ዮዳሄም የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ይሆኑ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔርና በንጉሡ በሕዝቡም መካከል ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ፤ ደግሞም በንጉሡና በሕዝቡ መካከል ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ።

verses.en: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Tout le peuple du pays entra dans la maison de Baal, et ils la démolirent; ils brisèrent entièrement ses autels et ses images, et ils tuèrent devant les autels Matthan, prêtre de Baal. Le sacrificateur Jehojada mit des surveillants dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የአገሩም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወደ በኣል ቤት ሄደው አፈረሱት፤ መሠዊያዎቹንና ምስሎቹን አደቀቁ፥ የበኣልንም ካህን ማታንን በመሠዊያው ፊት ገደሉት። ካህኑም ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት አስተዳዳሪዎችን ሾመ።

verses.en: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of the Lord, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king's house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.
verses.fr: Il prit les chefs de centaines, les Kéréthiens et les coureurs, et tout le peuple du pays; et ils firent descendre le roi de la maison de l''Eternel, et ils entrèrent dans la maison du roi par le chemin de la porte des coureurs. Et Joas s''assit sur le trône des rois.
verses.am: መቶ አለቆቹንና ካራውያንንም፥ ዘበኞችንና የአገሩንም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወሰደ፤ ንጉሡንም ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት አወረዱት፥ በዘበኞችም በር መንገድ ወደ ንጉሡ ቤት አመጡት፤ በነገሥታቱም ዙፋን ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king's house.
verses.fr: Tout le peuple du pays se réjouissait, et la ville était tranquille. On avait fait mourir Athalie par l''épée dans la maison du roi.
verses.am: የአገሩም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ደስ አላቸው፥ ከተማይቱም ጸጥ አለች። ጎቶልያንም በንጉሡ ቤት አጠገብ በሰይፍ ገደሉአት።

verses.en: Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign.
verses.fr: Joas avait sept ans lorsqu''il devint roi.

verses.en: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
verses.fr: La septième année de Jéhu, Joas devint roi, et il régna quarante ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Tsibja, de Beer-Schéba.
verses.am: ኢዮአስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሰባት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the Lord all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
verses.fr: Joas fit ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel tout le temps qu''il suivit les directions du sacrificateur Jehojada.
verses.am: በኢዩ በሰባተኛው ዓመት ኢዮአስ መንገሥ ጀመረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አርባ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ሳብያ የተባለች የቤርሳቤህ ሴት ነበረች።

verses.en: But the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.
verses.fr: Seulement, les hauts lieux ne disparurent point; le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices et des parfums sur les hauts lieux.
verses.am: ካህኑ ዮዳሄም ያስተምረው በነበረ ዘመን ሁሉ ኢዮአስ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ።

verses.en: And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the Lord, even the money of every one that passeth the account, the money that every man is set at, and all the money that cometh into any man's heart to bring into the house of the Lord,
verses.fr: Joas dit aux sacrificateurs: Tout l''argent consacré qu''on apporte dans la maison de l''Eternel, l''argent ayant cours, savoir l''argent pour le rachat des personnes d''après l''estimation qui en est faite, et tout l''argent qu''il vient au coeur de quelqu''un d''apporter à la maison de l''Eternel,
verses.am: ነገር ግን በኮረብቶቹ ላይ ያሉት መስገጃዎች አልተወገዱም፤ ሕዝቡም ገና በኮረብቶቹ ላይ ባሉት መስገጃዎች ይሠዋና ያጥን ነበር።

verses.en: Let the priests take it to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.
verses.fr: que les sacrificateurs le prennent chacun de la part des gens de sa connaissance, et qu''ils l''emploient à réparer la maison partout où il se trouvera quelque chose à réparer.
verses.am: ኢዮአስም ካህናቱን። ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት የሚገባውን የተቀደሰውን ገንዘብ ሁሉ፥ ስለ ነፍሱም ዋጋ የሚቀርበውን ገንዘብ፥ በልባቸውም ፈቃድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት የሚያመጡትን ገንዘብ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.
verses.fr: Mais il arriva que, la vingt-troisième année du roi Joas, les sacrificateurs n''avaient point réparé ce qui était à réparer à la maison.
verses.am: ካህናቱ እያንዳንዱ ሰው ከሚያመጣው ይውሰዱ በመቅደስም ውስጥ የተናዱትን ይጠግኑበት አላቸው።

verses.en: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the other priests, and said unto them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.
verses.fr: Le roi Joas appela le sacrificateur Jehojada et les autres sacrificateurs, et leur dit: Pourquoi n''avez-vous pas réparé ce qui est à réparer à la maison? Maintenant, vous ne prendrez plus l''argent de vos connaissances, mais vous le livrerez pour les réparations de la maison.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እስከ ንጉሡ እስከ ኢዮአስ እስከ ሀያ ሦስተኛው ዓመት ድረስ በመቅደሱ ውስጥ የተናዱትን ካህናቱ አልጠገኑትም ነበር።

verses.en: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs convinrent de ne pas prendre l''argent du peuple, et de n''être pas chargés des réparations de la maison.
verses.am: ኢዮአስም ካህኑን ዮዳሄንና ካህናቱን ጠርቶ። በመቅደሱ ውስጥ የተናዱትን ስፍራዎች ስለ ምን አትጠግኑአቸውም? ከእንግዲህ ወዲያ ገንዘቡ ለቤቱ መጠገኛ ይሰጥ እንጂ ከሚያመጡት ሰዎች አትቀበሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the Lord: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Alors le sacrificateur Jehojada prit un coffre, perça un trou dans son couvercle, et le plaça à côté de l''autel, à droite, sur le passage par lequel on entrait à la maison de l''Eternel. Les sacrificateurs qui avaient la garde du seuil y mettaient tout l''argent qu''on apportait dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህናቱም። ከሕዝቡ ገንዘቡን አንወስድም፥ በቤቱም ውስጥ የተናዱትን አንጠግንም ብለው እሺ አሉ።

verses.en: And it was so, when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king's scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Quand ils voyaient qu''il y avait beaucoup d''argent dans le coffre, le secrétaire du roi montait avec le souverain sacrificateur, et ils serraient et comptaient l''argent qui se trouvait dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህኑ ዮዳሄ ግን ሣጥን ወስዶ መክደኛውን ነደለው፥ በመሠዊያውም አጠገብ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት በሚገቡበት መግቢያ በስተ ቀኝ አኖረው፤ ደጁንም የሚጠብቁ ካህናት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት የሚመጣውን ገንዘብ ሁሉ ያኖሩበት ነበር።

verses.en: And they gave the money, being told, into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of the Lord: and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house of the Lord,
verses.fr: Ils remettaient l''argent pesé entre les mains de ceux qui étaient chargés de faire exécuter l''ouvrage dans la maison de l''Eternel. Et l''on employait cet argent pour les charpentiers et pour les ouvriers qui travaillaient à la maison de l''Eternel,
verses.am: በሣጥንም ውስጥ ብዙ ገንዘብ መኖሩን ባዩ ጊዜ የንጉሡ ጸሐፊና የካህናቱ አለቃ ይመጡ ነበር፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የተገኘውን ቈጥረው በከረጢት ውስጥ ያኖሩት ነበር።

verses.en: And to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the Lord, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.
verses.fr: pour les maçons et les tailleurs de pierres, pour les achats de bois et de pierres de taille nécessaires aux réparations de la maison de l''Eternel, et pour toutes les dépenses concernant les réparations de la maison.
verses.am: የተመዘነውንም ገንዘብ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ለመሥራት በተሾሙት እጅ ይሰጡ ነበር።

verses.en: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the Lord bowls of silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of the Lord:
verses.fr: Mais, avec l''argent qu''on apportait dans la maison de l''Eternel, on ne fit pour la maison de l''Eternel ni bassins d''argent, ni couteaux, ni coupes, ni trompettes, ni aucun ustensile d''or ou d''argent:
verses.am: የተናደውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ለመጠገን መክፈል ለሚያሻው ሁሉ ድንጋይና እንጨት ይገዙ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ለሚሠሩ አናጢዎችና ሠራተኞች ግንበኞችና ድንጋይ ወቃሪዎች ይሰጡት ነበር።

verses.en: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: on le donnait à ceux qui faisaient l''ouvrage, afin qu''ils l''employassent à réparer la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ከሚመጣው ገንዘብ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት የሚሆኑ የብር ጽዋዎችና ጕጠቶች ድስቶችም መለከቶችም የወርቅና የብር ዕቃዎችም አልተሠሩም ነበር።

verses.en: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.
verses.fr: On ne demandait pas de compte aux hommes entre les mains desquels on remettait l''argent pour qu''ils le donnassent à ceux qui faisaient l''ouvrage, car ils agissaient avec probité.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለሚሠሩት ይሰጡት ነበር፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት ጠገኑበት።

verses.en: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the Lord: it was the priests'.
verses.fr: L''argent des sacrifices de culpabilité et des sacrifices d''expiation n''était point apporté dans la maison de l''Eternel: il était pour les sacrificateurs.
verses.am: ለሠራተኞችም ይከፍሉ ዘንድ ገንዘቡን የሚወስዱትን ሰዎች አይቆጣጠሩአቸውም ነበር፤ በታማኝነት ይሠሩ ነበርና።

verses.en: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Alors Hazaël, roi de Syrie, monta et se battit contre Gath, dont il s''empara. Hazaël avait l''intention de monter contre Jérusalem.
verses.am: ስለ በደልና ሰለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የቀረበውም ገንዘብ ለካህናት ነበረ እንጂ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አያገቡትም ነበር።

verses.en: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the Lord, and in the king's house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Joas, roi de Juda, prit toutes les choses consacrées, ce qui avait été consacré par Josaphat, par Joram et par Achazia, ses pères, rois de Juda, ce qu''il avait consacré lui-même, et tout l''or qui se trouvait dans les trésors de la maison de l''Eternel et de la maison du roi, et il envoya le tout à Hazaël, roi de Syrie, qui ne monta pas contre Jérusalem.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት የሶርያ ንጉሥ አዛሄል ወጥቶ ጌትን ወጋ፥ ያዘውም፤ አዛሄልም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ለመውጣት ፊቱን አቀና።

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Joas, et tout ce qu''il a fait, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois de Juda?
verses.am: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ ኢዮአስ አባቶቹ የይሁዳ ነገሥታት ኢዮሣፍጥና ኢዮራም አካዝያስም የቀደሱትን ቅዱስ ነገር፥ እርሱም የቀደሰውን፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤትና በንጉሡ ቤት መዛግብት የተገኘውን ወርቅ ሁሉ ወሰደ፥ ወደ ሶርያም ንጉሥ ወደ አዛሄል ላከው። እርሱም ከኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሰ።

verses.en: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goeth down to Silla.
verses.fr: Ses serviteurs se soulevèrent et formèrent une conspiration; ils frappèrent Joas dans la maison de Millo, qui est à la descente de Silla.
verses.am: የቀረውም የኢዮአስ ነገር፥ የሠራውም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Jozacar, fils de Schimeath, et Jozabad, fils de Schomer, ses serviteurs, le frappèrent, et il mourut. On l''enterra avec ses pères, dans la ville de David. Et Amatsia, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ባሪያዎቹም ተነሥተው ዐመፁበት፥ ወደ ሲላ በሚወርደውም መንገድ በሚሎ ቤት ገደሉት።  [..]፤ ባሪያዎቹም የሰምዓት ልጅ ዮዘካርና የሾሜር ልጅ ዮዛባት መቱት፥ ሞተም፤ በዳዊትም ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ቀበሩት፤ ልጁም አሜስያስ በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.en: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned seventeen years.
verses.fr: La vingt-troisième année de Joas, fils d''Achazia, roi de Juda, Joachaz, fils de Jéhu, régna sur Israël à Samarie. Il régna dix-sept ans.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በአካዝያስ ልጅ በኢዮአስ በሀያ ሦስተኛው ዓመት የኢዩ ልጅ ኢዮአካዝ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ ነገሠ፤ አሥራ ሰባትም ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel; il commit les mêmes péchés que Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, qui avait fait pécher Israël, et il ne s''en détourna point.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ነገር አደረገ፥ እስራኤልንም ያሳተውን የናባጥን ልጅ የኢዮርብዓምን ኃጢአት ተከተለ፤ ከእርስዋም አልራቀም።

verses.en: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, all their days.
verses.fr: La colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma contre Israël, et il les livra entre les mains de Hazaël, roi de Syrie, et entre les mains de Ben-Hadad, fils de Hazaël, tout le temps que ces rois vécurent.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ነደደ፥ በዘመኑም ሁሉ በሶርያው ንጉሥ በአዛሄል እጅ፥ በአዛሄልም ልጅ በወልደ አዴር እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And Jehoahaz besought the Lord, and the Lord hearkened unto him: for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.
verses.fr: Joachaz implora l''Eternel. L''Eternel l''exauça, car il vit l''oppression sous laquelle le roi de Syrie tenait Israël,
verses.am: ኢዮአካዝም እግዚአብሔርን ለመነ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የሶርያ ንጉሥ እስራኤልን ያስጨነቀበትን ጭንቀት አይቶአልና ሰማው።

verses.en: (And the Lord gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents, as beforetime.
verses.fr: et l''Eternel donna un libérateur à Israël. Les enfants d''Israël échappèrent aux mains des Syriens, et ils habitèrent dans leurs tentes comme auparavant.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለእስራኤል ታዳጊ ሰጠ፥ ከሶርያውያንም እጅ ዳኑ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች እንደ ቀድሞው ጊዜ በድንኳናቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel sin, but walked therein: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)
verses.fr: Mais ils ne se détournèrent point des péchés de la maison de Jéroboam, qui avait fait pécher Israël; ils s''y livrèrent aussi, et même l''idole d''Astarté était debout à Samarie.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእርስዋ ሄዱ እንጂ እስራኤልን ካሳተው ከኢዮርብዓም ቤት ኃጢአት አልራቁም፤ ደግሞም የማምለኪያ ዐፀድ በሰማርያ ቆሞ ቀረ።

verses.en: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.
verses.fr: De tout le peuple de Joachaz l''Eternel ne lui avait laissé que cinquante cavaliers, dix chars, et dix mille hommes de pied; car le roi de Syrie les avait fait périr et les avait rendus semblables à la poussière qu''on foule aux pieds.
verses.am: ለኢዮአካዝም ከአምሳ ፈረሰኞች፥ ከአሥርም ሰረገሎች፥ ከአሥር ሺህም እግረኞች በቀር ሕዝብ አልቀረለትም፤ የሶርያ ንጉሥ አጥፍቶአቸዋልና፥ በአውድማም እንዳላ ዕብቅ አድቅቆአቸዋልና።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Joachaz, tout ce qu''il a fait, et ses exploits, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël?
verses.am: የቀረውም የኢዮአካዝ ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ ጭከናውም፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Joachaz se coucha avec ses pères, et on l''enterra à Samarie. Et Joas, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ኢዮአካዝም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በሰማርያም ቀበሩት፤ ልጁም ዮአስ በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.en: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned sixteen years.
verses.fr: La trente-septième année de Joas, roi de Juda, Joas, fils de Joachaz, régna sur Israël à Samarie. Il régna seize ans.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮአስ በሠላሳ ሰባተኛው ዓመት የኢዮአካዝ ልጅ ዮአስ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ ነገሠ፤ አሥራ ስድስትም ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin: but he walked therein.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel; il ne se détourna d''aucun des péchés de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, qui avait fait pécher Israël, et il s''y livra comme lui.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፋ ነገር አደረገ፤ እስራኤልን በሳተው በናባጥ ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት ሁሉ ሄደ እንጂ ከእርስዋ አልራቀም።
