verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Joas, tout ce qu''il a fait, ses exploits, et la guerre qu''il eut avec Amatsia, roi de Juda, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël?
verses.am: የቀረውም የዮአስ ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ ከይሁዳም ከአሜስያስ ጋር የተዋጋበት ጭከና፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
verses.fr: Joas se coucha avec ses pères. Et Jéroboam s''assit sur son trône. Joas fut enterré à Samarie avec les rois d''Israël.
verses.am: ዮአስም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ ኢዮርብዓምም በዙፋኑ ላይ ተቀመጠ፤ ዮአስም በሰማርያ ከእስራኤል ነገሥታት ጋር ተቀበረ።

verses.en: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died. And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof.
verses.fr: Elisée était atteint de la maladie dont il mourut; et Joas, roi d''Israël, descendit vers lui, pleura sur son visage, et dit: Mon père! mon père! Char d''Israël et sa cavalerie!
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም በሚሞትበት በሽታ ታመመ፤ የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ዮአስ ወደ እርሱ ወርዶ በፊቱ አለቀሰና። አባቴ ሆይ፥ አባቴ ሆይ፥ የእስራኤል ሰረገላና ፈረሰኞች አለ።

verses.en: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.
verses.fr: Elisée lui dit: Prends un arc et des flèches. Et il prit un arc et des flèches.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም። ቀስትና ፍላጻዎች ውሰድ አለው፤ ቀስቱንና ፍላጻዎችንም ወሰደ።

verses.en: And he said to the king of Israel, Put thine hand upon the bow. And he put his hand upon it: and Elisha put his hands upon the king's hands.
verses.fr: Puis Elisée dit au roi d''Israël: Bande l''arc avec ta main. Et quand il l''eut bandé de sa main, Elisée mit ses mains sur les mains du roi,
verses.am: የእስራኤልንም ንጉሥ። እጅህን በቀስቱ ላይ ጫን አለው። እጁንም ጫነበት፤ ኤልሳዕም እጁን በንጉሡ እጅ ላይ ጭኖ።

verses.en: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened it. Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the Lord's deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed them.
verses.fr: et il dit: Ouvre la fenêtre à l''orient. Et il l''ouvrit. Elisée dit: Tire. Et il tira. Elisée dit: C''est une flèche de délivrance de la part de l''Eternel, une flèche de délivrance contre les Syriens; tu battras les Syriens à Aphek jusqu''à leur extermination.
verses.am: የምስራቁን መስኮት ክፈት አለ፤ ከፈተውም። ኤልሳዕም። ወርውር አለ፤ ወረወረውም። እርሱም። የእግዚአብሔር መድኃኒት ፍላጻ ነው፤ በሶርያ ላይ የመድኃኒት ፍላጻ ነው፤ እስክታጠፋቸው ድረስ ሶርያዊያንን በአፌቅ ትመታለህ አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took them. And he said unto the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.
verses.fr: Elisée dit encore: Prends les flèches. Et il les prit. Elisée dit au roi d''Israël: Frappe contre terre. Et il frappa trois fois, et s''arrêta.
verses.am: ደግሞም። ፍላጻዎቹን ውሰድ አለው፤ ወሰዳቸውም። የእስራኤልንም ንጉሥ። ምድሩን ምታው አለው። ሦስት ጊዜም መትቶ ቆመ።

verses.en: And the man of God was wroth with him, and said, Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it: whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice.
verses.fr: L''homme de Dieu s''irrita contre lui, et dit: Il fallait frapper cinq ou six fois; alors tu aurais battu les Syriens jusqu''à leur extermination; maintenant tu les battras trois fois.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ተቆጥቶ። አምስት ወይም ስድስት ጊዜ መትተኸው ኖሮ ሶርያን እስክታጠፋው ድረስ በመታኸው ነበር፤ አሁን ግን ሦስት ጊዜ ብቻ ሶርያን ትመታለህ አለ።

verses.en: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.
verses.fr: Elisée mourut, et on l''enterra. L''année suivante, des troupes de Moabites pénétrèrent dans le pays.
verses.am: ኤልሳዕም ሞተ፥ ቀበሩትም። ከሞዓብም አደጋ ጣዮች በየዓመቱ ወደ አገሩ ይገቡ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
verses.fr: Et comme on enterrait un homme, voici, on aperçut une de ces troupes, et l''on jeta l''homme dans le sépulcre d''Elisée. L''homme alla toucher les os d''Elisée, et il reprit vie et se leva sur ses pieds.
verses.am: ሰዎችም አንድ ሰው ሲቀብሩ አደጋ ጣዮችን አዩ፥ ሬሳውንም በኤልሳዕ መቃብር ጣሉት፤ የኤልሳዕንም አጥንት በነካ ጊዜ ሰውዮው ድኖ በእግሩ ቆመ።

verses.en: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
verses.fr: Hazaël, roi de Syrie, avait opprimé Israël pendant toute la vie de Joachaz.
verses.am: የሶርያም ንጉሥ አዛሄል በኢዮአካዝ ዘመን ሁሉ እስራኤልን አስጨነቀ፤

verses.en: And the Lord was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.
verses.fr: Mais l''Eternel leur fit miséricorde et eut compassion d''eux, il tourna sa face vers eux à cause de son alliance avec Abraham, Isaac et Jacob, il ne voulut pas les détruire, et jusqu''à présent il ne les a pas rejetés de sa face.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን ራራላቸው፥ ማራቸውም፥ ከአብርሃምና ከይስሐቅ ከያዕቆብም ጋር ስላደረገውም ቃል ኪዳን እነርሱን ተመለከተ፤ ሊያጠፋቸውም አልወደደም፥ ፈጽሞም ከፊቱ አልጣላቸውም።

verses.en: So Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Hazaël, roi de Syrie, mourut, et Ben-Hadad, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: የሶርያም ንጉሥ አዛሄል ሞተ፤ ልጁም ወልደ አዴር በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Israel.
verses.fr: Joas, fils de Joachaz, reprit des mains de Ben-Hadad, fils de Hazaël, les villes enlevées par Hazaël à Joachaz, son père, pendant la guerre. Joas le battit trois fois, et il recouvra les villes d''Israël.
verses.am: አዛሄልም ከአባቱ ከኢዮአካዝ እጅ በሰልፍ የወሰዳቸውን ከተሞች የኢዮአካዝ ልጅ ዮአስ ከአዛሄል ልጅ ከወልደ አዴር እጅ ወሰደ። ዮአስም ሦስት ጊዜ መታው፥ የእስራኤልንም ከተሞች መለሰ።

verses.en: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.
verses.fr: La seconde année de Joas, fils de Joachaz, roi d''Israël, Amatsia, fils de Joas, roi de Juda, régna.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በኢዮአካዝ ልጅ በዮአስ በሁለተኛው ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮአስ ልጅ አሜስያስ ነገሠ።

verses.en: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Il avait vingt-cinq ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna vingt-neuf ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Joaddan, de Jérusalem.
verses.am: መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሀያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ነገሠ። እናቱም ዮዓዳን የተባለች የኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ነበረች።

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel, non pas toutefois comme David, son père; il agit entièrement comme avait agi Joas, son père.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን አባቱ ኢዮአስ እንዳደረገ ሁሉ እንጂ እንደ አባቱ እንደ ዳዊት አላደረገም።

verses.en: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.
verses.fr: Seulement, les hauts lieux ne disparurent point; le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices et des parfums sur les hauts lieux.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በኮረብቶቹ ላይ ያሉት መስገጃዎች አልተወገዱም፤ ሕዝቡም ገና በኮረብቶች ላይ ባሉት መስገጃዎች ይሠዋና ያጥን ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father.
verses.fr: Lorsque la royauté fut affermie entre ses mains, il frappa ses serviteurs qui avaient tué le roi, son père.
verses.am: መንግሥቱም በጸናለት ጊዜ አባቱን የገደሉትን ባሪያዎች ገደለ።

verses.en: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein the Lord commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
verses.fr: Mais il ne fit pas mourir les fils des meurtriers, selon ce qui est écrit dans le livre de la loi de Moïse, où l''Eternel donne ce commandement: On ne fera point mourir les pères pour les enfants, et l''on ne fera point mourir les enfants pour les pères; mais on fera mourir chacun pour son péché.
verses.am: በሙሴ ሕግ መጽሐፍም እንደ ተጻፈ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። ሁሉ በኃጢአቱ ይሙት እንጂ አባቶች በልጆች አይሙቱ፥ ልጆችም በአባቶች አይሙቱ ብሎ እንዳዘዘ የነፍሰ ገዳዮቹን ልጆች አልገደለም።

verses.en: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.
verses.fr: Il battit dix mille Edomites dans la vallée du sel; et durant la guerre, il prit Séla, et l''appela Joktheel, nom qu''elle a conservé jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: እርሱም በጨው ሸለቆ ከኤዶምያስ አሥር ሺህ ሰው ገደለ፤ ሴላን በሰልፍ ወስዶ ስምዋን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ዮቅትኤል ብሎ ጠራት።

verses.en: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.
verses.fr: Alors Amatsia envoya des messagers à Joas, fils de Joachaz, fils de Jéhu, roi d''Israël, pour lui dire: Viens, voyons-nous en face!
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም አሜስያስ። ና እርስ በርሳችን ፊት ለፊት እንተያይ ብሎ ወደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ ወደ ኢዩ ልጅ ወደ ኢዮአካዝ ልጅ ወደ ዮአስ መልእክተኞችን ላከ።

verses.en: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
verses.fr: Et Joas, roi d''Israël, fit dire à Amatsia, roi de Juda: L''épine du Liban envoya dire au cèdre du Liban: Donne ta fille pour femme à mon fils! Et les bêtes sauvages qui sont au Liban passèrent et foulèrent l''épine.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ዮአስ። የሊባኖስ ኵርንችት፥ ልጅህን ለልጄ ሚስት አድርገህ ስጠው ብሎ ወደ ሊባኖስ ዝግባ ላከ፤ የሊባኖስም አውሬ አልፎ ኵርንችቱን ረገጠ።

verses.en: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom, and thine heart hath lifted thee up: glory of this, and tarry at home: for why shouldest thou meddle to thy hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?
verses.fr: Tu as battu les Edomites, et ton coeur s''élève. Jouis de ta gloire, et reste chez toi. Pourquoi t''engager dans une malheureuse entreprise, qui amènerait ta ruine et celle de Juda?
verses.am: ኤዶምያስን በእውነት መታህ፥ ልብህንም ከፍ ከፍ አደረግህ፤ በዚያ ተመካ፥ በቤትህም ተቀመጥ፤ አንተ ከይሁዳ ጋር ትወድቅ ዘንድ ስለ ምን መከራ ትሻለህ? ብሎ ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ወደ አሜስያስ ላከ።

verses.en: But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Bethshemesh, which belongeth to Judah.
verses.fr: Mais Amatsia ne l''écouta pas. Et Joas, roi d''Israël, monta; et ils se virent en face, lui et Amatsia, roi de Juda, à Beth-Schémesch, qui est à Juda.
verses.am: አሜስያስ ግን አልሰማም፤ የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ዮአስ ወጣ፥ እርሱና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ አሜስያስም በይሁዳ ባለች በቤት ሳሚስ እርስ በርሳቸው ተያዩ።

verses.en: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel; and they fled every man to their tents.
verses.fr: Juda fut battu par Israël, et chacun s''enfuit dans sa tente.
verses.am: ይሁዳም በእስራኤል ፊት ተመታ፤ እያንዳንዱም ወደ ድንኳኑ ሸሸ።

verses.en: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Bethshemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
verses.fr: Joas, roi d''Israël, prit à Beth-Schémesch Amatsia, roi de Juda, fils de Joas, fils d''Achazia. Il vint à Jérusalem, et fit une brèche de quatre cents coudées dans la muraille de Jérusalem, depuis la porte d''Ephraïm jusqu''à la porte de l''angle.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ዮአስ የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የአካዝያስን ልጅ የኢዮአስን ልጅ አሜስያስን በቤትሳሚስ ይዞ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጥር ከኤፍሬም በር ጀምሮ እስክ ማዕዘኑ በር ድረስ አራት መቶ ክንድ አፈረሰ።

verses.en: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasures of the king's house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.
verses.fr: Il prit tout l''or et l''argent et tous les vases qui se trouvaient dans la maison de l''Eternel et dans les trésors de la maison du roi; il prit aussi des otages, et il retourna à Samarie.
verses.am: ወርቁንና ብሩን ሁሉ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤትና በንጉሡ ቤት መዛግብት የነበሩትን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ፥ በመያዣም የተያዙትን ወስዶ ወደ ሰማርያ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Joas, ce qu''il a fait, ses exploits, et la guerre qu''il eut avec Amatsia, roi de Juda, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël?
verses.am: የቀረውም ያደረገው የዮአስ ነገር፥ ጭከናውም፥ ከይሁዳም ንጉሥ ከአሜስያስ ጋር እንደ ተዋጋ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Joas se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré à Samarie avec les rois d''Israël. Et Jéroboam, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ዮአስም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በሰማርያም ከእስራኤል ነገሥታት ጋር ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ኢዮርብዓም በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
verses.fr: Amatsia, fils de Joas, roi de Juda, vécut quinze ans après la mort de Joas, fils de Joachaz, roi d''Israël.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ የኢዮአስ ልጅ አሜስያስ ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ከኢዮአካዝ ልጅ ከዮአስ ሞት በኋላ አሥራ አምስት ዓመት ኖረ።

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions d''Amatsia, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois de Juda?
verses.am: የቀረውም የአሜስያስ ነገር በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.
verses.fr: On forma contre lui une conspiration à Jérusalem, et il s''enfuit à Lakis; mais on le poursuivit à Lakis, où on le fit mourir.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም የዓመፅ መሐላ አደረጉበት፥ እርሱም ወደ ለኪሶ ኰበለለ፤ በኋላውም ወደ ለኪሶ ላኩ፥ በዚያም ገደሉት።

verses.en: And they brought him on horses: and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.
verses.fr: On le transporta sur des chevaux, et il fut enterré à Jérusalem avec ses pères, dans la ville de David.
verses.am: በፈረስም ጭነው አመጡት፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም በዳዊት ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ተቀበረ።

verses.en: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, which was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.
verses.fr: Et tout le peuple de Juda prit Azaria, âgé de seize ans, et l''établit roi à la place de son père Amatsia.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ሕዝብ ሁሉ የአሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ልጅ የነበረውን ዓዛርያስን ወስዶ በአባቱ በአሜስያስ ፋንታ አነገሠው።

verses.en: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
verses.fr: Azaria rebâtit Elath et la fit rentrer sous la puissance de Juda, après que le roi fut couché avec ses pères.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ከአባቶቹ ጋር ካንቀላፋ በኋላ፥ ኤላትን ሠርቶ ወደ ይሁዳ መለሳት።

verses.en: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria, and reigned forty and one years.
verses.fr: La quinzième année d''Amatsia, fils de Joas, roi de Juda, Jéroboam, fils de Joas, roi d''Israël, régna à Samarie. Il régna quarante et un ans.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮአስ ልጅ በአሜስያስ በአሥራ አምስተኛው ዓመት የእስራኤል ንጉሥ የዮአስ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓም በሰማርያ መንገሥ ጀመረ፤ አርባ አንድ ዓመትም ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel; il ne se détourna d''aucun des péchés de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, qui avait fait pécher Israël.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ነገር አደረገ፤ እስራኤልንም ካሳተው ከናባጥ ልጅ ከኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት ሁሉ አልራቀም።

verses.en: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the Lord God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gathhepher.
verses.fr: Il rétablit les limites d''Israël depuis l''entrée de Hamath jusqu''à la mer de la plaine, selon la parole que l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, avait prononcée par son serviteur Jonas, le prophète, fils d''Amitthaï, de Gath-Hépher.
verses.am: የጋትሔፌር በነበረው በአማቴ ልጅ በባሪያው በነቢዩ በዮናስ እጅ እንደ ተናገረው እንደ እስራኤል አምላክ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል የእስራኤልን ድንበር ከሐማት መግቢያ ጀምሮ እስከ ዓረባ ባሕር ድረስ መለሰ።

verses.en: For the Lord saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter: for there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Israel.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel vit l''affliction d''Israël à son comble et l''extrémité à laquelle se trouvaient réduits esclaves et hommes libres, sans qu''il y eût personne pour venir au secours d''Israël.
verses.am: የታሰረውና የተለቀቀውም እንደ ጠፋ፥ እስራኤልንም የሚረዳ እንዳልነበረ እግዚአብሔር እጅግ የመረረውን የእስራኤልን ጭንቀት አየ።

verses.en: And the Lord said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
verses.fr: Or l''Eternel n''avait point résolu d''effacer le nom d''Israël de dessous les cieux, et il les délivra par Jéroboam, fils de Joas.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የእስራኤልን ስም ከሰማይ በታች ይደመስስ ዘንድ አልተናገረም፤ ነገር ግን በዮአስ ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም እጅ አዳናቸው።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which belonged to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Jéroboam, tout ce qu''il a fait, ses exploits à la guerre, et comment il fit rentrer sous la puissance d''Israël Damas et Hamath qui avaient appartenu à Juda, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël?
verses.am: የቀረውም የኢዮርብዓም ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ ጭከናውም፥ እንደ ተዋጋም፥ የይሁዳ የነበረውን ደማስቆንና ሐማትን ለእስራኤል እንደ መለሰ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Jéroboam se coucha avec ses pères, avec les rois d''Israël. Et Zacharie, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ኢዮርብዓምም ከአባቶቹ ከእስራኤል ነገሥታት ጋር አንቀላፋ፤ ልጁም ዘካርያ በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.en: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign.
verses.fr: La vingt-septième année de Jéroboam, roi d''Israël, Azaria, fils d''Amatsia, roi de Juda, régna.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በኢዮርብዓም በሀያ ሰባተኛው ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የአሜስያስ ልጅ ዓዛርያስ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Il avait seize ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna cinquante-deux ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Jecolia, de Jérusalem.
verses.am: መንገሥም በጀመረ ጊዜ የአሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አምሳ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ይኮልያ የተባለች የኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ነበረች።

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Amaziah had done;
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel, entièrement comme avait fait Amatsia, son père.
verses.am: አባቱ አሜስያስ እንዳደረገው ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ።

verses.en: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.
verses.fr: Seulement, les hauts lieux ne disparurent point; le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices et des parfums sur les hauts lieux.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በኮረብቶች ላይ ያሉት መስገጃዎች አልተወገዱም፤ ሕዝቡም ገና በኮረብቶች ላይ ባሉት መስገጃዎች ይሠዋና ያጥን ነበር።

verses.en: And the Lord smote the king, so that he was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the king's son was over the house, judging the people of the land.
verses.fr: L''Eternel frappa le roi, qui fut lépreux jusqu''au jour de sa mort et demeura dans une maison écartée. Et Jotham, fils du roi, était à la tête de la maison et jugeait le peuple du pays.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ንጉሡን ቀሠፈው፥ እስከሚሞትበትም ቀን ድረስ ለምጻም ሆነ፥ በተለየ ቤትም ይቀመጥ ነበር፥ የንጉሡም ልጅ ኢዮአታም በንጉሥ ቤት ላይ ሠልጥኖ ለአገሩ ሕዝብ ይፈርድ ነበር።

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions d''Azaria, et tout ce qu''il a fait, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois de Juda?
verses.am: የቀረውም የዓዛርያስ ነገር፥ የሠራውም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Azaria se coucha avec ses pères, et on l''enterra avec ses pères dans la ville de David. Et Jotham, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ዓዛርያስም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ቀበሩት፤ ልጁም ኢዮአታም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.
verses.fr: La trente-huitième année d''Azaria, roi de Juda, Zacharie, fils de Jéroboam, régna sur Israël à Samarie. Il régna six mois.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በዓዛርያስ በሠላሳ ስምንተኛው ዓመት የኢዮርብዓም ልጅ ዘካርያስ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ ስድስት ወር ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, comme avaient fait ses pères; il ne se détourna point des péchés de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, qui avait fait pécher Israël.
verses.am: አባቶቹም እንዳደረጉት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነገር አደረገ፤ እስራኤልን ካሳታቸው ከናባጥ ልጅ ከኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት አልራቀም።

verses.en: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Schallum, fils de Jabesch, conspira contre lui, le frappa devant le peuple, et le fit mourir; et il régna à sa place.
verses.am: የኢያቤስም ልጅ ሰሎም ተማማለበት፥ በይብልዓም መትቶ ገደለው፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Zacharie, cela est écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël.
verses.am: የቀረውም የዘካርያ ነገር፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: This was the word of the Lord which he spake unto Jehu, saying, Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation. And so it came to pass.
verses.fr: Ainsi s''accomplit ce que l''Eternel avait déclaré à Jéhu, en disant: Tes fils jusqu''à la quatrième génération seront assis sur le trône d''Israël.
verses.am: ለኢዩ። ልጆችህ እስከ አራት ትውልድ ድረስ በእስራኤል ዙፋን ላይ ይቀመጣሉ ተብሎ የተነገረው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነበረ፤ እንዲሁም ሆነ።

verses.en: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.
verses.fr: Schallum, fils de Jabesch, régna la trente-neuvième année d''Ozias, roi de Juda. Il régna pendant un mois à Samarie.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሠ በዖዝያን በሠላሳ ዘጠኝኛው ዓመት የኢያቤስ ልጅ ሰሎም ነገሠ፤ በሰማርያም አንድ ወር ያህል ነገሠ።

verses.en: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Menahem, fils de Gadi, monta de Thirtsa et vint à Samarie, frappa dans Samarie Schallum, fils de Jabesch, et le fit mourir; et il régna à sa place.
verses.am: የጋዲም ልጅ ምናሔም ከቴርሳ ወጥቶ ወደ ሰማርያ መጣ፥ በሰማርያም የኢያቤስን ልጅ ሰሎምን መታ፥ ገደለውም፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Schallum, et la conspiration qu''il forma, cela est écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël.
verses.am: የቀረውም የሰሎም ነገር፥ የተማማለውም ዓመፅ፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him, therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.
verses.fr: Alors Menahem frappa Thiphsach et tous ceux qui y étaient, avec son territoire depuis Thirtsa; il la frappa parce qu''elle n''avait pas ouvert ses portes, et il fendit le ventre de toutes les femmes enceintes.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ምናሔም ከቴርሳ ወጥቶ ቲፍሳን በእርስዋም ያሉትን ሁሉ ዳርቻዋንም መታ፤ ይከፍቱለትም ዘንድ አልወደዱምና መታት፤ በእርስዋም የነበሩትን እርጉዞች ሁሉ ቀደዳቸው።

verses.en: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel, and reigned ten years in Samaria.
verses.fr: La trente-neuvième année d''Azaria, roi de Juda, Menahem, fils de Gadi, régna sur Israël. Il régna dix ans à Samarie.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በዓዛርያስ በሠላሳ ዘጠኝኛው ዓመት የጋዲ ልጅ ምናሔም በእስራኤል ላይ መንገሥ ጀመረ፤ በሰማርያም አሥር ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel; il ne se détourna point, tant qu''il vécut, des péchés de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, qui avait fait pécher Israël.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ነገር አደረገ፤ እስራኤልን ካሳተው ከናባጥ ልጅ ከኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት አልራቀም።

verses.en: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.
verses.fr: Pul, roi d''Assyrie, vint dans le pays; et Menahem donna à Pul mille talents d''argent, pour qu''il l''aidât à affermir la royauté entre ses mains.
verses.am: በዘመኑም የአሦር ንጉሥ ፎሐ በምድሪቱ ላይ ወጣ፤ ምናሔምም መንግሥቱን በእጁ ያጸናለት ዘንድ የፎሐ እጅ ከእርሱ ጋር እንዲሆን አንድ ሺህ መክሊት ብር ሰጠው።

verses.en: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel, even of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.
verses.fr: Menahem leva cet argent sur tous ceux d''Israël qui avaient de la richesse, afin de le donner au roi d''Assyrie; il les taxa chacun à cinquante sicles d''argent. Le roi d''Assyrie s''en retourna, et ne s''arrêta pas alors dans le pays.
verses.am: ምናሔምም ብሩን ለአሦር ንጉሥ ይሰጥ ዘንድ በእስራኤል ባለ ጠጎች ሁሉ ላይ በእያንዳንዱ ላይ አምሳ ሰቅል ብር አስገብሮ አወጣ። የአሦርም ንጉሥ ተመለሰ፥ በአገሪቱም አልተቀመጠም።

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Menahem, et tout ce qu''il a fait, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël?
verses.am: የቀረውም የምናሔም ነገር፥ የሠራውም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Menahem se coucha avec ses pères. Et Pekachia, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ምናሔም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፤ ልጁም ፋቂስያስ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned two years.
verses.fr: La cinquantième année d''Azaria, roi de Juda, Pekachia, fils de Menahem, régna sur Israël à Samarie. Il régna deux ans.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በዓዛርያስ በአምሳኛው ዓመት የምናሔም ልጅ ፋቂስያስ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ መንገሥ ጀመረ፤ ሁለት ዓመትም ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel; il ne se détourna point des péchés de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, qui avait fait pécher Israël.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ነገር አደረገ፤ እስራኤልን ካሳተው ከናባጥ ልጅ ከኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት አልራቀም።

verses.en: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king's house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.
verses.fr: Pékach, fils de Remalia, son officier, conspira contre lui; il le frappa à Samarie, dans le palais de la maison du roi, de même qu''Argob et Arié; il avait avec lui cinquante hommes d''entre les fils des Galaadites. Il fit ainsi mourir Pekachia, et il régna à sa place.
verses.am: የሠራዊቱም አለቃ የሮሜልዩ ልጅ ፋቁሔ ተማማለበት፥ በሰማርያም በንጉሡ ቤት ግንብ ውስጥ ከአርጎብና ከአርያ ጋር መታው፤ ከእርሱም ጋር አምሳ የገለዓድ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ ገደለውም፥ ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Pekachia, et tout ce qu''il a fait, cela est écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël.
verses.am: የቀረውም የፋቂስያስ ነገር፥ የሠራውም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned twenty years.
verses.fr: La cinquante-deuxième année d''Azaria, roi de Juda, Pékach, fils de Remalia, régna sur Israël à Samarie. Il régna vingt ans.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በዓዛርያስ በአምሳ ሁለተኛው ዓመት የሮሜልዩ ልጅ ፋቁሔ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ መንገሥ ጀመረ፤ ሀያ ዓመትም ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel; il ne se détourna point des péchés de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, qui avait fait pécher Israël.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ነገር አደረገ፤ እስራኤልን ካሳተው ከናባጥ ልጅ ከኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት አልራቀም።

verses.en: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abelbethmaachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.
verses.fr: Du temps de Pékach, roi d''Israël, Tiglath-Piléser, roi d''Assyrie, vint et prit Ijjon, Abel-Beth-Maaca, Janoach, Kédesch, Hatsor, Galaad et la Galilée, tout le pays de Nephthali, et il emmena captifs les habitants en Assyrie.
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በፋቁሔ ዘመን የአሦር ንጉሥ ቴልጌልቴልፌልሶር መጥቶ ዒዮንና አቤልቤትመዓካን፥ ያኖዋንም፥ ቃዴስንና አሶርንም፥ ገለዓድንና ገሊላንም፥ የንፍታሌምን አገር ሁሉ ወሰደ፤ ወደ አሦርም አፈለሳቸው።

verses.en: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
verses.fr: Osée, fils d''Ela, forma une conspiration contre Pékach, fils de Remalia, le frappa et le fit mourir; et il régna à sa place, la vingtième année de Jotham, fils d''Ozias.
verses.am: በዖዝያንም ልጅ በኢዮአታም በሀያኛው ዓመት የኤላ ልጅ ሆሴዕ በሮሜልዩ ልጅ በፋቁሔ ላይ ተማማለ፥ መትቶም ገደለው፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Pékach, et tout ce qu''il a fait, cela est écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël.
verses.am: የቀረውም የፋቁሔ ነገር፥ የሠራውም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.
verses.fr: La seconde année de Pékach, fils de Remalia, roi d''Israël, Jotham, fils d''Ozias, roi de Juda, régna.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በሮሜልዩ ልጅ በፋቁሔ በሁለተኛው ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የዖዝያን ልጅ ኢዮአታም ነገሠ።

verses.en: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.
verses.fr: Il avait vingt-cinq ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna seize ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Jeruscha, fille de Tsadok.
verses.am: መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱ የሳዶቅ ልጅ ኢየሩሳ ነበረች።

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord: he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel; il agit entièrement comme avait agi Ozias, son père.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ፤ አባቱ ዖዝያን እንዳደረገ ሁሉ እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.en: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Seulement, les hauts lieux ne disparurent point; le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices et des parfums sur les hauts lieux. Jotham bâtit la porte supérieure de la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በኮረብቶች ላይ ያሉት መስገጃዎች አልተወገዱም፤ ሕዝቡም ገና በኮረብቶች ላይ ባሉት መስገጃዎች ይሠዋና ያጥን ነበር። እርሱም የላይኛውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት በር ሠራ።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Jotham, et tout ce qu''il a fait, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois de Juda?
verses.am: የቀረውም የኢዮአታም ነገር፥ የሠራውም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: In those days the Lord began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.
verses.fr: Dans ce temps-là, l''Eternel commença à envoyer contre Juda Retsin, roi de Syrie, et Pékach, fils de Remalia.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት እግዚአብሔር የሶርያን ንጉሥ ረአሶንንና የሮሜልዩን ልጅ ፋቁሔን በይሁዳ ላይ መስደድ ጀመረ።

verses.en: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Jotham se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré avec ses pères dans la ville de David, son père. Et Achaz, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ኢዮአታም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በአባቱም በዳዊት ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም አካዝ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.
verses.fr: La dix-septième année de Pékach, fils de Remalia, Achaz, fils de Jotham, roi de Juda, régna.
verses.am: በሮሜልዩ ልጅ በፋቁሔ በአሥራ ሰባተኛው ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮአታም ልጅ አካዝ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not that which was right in the sight of the Lord his God, like David his father.
verses.fr: Achaz avait vingt ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna seize ans à Jérusalem. Il ne fit point ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel, son Dieu, comme avait fait David, son père.
verses.am: አካዝ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እንደ አባቱም እንደ ዳዊት በአምላኩ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አላደረገም።

verses.en: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Il marcha dans la voie des rois d''Israël; et même il fit passer son fils par le feu, suivant les abominations des nations que l''Eternel avait chassées devant les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ሄደ፤ ደግሞም እግዚአብሔር ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት እንዳሳደዳቸው እንደ አሕዛብ ርኵሰት ልጁን በእሳት አሳለፈው።

verses.en: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
verses.fr: Il offrait des sacrifices et des parfums sur les hauts lieux, sur les collines et sous tout arbre vert.
verses.am: በመስገጃዎችና በኮረብቶቹ ላይ በለመለመውም ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች ይሠዋና ያጥን ነበር።

verses.en: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.
verses.fr: Alors Retsin, roi de Syrie, et Pékach, fils de Remalia, roi d''Israël, montèrent contre Jérusalem pour l''attaquer. Ils assiégèrent Achaz; mais ils ne purent pas le vaincre.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜም የሶርያ ንጉሥ ረአሶንና የእስራኤል ንጉሥ የሮሜልዩ ልጅ ፋቁሔ ሊዋጉ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ፤ አካዝንም ከበቡት፥ ሊያሸንፉት ግን አልቻሉም።

verses.en: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.
verses.fr: Dans ce même temps, Retsin, roi de Syrie, fit rentrer Elath au pouvoir des Syriens; il expulsa d''Elath les Juifs, et les Syriens vinrent à Elath, où ils ont habité jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን የሶርያ ንጉሥ ረአሶን ኤላትን ወደ ሶርያ መለሰ፥ አይሁድንም ከኤላት አሳደደ፤ ኤዶማውያንም ወደ ኤላት መጥተው እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በእርስዋ ተቀምጠዋል።

verses.en: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.
verses.fr: Achaz envoya des messagers à Tiglath-Piléser, roi d''Assyrie, pour lui dire: Je suis ton serviteur et ton fils; monte, et délivre-moi de la main du roi de Syrie et de la main du roi d''Israël, qui s''élèvent contre moi.
verses.am: አካዝም። እኔ ባሪያህና ልጅህ ነኝ፤ መጥተህ ከተነሡብን ከሶርያ ንጉሥና ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ እጅ አድነኝ ብሎ ወደ አሦር ንጉሥ ወደ ቴልጌልቴልፌልሶር መልእክተኞችን ላከ።

verses.en: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasures of the king's house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.
verses.fr: Et Achaz prit l''argent et l''or qui se trouvaient dans la maison de l''Eternel et dans les trésors de la maison du roi, et il l''envoya en présent au roi d''Assyrie.
verses.am: አካዝም በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በንጉሡ ቤት መዛግብት የተገኘውን ብርና ወርቅ ወስዶ ወደ አሦር ንጉሥ ገጸ በረከት አድርጎ ሰደደው።

verses.en: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Assyrie l''écouta; il monta contre Damas, la prit, emmena les habitants en captivité à Kir, et fit mourir Retsin.
verses.am: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ሰማው፤ የአሦርም ንጉሥ በደማስቆ ላይ ወጣባት ወሰዳትም፥ ሕዝብዋንም ወደ ቂር አፈለሳቸው፥ ረአሶንንም ገደለ።

verses.en: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.
verses.fr: Le roi Achaz se rendit à Damas au-devant de Tiglath-Piléser, roi d''Assyrie. Et ayant vu l''autel qui était à Damas, le roi Achaz envoya au sacrificateur Urie le modèle et la forme exacte de cet autel.
verses.am: ንጉሡም አካዝ የአሦርን ንጉሠ ቴልጌልቴልፌልሶርን ሊገናኘው ወደ ደማስቆ ሄደ፤ በደማስቆ የነበረውን መሠዊያ አየ፤ ንጉሡም አካዝ የመሠዊያውን ምሳሌና የአሠራሩን መልክ ወደ ካህኑ ወደ ኦርያ ላከው።

verses.en: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur Urie construisit un autel entièrement d''après le modèle envoyé de Damas par le roi Achaz, et le sacrificateur Urie le fit avant que le roi Achaz fût de retour de Damas.
verses.am: ካህኑም ኦርያ መሠዊያ ሠራ፤ ንጉሡ አካዝ ከደማስቆ ልኮ እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ እንዲሁ ካህኑ ኦርያ ንጉሡ አካዝ ከደማስቆ እስኪመጣ ድረስ ሠራው።

verses.en: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.
verses.fr: A son arrivée de Damas, le roi vit l''autel, s''en approcha et y monta:
verses.am: ንጉሡም ከደማስቆ በመጣ ጊዜ መሠዊያውን አየ፤ ንጉሡም ወደ መሠዊያው ቀርቦ በእርሱ ላይ ወጣ።

verses.en: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.
verses.fr: il fit brûler son holocauste et son offrande, versa ses libations, et répandit sur l''autel le sang de ses sacrifices d''actions de grâces.
verses.am: በመሠዊያውም ላይ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን አሳረገ፥ የመጠጡንም ቍርባን አፈሰሰ፥ የደኅንነቱንም መሥዋዕት ደም ረጨ።

verses.en: And he brought also the brasen altar, which was before the Lord, from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of the Lord, and put it on the north side of the altar.
verses.fr: Il éloigna de la face de la maison l''autel d''airain qui était devant l''Eternel, afin qu''il ne fût pas entre le nouvel autel et la maison de l''Eternel; et il le plaça à côté du nouvel autel, vers le nord.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት የነበረውን የናሱን መሠዊያ ከመቅደሱ ፊት ከመሠዊያውና ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት መካከል ፈቀቅ አድርጎ በመሠውያው አጠገብ በሰሜን በኩል አኖረው።

verses.en: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king's burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire by.
verses.fr: Et le roi Achaz donna cet ordre au sacrificateur Urie: Fais brûler sur le grand autel l''holocauste du matin et l''offrande du soir, l''holocauste du roi et son offrande, les holocaustes de tout le peuple du pays et leurs offrandes, verses-y leurs libations, et répands-y tout le sang des holocaustes et tout le sang des sacrifices; pour ce qui concerne l''autel d''airain, je m''en occuperai.
verses.am: ንጉሡም አካዝ። የሚቃጠለውን የጥዋት መሥዋዕት፥ የማታውንም የእህሉን ቍርባን፥ የንጉሡንም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን፥ ለአገሩም ሕዝብ የሚሆን የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን የመጠጡንም ቍርባን በታላቁ መሠዊያ ላይ አቅርብ፤ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት ደም ሁሉ የሌላ መሥዋዕቱንም ደም ሁሉ ርጭበት፤ የናሱ መሠዊያ ግን እኔ እጠይቅበት ዘንድ ይሁን ብሎ ካህኑን ኦርያን አዘዘው።

verses.en: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur Urie se conforma à tout ce que le roi Achaz avait ordonné.
verses.am: ካህኑ ኦርያ ንጉሡ አካዝ እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.en: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon the pavement of stones.
verses.fr: Et le roi Achaz brisa les panneaux des bases, et en ôta les bassins qui étaient dessus. Il descendit la mer de dessus les boeufs d''airain qui étaient sous elle, et il la posa sur un pavé de pierres.
verses.am: ንጉሡም አካዝ የመቀመጫዎችን ክፈፍ ቈረጠ፥ ከእነርሱም የመታጠቢያውን ሰኖች ወሰደ፤ ኵሬውንም ከበታቹ ከነበሩት ከናሱ በሬዎች አወረደው፥ በጠፍጣፋውም ድንጋይ ላይ አኖረው።

verses.en: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king's entry without, turned he from the house of the Lord for the king of Assyria.
verses.fr: Il changea dans la maison de l''Eternel, à cause du roi d''Assyrie, le portique du sabbat qu''on y avait bâti et l''entrée extérieure du roi.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የዙፋኑን መሠረት ሠራ፤ ስለ አሦርም ንጉሥ በውጭ ያለውን የንጉሡን መንገድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አዞረው።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions d''Achaz, et tout ce qu''il a fait, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois de Juda?
verses.am: የቀረውም አካዝ ያደረገው ነገር በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Achaz se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré avec ses pères dans la ville de David. Et Ezéchias, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: አካዝም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ሕዝቅያስ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.
verses.fr: La douzième année d''Achaz, roi de Juda, Osée, fils d''Ela, régna sur Israël à Samarie. Il régna neuf ans.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በአካዝ በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ዓመት የኤላ ልጅ ሆሴዕ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ ንጉሥ ሆነ፤ ዘጠኝ ዓመትም ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, non pas toutefois comme les rois d''Israël qui avaient été avant lui.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ነገር አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን ከእርሱ አስቀድሞ እንደ ነበሩት እንደ እስራኤል ነገሥታት አይደለም።

verses.en: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.
verses.fr: Salmanasar, roi d''Assyrie, monta contre lui; et Osée lui fut assujetti, et lui paya un tribut.
verses.am: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ስልምናሶር በእርሱ ላይ ወጣ፤ ሆሴዕም ተገዛለት፥ ግብርም አመጣለት።

verses.en: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.
verses.fr: Mais le roi d''Assyrie découvrit une conspiration chez Osée, qui avait envoyé des messagers à So, roi d''Egypte, et qui ne payait plus annuellement le tribut au roi d''Assyrie. Le roi d''Assyrie le fit enfermer et enchaîner dans une prison.
verses.am: የአሦርም ንጉሥ በሆሴዕ ላይ ዓመፅ አገኘ፤ መልእክተኞችን ወደ ግብጽ ንጉሥ ወደ ሴጎር ልኮ ነበርና፤ እንደ ልማዱም በየዓመቱ ለአሦር ንጉሥ ግብር አልሰጠምና፤ ስለዚህ የአሦር ንጉሥ ይዞ በወህኒ ቤት አሰረው።

verses.en: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
verses.fr: Et le roi d''Assyrie parcourut tout le pays, et monta contre Samarie, qu''il assiégea pendant trois ans.
verses.am: የአሦርም ንጉሥ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ወጣ፥ ወደ ሰማርያም ወጥቶ ሦስት ዓመት ከበባት።

verses.en: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
verses.fr: La neuvième année d''Osée, le roi d''Assyrie prit Samarie, et emmena Israël captif en Assyrie. Il les fit habiter à Chalach, et sur le Chabor, fleuve de Gozan, et dans les villes des Mèdes.
verses.am: በሆሴዕ በዘጠኝኛው ዓመት የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰማርያን ወሰደ፥ እስራኤልንም ወደ አሦር አፈለሰ፥ በአላሔና በአቦር በጎዛንም ወንዝ በሜዶንም ከተሞች አኖራቸው።

verses.en: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,
verses.fr: Cela arriva parce que les enfants d''Israël péchèrent contre l''Eternel, leur Dieu, qui les avait fait monter du pays d''Egypte, de dessous la main de Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, et parce qu''ils craignirent d''autres dieux.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከግብጽ ንጉሥ ከፈርዖን እጅ፥ ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣቸውን አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርን በድለው ነበርና፥ ሌሎችንም አማልክት አምልከው ነበርና፥

verses.en: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.
verses.fr: Ils suivirent les coutumes des nations que l''Eternel avait chassées devant les enfants d''Israël, et celles que les rois d''Israël avaient établies.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ባሳደዳቸው በአሕዛብ ሥርዓት፥ የእስራኤልም ነገሥታት ባደረጓት ሥርዓት ሄደው ነበርና እንደዚህ ሆነ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the Lord their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël firent en secret contre l''Eternel, leur Dieu, des choses qui ne sont pas bien. Ils se bâtirent des hauts lieux dans toutes leurs villes, depuis les tours des gardes jusqu''aux villes fortes.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በአምላካቸው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ቅን ያልሆነን ንገር በስውር አደረጉ፤ በከተሞቻቸውም ሁሉ ከዘበኞች ግንብ ጀምሮ እስከ ተመሸገች ከተማ ድረስ በከፍታዎቹ ላይ መስገጃዎችን ሠሩ።

verses.en: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:
verses.fr: Ils se dressèrent des statues et des idoles sur toute colline élevée et sous tout arbre vert.
verses.am: በረጃጅሙ ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ በለመለመውም ዛፍ ሁሉ ታች ሐውልቶችንና የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶችን ተከሉ፤

verses.en: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the Lord carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the Lord to anger:
verses.fr: Et là ils brûlèrent des parfums sur tous les hauts lieux, comme les nations que l''Eternel avait chassées devant eux, et ils firent des choses mauvaises, par lesquelles ils irritèrent l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከፊታቸው ያወጣቸው አሕዛብ እንዳደረጉት፥ በኮረብቶቹ መስገጃዎች ሁሉ ላይ ያጥኑ ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ያስቈጡ ዘንድ ክፉ ነገር አደረጉ፤

verses.en: For they served idols, whereof the Lord had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.
verses.fr: Ils servirent les idoles dont l''Eternel leur avait dit: Vous ne ferez pas cela.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የከለከላቸውን ጣዖቶች አመለኩ።

verses.en: Yet the Lord testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fit avertir Israël et Juda par tous ses prophètes, par tous les voyants, et leur dit: Revenez de vos mauvaises voies, et observez mes commandements et mes ordonnances, en suivant entièrement la loi que j''ai prescrite à vos pères et que je vous ai envoyée par mes serviteurs les prophètes.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ከክፉ መንገዳችሁ ተመለሱ፤ ለአባቶቻችሁም እንዳዘዝሁት፥ ባባሪያዎቼ በነቢያት የላክሁላችሁን ትእዛዜንና ሥርዓቴን ሕጌንም ሁሉ ጠብቁ ብሎ በነቢዩ ሁሉና በባለ ራእዩ አፍ ሁሉ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳ መሰከረ።

verses.en: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the Lord their God.
verses.fr: Mais ils n''écoutèrent point, et ils roidirent leur cou, comme leurs pères, qui n''avaient pas cru en l''Eternel, leur Dieu.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርን እንዳላመኑ እንደ አባቶቻቸው አንገት አንገታቸውን አደነደኑ እንጂ አልሰሙም።

verses.en: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom the Lord had charged them, that they should not do like them.
verses.fr: Ils rejetèrent ses lois, l''alliance qu''il avait faite avec leurs pères, et les avertissements qu''il leur avait adressés. Ils allèrent après des choses de néant et ne furent eux-mêmes que néant, et après les nations qui les entouraient et que l''Eternel leur avait défendu d''imiter.
verses.am: ሥርዓቱንም ከአባቶቻቸውም ጋር ያደረገውን ቃል ኪዳን፥ ያጸናላቸውንም ምስክሩን ናቁ፤ ከንቱ ነገርንም ተከተሉ፥ ምናምንቴዎችም ሆኑ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ እነርሱ እንዳይሠሩ ያዘዛቸውን በዙሪያቸው ያሉትን አሕዛብን ተከተሉ።

verses.en: And they left all the commandments of the Lord their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
verses.fr: Ils abandonnèrent tous les commandements de l''Eternel, leur Dieu, ils se firent deux veaux en fonte, ils fabriquèrent des idoles d''Astarté, ils se prosternèrent devant toute l''armée des cieux, et ils servirent Baal.
verses.am: የአምላካቸውንም የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ተዉ፥ ቀልጠው የተሠሩትንም የሁለቱን እንቦሶች ምስሎች አደረጉ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀድንም ተከሉ፥ ለሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ሰገዱ፥ በኣልንም አመለኩ።

verses.en: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.
verses.fr: Ils firent passer par le feu leurs fils et leurs filles, ils se livrèrent à la divination et aux enchantements, et ils se vendirent pour faire ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, afin de l''irriter.
verses.am: ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን በእሳት አሳለፉአቸው፥ ምዋርተኞችና አስማተኞችም ሆኑ፥ ያስቈጡትም ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነገር ለማድረግ ራሳቸውን ሸጡ።

verses.en: Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.fr: Aussi l''Eternel s''est-il fortement irrité contre Israël, et les a-t-il éloignés de sa face. -Il n''est resté que la seule tribu de Juda.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ላይ እጅግ ተቈጣ፥ ከፊቱም ጣላቸው፤ ከይሁዳም ነገድ ብቻ በቀር ማንም አልቀረም።

verses.en: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the Lord their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
verses.fr: Juda même n''avait pas gardé les commandements de l''Eternel, son Dieu, et ils avaient suivi les coutumes établies par Israël. -
verses.am: ይሁዳም ደግሞ እስራኤል ባደረጋት ሥርዓት ሄደ እንጂ የአምላኩን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ አልጠበቀም።

verses.en: And the Lord rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a rejeté toute la race d''Israël; il les a humiliés, il les a livrés entre les mains des pillards, et il a fini par les chasser loin de sa face.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የእስራኤልን ዘር ሁሉ ጠላ፥ አስጨነቃቸውም፥ ከፊቱም እስኪጥላቸው ድረስ በበዝባዦች እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the Lord, and made them sin a great sin.
verses.fr: Car Israël s''était détaché de la maison de David, et ils avaient fait roi Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, qui les avait détournés de l''Eternel, et avait fait commettre à Israël un grand péché.
verses.am: እስራኤልንም ከዳዊት ቤት ለየ፤ የናባጥንም ልጅ ኢዮርብዓምን አነገሡ፤ ኢዮርብዓምም እግዚአብሔርን ከመከተል እስራኤልን መለሰ፥ ታላቅም ኃጢአት አሠራቸው።

verses.en: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël s''étaient livrés à tous les péchés que Jéroboam avait commis; ils ne s''en détournèrent point,
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ኢዮርብዓም ባደረገው ኃጢአት ሁሉ ሄዱ፤

verses.en: Until the Lord removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.
verses.fr: jusqu''à ce que l''Eternel eût chassé Israël loin de sa face, comme il l''avait annoncé par tous ses serviteurs les prophètes. Et Israël a été emmené captif loin de son pays en Assyrie, où il est resté jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በባሪያዎቹ በነቢያቱ ሁሉ አፍ እንደ ተናገረው እስራኤልን ከፊቱ እስኪያወጣ ድረስ ከእርስዋ አልራቁም። እስራኤልም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከምድሩ ወደ አሦር ፈለሰ።

verses.en: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Assyrie fit venir des gens de Babylone, de Cutha, d''Avva, de Hamath et de Sepharvaïm, et les établit dans les villes de Samarie à la place des enfants d''Israël. Ils prirent possession de Samarie, et ils habitèrent dans ses villes.
verses.am: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ከባቢሎንና ከኩታ ከአዋና ከሐማት ከሴፈርዋይም ሰዎችን አመጣ፥ በእስራኤልም ልጆች ፋንታ በሰማርያ ከተሞች አኖራቸው፤ ሰማርያንም ወረሱአት፤ በከተሞችዋም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not the Lord: therefore the Lord sent lions among them, which slew some of them.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils commencèrent à y habiter, ils ne craignaient pas l''Eternel, et l''Eternel envoya contre eux des lions qui les tuaient.
verses.am: በዚያም መቀመጥ በጀመሩ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን አይፈሩትም ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔርም አንበሶች ሰደደባቸው፥ ይገድሉአቸውም ነበር።

verses.en: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.
verses.fr: On dit au roi d''Assyrie: Les nations que tu as transportées et établies dans les villes de Samarie ne connaissent pas la manière de servir le dieu du pays, et il a envoyé contre elles des lions qui les font mourir, parce qu''elles ne connaissent pas la manière de servir le dieu du pays.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ለአሦር ንጉሥ። ያፈለስኻቸው፥ በሰማርያም ከተሞች ያኖርኻቸው የአገሩን አምላክ ወግ አላወቁም፤ የአገሩን አምላክ ወግ አላወቁምና አንበሶችን ሰድዶባቸዋል፥ እነሆም፥ ገደሉአቸው ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.en: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Assyrie donna cet ordre: Faites-y aller l''un des prêtres que vous avez emmenés de là en captivité; qu''il parte pour s''y établir, et qu''il leur enseigne la manière de servir le dieu du pays.
verses.am: የአሦርም ንጉሥ። ከዚያ ካመጣችኋቸው ካህናት አንዱን ውሰዱ፤ ሄዶም በዚያ ይቀመጥ፥ የአገሩንም አምላክ ወግ ያስተምራቸው ብሎ አዘዘ።

verses.en: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the Lord.
verses.fr: Un des prêtres qui avaient été emmenés captifs de Samarie vint s''établir à Béthel, et leur enseigna comment ils devaient craindre l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከሰማርያም ካፈለሱአቸው ካህናት አንዱ መጥቶ በቤቴል ተቀመጠ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም እንዴት እንዲፈሩት ያስተምራቸው ነበር።

verses.en: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.
verses.fr: Mais les nations firent chacune leurs dieux dans les villes qu''elles habitaient, et les placèrent dans les maisons des hauts lieux bâties par les Samaritains.
verses.am: በየሕዝባቸውም አምላካቸውን አደረጉ፥ ሰምራውያንም በሠሩት በኮረብታው መስገጃዎች ሕዝቡ ሁሉ በሚኖሩበት ከተሞቻቸው አኖሩአቸው።

verses.en: And the men of Babylon made Succothbenoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,
verses.fr: Les gens de Babylone firent Succoth-Benoth, les gens de Cuth firent Nergal, les gens de Hamath firent Aschima,
verses.am: የባቢሎንም ሰዎች ሱኮትበኖትን ሠሩ፤ የኩታም ሰዎች ኤርጌልን ሠሩ፤

verses.en: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
verses.fr: ceux d''Avva firent Nibchaz et Tharthak; ceux de Sepharvaïm brûlaient leurs enfants par le feu en l''honneur d''Adrammélec et d''Anammélec, dieux de Sepharvaïm.
verses.am: የሐማትም ሰዎች አሲማትን ሠሩ፤ አዋውያንም ኤልባዝርንና ተርታቅን ሠሩ፤ የሴፈርዋይም ሰዎችም ለሴፈርዋይም አማልክት ለአድራሜሌክና ለአነሜሌክ ልጆቻቸውን በእሳት ያቃጥሉ ነበር።

verses.en: So they feared the Lord, and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.
verses.fr: Ils craignaient aussi l''Eternel, et ils se créèrent des prêtres des hauts lieux pris parmi tout le peuple: ces prêtres offraient pour eux des sacrifices dans les maisons des hauts lieux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም ይፈሩ ነበር፥ ከመካከላቸውም ለኮረብታው መስገጃዎች ካህናት አደረጉ፥ በኮረብታውም መስገጃዎች ይሠዉ ነበር።

verses.en: They feared the Lord, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.
verses.fr: Ainsi ils craignaient l''Eternel, et ils servaient en même temps leurs dieux d''après la coutume des nations d''où on les avait transportés.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም ሲፈሩ ከመካከላቸው እንደ ፈለሱት እንደ አሕዛብ ልማድ አምላካቸውን ያመልኩ ነበር።

verses.en: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the Lord, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the Lord commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;
verses.fr: Ils suivent encore aujourd''hui leurs premiers usages: ils ne craignent point l''Eternel, et ils ne se conforment ni à leurs lois et à leurs ordonnances, ni à la loi et aux commandements prescrits par l''Eternel aux enfants de Jacob qu''il appela du nom d''Israël.
verses.am: እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እንደ ቀደመው ልማድ ያደርጋሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም አይፈሩም፥ እግዚአብሔርም እስራኤል ብሎ የጠራውን የያዕቆብን ልጆች እንዳዘዛቸው ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ሕግና ትእዛዝም አያደርጉም።

verses.en: With whom the Lord had made a covenant, and charged them, saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:
verses.fr: L''Eternel avait fait alliance avec eux, et leur avait donné cet ordre: Vous ne craindrez point d''autres dieux; vous ne vous prosternerez point devant eux, vous ne les servirez point, et vous ne leur offrirez point de sacrifices.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ፥ እንዲህም ብሎ አዘዛቸው። ሌሎችን አማልክት አትፍሩ፥ አትስገዱላቸው፥ አታምልኩአቸው፥ አትሠዉላቸው፤

verses.en: But the Lord, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye do sacrifice.
verses.fr: Mais vous craindrez l''Eternel, qui vous a fait monter du pays d''Egypte avec une grande puissance et à bras étendu; c''est devant lui que vous vous prosternerez, et c''est à lui que vous offrirez des sacrifices.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በታላቅ ኃይል በተዘረጋችም ክንድ ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣችሁን እግዚአብሔር እርሱን ፍሩ፥ ለእርሱም ስገዱ፥ ለእርሱም ሠዉ፤

verses.en: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.
verses.fr: Vous observerez et mettrez toujours en pratique les préceptes, les ordonnances, la loi et les commandements, qu''il a écrits pour vous, et vous ne craindrez point d''autres dieux.
verses.am: የጻፈላችሁንም ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ሕግና ትእዛዝም ለዘላለም ታደርጉ ዘንድ ጠብቁ፤ ሌሎችንም አማልክት አትፍሩ።

verses.en: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.
verses.fr: Vous n''oublierez pas l''alliance que j''ai faite avec vous, et vous ne craindrez point d''autres dieux.
verses.am: ከእናንተም ጋር ያደረግሁትን ቃል ኪዳን አትርሱ፤ ሌሎችንም አማልክት አትፍሩ።

verses.en: But the Lord your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
verses.fr: Mais vous craindrez l''Eternel, votre Dieu; et il vous délivrera de la main de tous vos ennemis.
verses.am: አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ፍሩ፤ እርሱም ከጠላቶቻችሁ ሁሉ እጅ ያድናችኋል።

verses.en: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.
verses.fr: Et ils n''ont point obéi, et ils ont suivi leurs premiers usages.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንደ ቀደመው ልማዳቸው አደረጉ እንጂ አልሰሙም።

verses.en: So these nations feared the Lord, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children's children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.
verses.fr: Ces nations craignaient l''Eternel et servaient leurs images; et leurs enfants et les enfants de leurs enfants font jusqu''à ce jour ce que leurs pères ont fait.
verses.am: እነዚህም አሕዛብ እግዚአብሔርን ይፈሩ ነበር፤ ደግሞም የተቀረጹ ምስሎቻቸውን ያመልኩ ነበር፤ ልጆቻቸውም የልጅ ልጆቻቸውም አባቶቻቸው እንዳደረጉ እንዲሁ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.
verses.fr: La troisième année d''Osée, fils d''Ela, roi d''Israël, Ezéchias, fils d''Achaz, roi de Juda, régna.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በኤላ ልጅ በሆሴዕ በሦስተኛው ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የአካዝ ልጅ ሕዝቅያስ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.
verses.fr: Il avait vingt-cinq ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna vingt-neuf ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Abi, fille de Zacharie.
verses.am: መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሀያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም የዘካርያስ ልጅ አቡ ነበረች።

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that David his father did.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel, entièrement comme avait fait David, son père.
verses.am: እርሱም አባቱ ዳዊት እንዳደረገው ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገርን አደረገ።

verses.en: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.
verses.fr: Il fit disparaître les hauts lieux, brisa les statues, abattit les idoles, et mit en pièces le serpent d''airain que Moïse avait fait, car les enfants d''Israël avaient jusqu''alors brûlé des parfums devant lui: on l''appelait Nehuschtan.
verses.am: በኮረብታም ያሉትን መስገጃዎች አስወገደ፥ ሐውልቶችንም ቀለጣጠመ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቹንም ቈረጠ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች እስከዚህ ዘመን ድረስ ያጥኑለት ነበርና ሙሴ የሠራውን የናሱን እባብ ሰባበረ፤ ስሙንም ነሑሽታን ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: He trusted in the Lord God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor any that were before him.
verses.fr: Il mit sa confiance en l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël; et parmi tous les rois de Juda qui vinrent après lui ou qui le précédèrent, il n''y en eut point de semblable à lui.
verses.am: በእስራኤልም አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር ታመነ፤ ከእርሱም በኋላ ከእርሱም በፊት ከነበሩት ከይሁዳ ነገሥታት ሁሉ እርሱን የሚመስል አልነበረም።

verses.en: For he clave to the Lord, and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Il fut attaché à l''Eternel, il ne se détourna point de lui, et il observa les commandements que l''Eternel avait prescrits à Moïse.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔርም ጋር ተጣበቀ፥ እርሱንም ከመከተል አልራቀም፥ እግዚአብሔርም ለሙሴ ያዘዘውን ትእዛዛቱን ጠበቀ።

verses.en: And the Lord was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel fut avec Ezéchias, qui réussit dans toutes ses entreprises. Il se révolta contre le roi d''Assyrie, et ne lui fut plus assujetti.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ፥ የሚሄድበትም መንገድ ተከናወነለት፤ በአሦርም ንጉሥ ላይ ዐመፀ፥ አልገበረለትም።

verses.en: He smote the Philistines, even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
verses.fr: Il battit les Philistins jusqu''à Gaza, et ravagea leur territoire depuis les tours des gardes jusqu''aux villes fortes.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማውያንንም እስከ ጋዛና እስከ ዳርቻዋ ድረስ፥ ከዘበኞች ግንብ ጀምሮ እስከ ምሽጉ ከተማ ድረስ መታ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.
verses.fr: La quatrième année du roi Ezéchias, qui était la septième année d''Osée, fils d''Ela, roi d''Israël, Salmanasar, roi d''Assyrie, monta contre Samarie et l''assiégea.
verses.am: በንጉሡ በሕዝቅያስ በአራተኛው ዓመት፥ በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በኤላ ልጅ በሆሴዕ በሰባተኛው ዓመት፥ የአሦር ንጉሥ ስልምናሶር ወደ ሰማርያ ወጣ፥ ከበባትም።

verses.en: And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is in the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
verses.fr: Il la prit au bout de trois ans, la sixième année d''Ezéchias, qui était la neuvième année d''Osée, roi d''Israël: alors Samarie fut prise.
verses.am: ከሦስት ዓመት በኋላም ወሰዳት፤ በሕዝቅያስ በስድስተኛው ዓመት፥ በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በሆሴዕ በዘጠኝኛው ዓመት፥ ሰማርያ ተያዘች።

verses.en: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:
verses.fr: Le roi d''Assyrie emmena Israël captif en Assyrie, et il les établit à Chalach, et sur le Chabor, fleuve de Gozan, et dans les villes des Mèdes,
verses.am: የአሦር ንጉሥ እስራኤልን ወደ አሦር አፈለሰ፥ በአላሔና በአቦር በጎዛንም ወንዝ በሜዶንም ከተሞች አኖራቸው፤

verses.en: Because they obeyed not the voice of the Lord their God, but transgressed his covenant, and all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded, and would not hear them, nor do them.
verses.fr: parce qu''ils n''avaient point écouté la voix de l''Eternel, leur Dieu, et qu''ils avaient transgressé son alliance, parce qu''ils n''avaient ni écouté ni mis en pratique tout ce qu''avait ordonné Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የአምላካቸውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰሙምና፥ ቃል ኪዳኑንም አፍርሰዋልና፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ባሪያ ሙሴ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አልሰሙምና፥ አላደረጉምና።

verses.en: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.
verses.fr: La quatorzième année du roi Ezéchias, Sanchérib, roi d''Assyrie, monta contre toutes les villes fortes de Juda, et s''en empara.
verses.am: በንጉሡም በሕዝቅያስ በአሥራ አራተኛው ዓመት የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም ወደ ይሁዳ ወደ ተመሸጉት ከተሞች ሁሉ ወጣ፥ ወሰዳቸውም።

verses.en: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
verses.fr: Ezéchias, roi de Juda, envoya dire au roi d''Assyrie à Lakis: J''ai commis une faute! Eloigne-toi de moi. Ce que tu m''imposeras, je le supporterai. Et le roi d''Assyrie imposa à Ezéchias, roi de Juda, trois cents talents d''argent et trente talents d''or.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ። በድያለሁ፥ ከእኔ ተመለስ፤ የምትጭንብኝን ሁሉ እሸከማለሁ ብሎ ወደ አሦር ንጉሥ ወደ ለኪሶ ላከ። የአሦርም ንጉሥ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሕዝቅያስ ላይ ሦስት መቶ መክሊት ብርና ሠላሳ መክሊት ወርቅ ጫነበት።

verses.en: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasures of the king's house.
verses.fr: Ezéchias donna tout l''argent qui se trouvait dans la maison de l''Eternel et dans les trésors de la maison du roi.
verses.am: ሕዝቅያስም በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በንጉሡ ቤት መዛግብት የተገኘውን ብር ሁሉ ሰጠው።

verses.en: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the Lord, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
verses.fr: Ce fut alors qu''Ezéchias, roi de Juda, enleva, pour les livrer au roi d''Assyrie, les lames d''or dont il avait couvert les portes et les linteaux du temple de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ሕዝቅያስ ከእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ደጆችና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ ከለበጣቸው መቃኖች ወርቁን ቈረጠ፥ ለአሦርም ንጉሥ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller's field.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Assyrie envoya de Lakis à Jérusalem, vers le roi Ezéchias, Tharthan, Rab-Saris et Rabschaké avec une puissante armée. Ils montèrent, et ils arrivèrent à Jérusalem. Lorsqu''ils furent montés et arrivés, ils s''arrêtèrent à l''aqueduc de l''étang supérieur, sur le chemin du champ du foulon.
verses.am: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ተርታንንና ራፌስን ራፋስቂስንም ከብዙ ሠራዊት ጋር ከለኪሶ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ላከ። ወጥተውም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ፤ በመጡም ጊዜ በአጣቢው እርሻ መንገድ ባለችው በላይኛይቱ ኩሬ መስኖ አጠገብ ቆሙ።

verses.en: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.
verses.fr: Ils appelèrent le roi; et Eliakim, fils de Hilkija, chef de la maison du roi, se rendit auprès d''eux, avec Schebna, le secrétaire, et Joach, fils d''Asaph, l''archiviste.
verses.am: ንጉሡንም ጠሩ፤ የቤቱም አዛዥ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ ኤልያቄም ጸሐፊውም ሳምናስ ታሪክ ጸሐፊውም የአሳፍ ልጅ ዮአስ ወደ እነርሱ ወጡ።

verses.en: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
verses.fr: Rabschaké leur dit: Dites à Ezéchias: Ainsi parle le grand roi, le roi d''Assyrie: Quelle est cette confiance, sur laquelle tu t''appuies?
verses.am: ራፋስቂስም አላቸው። ለሕዝቅያስ እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩት። ታላቁ የአሦር ንጉሥ እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ የምትታመንበት መተማመኛ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Thou sayest, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
verses.fr: Tu as dit: Il faut pour la guerre de la prudence et de la force. Mais ce ne sont que des paroles en l''air. En qui donc as-tu placé ta confiance, pour t''être révolté contre moi?
verses.am: የከንፈር ቃል ለሰልፍ ምክርና ኃይል እንደሚሆን ትናገራለህ፤ አሁንም በእኔ ላይ ያመፅኸው በማን ተማምነህ ነው?

verses.en: Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.
verses.fr: Voici, tu l''as placée dans l''Egypte, tu as pris pour soutien ce roseau cassé, qui pénètre et perce la main de quiconque s''appuie dessus: tel est Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, pour tous ceux qui se confient en lui.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በዚህ በተቀጠቀጠ በሸምበቆ በትር በግብጽ ትታመናለህ፤ ሰው ቢመረኰዘው ተሰብሮ በእጁ ይገባል ያቈስለውማል፤ የግብጽ ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ለሚታመኑበት ሁሉ እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.en: But if ye say unto me, We trust in the Lord our God: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?
verses.fr: Peut-être me direz-vous: C''est en l''Eternel, notre Dieu, que nous nous confions. Mais n''est-ce pas lui dont Ezéchias a fait disparaître les hauts lieux et les autels, en disant à Juda et à Jérusalem: Vous vous prosternerez devant cet autel à Jérusalem?
verses.am: እናንተም። በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር እንታመናለን ብትሉኝ፥ ሕዝቅያስ ይሁዳንና ኢየሩሳሌምን። በኢየሩሳሌም ባለው በዚህ መሠዊያ ፊት ሰገዱ ብሎ የኮረብታ መስገጃዎቹንና መሠዊያውቹን ያስፈረሰ ይህ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
verses.fr: Maintenant, fais une convention avec mon maître, le roi d''Assyrie, et je te donnerai deux mille chevaux, si tu peux fournir des cavaliers pour les monter.
verses.am: አሁን እንግዲህ ከጌታዬ ከአሦር ንጉሥ ጋር ተወራረድ፥ የሚቀመጡባቸውንም ሰዎች ማግኘት ቢቻልህ እኔ ሁለት ሺህ ፈረሶች እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.fr: Comment repousserais-tu un seul chef d''entre les moindres serviteurs de mon maître? Tu mets ta confiance dans l''Egypte pour les chars et pour les cavaliers.
verses.am: ስለ ሰረገሎችና ስለ ፈረሰኞች በግብጽ ስትታመን፥ ከጌታዬ ባሪያዎች የሚያንሰውን የአንዱ አለቃ ፊት ትቃወም ዘንድ እንዴት ይቻልሃል?

verses.en: Am I now come up without the Lord against this place to destroy it? The Lord said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
verses.fr: D''ailleurs, est-ce sans la volonté de l''Eternel que je suis monté contre ce lieu, pour le détruire? L''Eternel m''a dit: Monte contre ce pays, et détruis-le.
verses.am: አሁን በውኑ ያለ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ይህን ስፍራ አጠፋ ዘንድ ወጥቻለሁን? እግዚአብሔር። ወደዚች አገር ወጥተህ አጥፋት አለኝ።

verses.en: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and talk not with us in the Jews' language in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
verses.fr: Eliakim, fils de Hilkija, Schebna et Joach, dirent à Rabschaké: Parle à tes serviteurs en araméen, car nous le comprenons; et ne nous parle pas en langue judaïque, aux oreilles du peuple qui est sur la muraille.
verses.am: የኬልቅያስም ልጅ ኤልያቄም ሳምናስም ዮአስም ራፋስቂስን። እኛ እንሰማለንና እባክህ፥ በሶርያ ቋንቋ ለባሪያዎችህ ተናገር፤ በቅጥርም ላይ ባለው ሕዝብ ጆሮ በአይሁድ ቋንቋ አትናገረን አሉት።

verses.en: But Rabshakeh said unto them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
verses.fr: Rabschaké leur répondit: Est-ce à ton maître et à toi que mon maître m''a envoyé dire ces paroles? N''est-ce pas à ces hommes assis sur la muraille pour manger leurs excréments et pour boire leur urine avec vous?
verses.am: ራፋስቂስ ግን። ጌታዬ ይህን ቃል እናገር ዘንድ ወደ አንተና ወደ ጌታህ ልኮኛልን? ከእናንተ ጋር ኵሳቸውን ይበሉ ዘንድ ሽንታቸውንም ይጠጡ ዘንድ በቅጥር ላይ ወደ ተቀመጡት ሰዎች አይደለምን? አላቸው።

verses.en: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:
verses.fr: Alors Rabschaké, s''étant avancé, cria à haute voix en langue judaïque, et dit: Ecoutez la parole du grand roi, du roi d''Assyrie!
verses.am: ራፋስቂስም ቆሞ በታላቅ ድምፅ በአይሁድ ቋንቋ እንዲህ ብሎ ጮኽ። የታላቁን የአሦር ንጉሥ ቃል ስሙ፤ ንጉሡ እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le roi: Qu''Ezéchias ne vous abuse point, car il ne pourra vous délivrer de ma main.
verses.am: ከእጄ ያድናችሁ ዘንድ አይችልምና ሕዝቅያስ አያታልላችሁ፤

verses.en: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord, saying, The Lord will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.fr: Qu''Ezéchias ne vous amène point à vous confier en l''Eternel, en disant: L''Eternel nous délivrera, et cette ville ne sera pas livrée entre les mains du roi d''Assyrie.
verses.am: ሕዝቅያስም። እግዚአብሔር በእርግጥ ያድነናል፥ ይህችም ከተማ በአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ አትሰጥም ብሎ በእግዚአብሔር እንድትታመኑ አያድርጋችሁ።

verses.en: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:
verses.fr: N''écoutez point Ezéchias; car ainsi parle le roi d''Assyrie: Faites la paix avec moi, rendez-vous à moi, et chacun de vous mangera de sa vigne et de son figuier, et chacun boira de l''eau de sa citerne,
verses.am: ሕዝቅያስንም አትስሙ፤ የአሦር ንጉሥ እንዲህ ይላል። ከእኔ ጋር ታረቁ ወደ እኔም ውጡ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም ከወይናችሁና ከበለሳችሁ ብሉ ከጕድጓዳችሁም ውኃ ጠጡ፤

verses.en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The Lord will deliver us.
verses.fr: jusqu''à ce que je vienne, et que je vous emmène dans un pays comme le vôtre, dans un pays de blé et de vin, un pays de pain et de vignes, un pays d''oliviers à huile et de miel, et vous vivrez et vous ne mourrez point. N''écoutez donc point Ezéchias; car il pourrait vous séduire en disant: L''Eternel nous délivrera.
verses.am: ይህም መጥቼ ምድራችሁን ወደምትመስለው ምድር፥ እህልና የወይን ጠጅ፥ እንጀራና ወይን፥ ወይራና ማር ወዳለባት ምድር እስካፈልሳችሁ ድረስ በሕይወት እንድትኖሩ እንዳትሞቱም ነው። ሕዝቅያስም። እግዚአብሔር ያድነናል ብሎ ቢያታልላችሁ አትስሙት።

verses.en: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.fr: Les dieux des nations ont-ils délivré chacun son pays de la main du roi d''Assyrie?
verses.am: በውኑ የአሕዛብ አማልክት አገሮቻቸውን ከአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ አድነዋቸዋልን?

verses.en: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?
verses.fr: Où sont les dieux de Hamath et d''Arpad? Où sont les dieux de Sepharvaïm, d''Héna et d''Ivva? Ont-ils délivré Samarie de ma main?
verses.am: የሐማትና የአርፋድ አማልክት ወዴት አሉ? የሴፈርዋይምና የሄና የዒዋም አማልክት ወዴት አሉ?

verses.en: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?
verses.fr: Parmi tous les dieux de ces pays, quels sont ceux qui ont délivré leur pays de ma main, pour que l''Eternel délivre Jérusalem de ma main?
verses.am: ሰማርያን ከእጄ አድነዋታልን? እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን ከእጄ ያድን ዘንድ ከአገሮቹ አማልክት ሁሉ አገሩን ከእጄ ያዳነ ማን ነው?

verses.en: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
verses.fr: Le peuple se tut, et ne lui répondit pas un mot; car le roi avait donné cet ordre: Vous ne lui répondrez pas.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ዝም አሉ፥ አንዳችም አልመለሱለትም፤ ንጉሡ እንዳይመልሱለት አዝዞ ነበርና።

verses.en: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.fr: Et Eliakim, fils de Hilkija, chef de la maison du roi, Schebna, le secrétaire, et Joach, fils d''Asaph, l''archiviste, vinrent auprès d''Ezéchias, les vêtements déchirés, et lui rapportèrent les paroles de Rabschaké.
verses.am: የቤቱ አዛዥ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ ኤልያቄም ጸሐፊውም ሳምናስ ታሪክ ጸሐፊም የአሳፍ ልጅ ዮአስ ልብሳቸውን ቀድደው ወደ ሕዝቅያስ መጡ፥ የራፋስቂስንም ቃል ነገሩት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Lorsque le roi Ezéchias eut entendu cela, il déchira ses vêtements, se couvrit d''un sac, et alla dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሕዝቅያስ ይህን በሰማ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀደደ፥ ማቅም ለበሰ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ገባ።

verses.en: And he sent Eliakim, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
verses.fr: Il envoya Eliakim, chef de la maison du roi, Schebna, le secrétaire, et les plus anciens des sacrificateurs, couverts de sacs, vers Esaïe, le prophète, fils d''Amots.
verses.am: የቤቱንም አዛዥ ኤልያቄምን ጸሐፊውንም ሳምናስን የካህናቱንም ሽማግሌዎች ማቅ ለብሰው ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ አሞጽ ልጅ ወደ ኢሳይያስ ይሄዱ ዘንድ ላካቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy; for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
verses.fr: Et ils lui dirent: Ainsi parle Ezéchias: Ce jour est un jour d''angoisse, de châtiment et d''opprobre; car les enfants sont près de sortir du sein maternel, et il n''y a point de force pour l''enfantement.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ሕዝቅያስ እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ ቀን የመከራና የተግሣጽ የዘለፋም ቀን ነው፤ ልጆች የሚወለዱበት ጊዜ ደርሶአል፥ ለመውለድም ኃይል የለም።
